I needed to purchase a stool to help me get up and down from my high bed after a total knee replacement surgery . I ordered this because it appeared to be identical to the one I used at the Rehabilitation center. It needed to both support over 200 pounds and fit between the legs I'd a walker without being too high. It was important the stool be at home waiting for me. The stool arrived and it was a disaster! The rubber step was dirty as if mud was wiped across it, it had a huge dent in the side and the metal edges were all rough. There was nothing wrong with the packaging so this didn't happen during transport. I tried standing on it since I needed to be able to use something to get into bed and it was giving under my weight, Amazon was great about the return, UPS picked it up at my house the next morning and the next day a replacement was delivered but I didn't have what I needed at home when I needed it. The replacement is okay, no dents, no dirt, still a little roughness around the metal edges. If I ordered one from the medical supply store it would have been double what I paid for this, i'm sorry I didn't because I would have had same day return if there had been any issues. I normally get very good values on Amazon but in this case, I got what I paid for, lower quality and less convenience. Hopefully I won't have to use it for long.

Cool looking but the red plastic is so hard the rt side button to lock the phone didn't work. Tried cutting 2 and then 3 of 4 thin areas free around that button to just use as a pivot hinge but ended up removing the right side button cover entirely leaving her a hole to put her fingernail into. Also, the screen protection glass is considerably smaller and literally floats/slides around the screen. It doesn't even touch the case or edge of the phone screen. Thumbs down to that. I do like the corner thingy for the neck lanyard [they do include a thin one.] With so many other cases that are typically cheaper, I'd have thought this would have been of better design.

I think the band itself looks really nice. I like the divets and I think it’s something I would have worn pretty frequently. However, when I took it off right after trying it on for the first time, the bar that holds the band to the watch came undone and sprung across my room. I’m not entirely sure why this watch would be made with a spring bar instead of a permanent bar, seeing as it’s made to stretch when it’s taken off. I think it’s really cute and I’m sad I can’t wear it, but I just don’t trust my Apple Watch with it now. Returned it immediately.

Update 3/30/23: They work well, but are fragile and both cases broke near the iWatch rotary dial in under 2 months. It is the weak spot in the plastic, and due to design it will always fail at that point. Once it breaks, it does not keep out the moisture. These work better than expected, great in fact, for keeping the moisture out and keeping the iWatch touch responsive during the most intense workouts. Even if moisture did get inside the case, which it hasn't yet, it is a quick snap off, dry, and snap back on. It is also more visually appealing than I thought it would be. The best inexpensive watch and screen protector I've used to date. The only minor issue is that the crown dial is a little less accessible, although it's good enough. I would recommend this product to others. In comparison, I've previously tried many other soft plastic covers to protect my iWatch. Eventually during a strong workout, the sweat will get inside the cover. When that happens, the iWatch is virtually unusable and not responsive to touch. So you have to take it off by taking off the watch band, drying it, and then placing it back on the iWatch to protect it at the gym. This takes time and is very inconvenient! Then one will have to hope it stays touch responsive for the rest of the workout. This moisture resistant case solves the problems of the other screen and watch protectors. It may not stay moisture resistant while swimming however, but I have not tried yet.

I’ve had the misfortune of owning a lot of these Solar charging power banks. I do a lot of outdoors activities so being able to change my electronics in the sun was very important in choosing a good power bank. This power bank has so far been the only one I’ve been able to charge to full in the sun. Very happy with this purchase. I’d recommend this if you need a solar charging power bank. UPDATE: Aug.25.2022. I’m going to start off by saying this is perhaps the best solar bank I’ve had. That being said, when I first had the unit it would always charge to full in the sun. But as of recent the power bank will not charge to full anymore. It would only charge to half and no matter how long you leave it out it will never charge to full. Disappointed, I thought I had a winner. I believe this is due to design flaws more than quality control issues. This problem isn’t isolated to just this design and manufacturer but all of them in general. I’ve always covered the battery portion of the power bank when out in the sun. Because I KNOW batteries don’t want to be out in the blistering heat. Why do they insist on you leaving a heat sensitive device out in the hot sun for extended period of time is beyond me. Solar power banks JUST SAY NO!

This case was probably my favorite case I had ever gotten for a phone before. The design is great and it looks good on the phone. It fits very tightly and you can still access all the ports and buttons with it on. My issue with this case is that I carry my phone in my pocket and my jeans (and no they were not new jeans) turned the white case blue. I could not clean this off and it just got worse with each time. I did return this case because of it. If it was not for that then I would have used this case forever.

my daughter loves the purple sparkly look on this and knew exactly what to do with the ring on the back. i like that the case comes with a lanyard. there should be better instructions on where to connect the lanyard. the lanyard is looped through the bottom right side of the case. you can barely see the opening because it blends in with the color of the case. the back also has a paper insert to make it sparkly or clear.....i almost threw it away because it looked like the stuff they use stuff the case with to make it appealing in the package. im only deducting the one star for those reasons....basically for a lack of any instructions!!

This case has a nice texture and feel to it. I liked the color and the rubberized texture helped prevent my iPhone 13 Pro from accidentally slipping out of my hand or pocket. Unfortunately, about a month and a half after I started using it, the case cracked around one corner and by the ringer silence switch. A portion of the case also broke away near the base. I’m pretty careful with my phones and never dropped. The only wear and tear was from taking the phone in and out of my pocket. I ended buying another case from another seller that is much more durable.

This is my 2nd clip like this, as my daughter borrowed (permanently) my 1st one. Compared to that 1st one this one seems less steady when it's holding my phone. It's also harder to get it into the clip because the clip only has one side that you push open the other is attached to the bar the holds everything relatively stable. Half the time I just open it and let my phone plop down to my bed as it takes 2 hands to both open and put the phone in or open it and grab the phone. Also, the part that grabs on to the shelf keeps sliding back off the shelf as I use it. So I have to slide it back on to the shelf. It's not damaging the shelf at all, which is a plus, but the fact it moves is bothersome as it would crash on my head if I didn't pay attention to the issue and fix it.

I've had this screen protector peel up on the edges. Maybe it's just me because I keep my phone in my front pocket and the protector is not really 'glued' down. Where the phone rubs on my pocket, the edges began tearing and peeling up. There is too much friction against the screen protector and it doesn't last for me. I think I need one that is a little more ridged that isn't so soft and prone to tear. The protector looks good until it comes up. The little lens protectors are cute too but useless if you have your phone in a case that already does what they are supposed to do.

I ordered this case because I had the same one for my iPhone 5 and LOVED it! Unfortunately, this one has a couple features that are different that I don’t like as well. The volume & power buttons are flat & very stiff making them very difficult to use. My last case’s buttons were protruding a bit & a lot easier to push. Also, the layout of the credit card pocket is different too-no big deal. The felt covering the magnets came up so I glued them back down with super glue (this was an issue with my last case too but again, no big deal). Nevertheless, I still like it-beats carrying around bulky wallets & purses which I don’t care for. It does it’s job & protects well. I love the camera protection it provides!

Not worth the price premium: I can buy a bunch of generic adapters and good Cozy tethers for less. EDIT November 30, 2022. Replacement unit is now connecting intermittently after 3 months. Process of elimination points to this adapter’s female socket (which is ironic because the male Type-C is supposed to fail earlier by design). EDIT July 23, 2022. The adapter has suddenly stopped working after a bit over 6 months. Seller is suggesting ‘wear from excessive use’ which is ridiculous for an adapter that is rarely removed. I would expect a ‘no hassle’ replacement for something commanding this premium price. ORIGINAL REVIEW Functions well but they chose a more rigid formulation for the tether. This means the loop can’t stretch much and is in fact is larger than the Apple OEM cable’s connector and can run the length of the cable and even fall off. For the price, the tether should do it’s job flawlessly: stay in place. I considered returning it, but it works better than cheaper adapters, so I printed a two-piece collet to grip the cable.

The case is nice and fit almost perfect. The silver edge of the phone shows where the rubber wraps around in some places. So far very sturdy and looks cool. My issue is with the holster. The phone slides in from the top and is tight which is good. But it's so tight that when I have it clipped in my pocket it is impossible to remove the phone with one hand, the holster pulls out with the phone. I would prefer it snap out the front like my old iPhone Otterbox instead of sliding in. The kickstand on the back of the case is a nice bonus. I have discovered another issue since originally posting this. With the phone in the holster and getting a call I have hung up on two people today because I hit the side button when pulling the phone out. I own a business and can't be hanging up on people so I will be getting a new case.

This is a very rugged case that is easy to install and use. It's even pretty easy to take off again, in case you need to access the battery or some other covered part of the phone. I like that the silicone cover prevents it from sliding off smooth surfaces, although it does attract a lot of dust. It also make the phone quite bulky and obstructs some key parts of the phone. I would end up peeling back the silicone under the fingerprint reader each time I would use it, until I wrapped a little strip of electrical tape around that edge of the silicone. The tape is sufficiently smooth that my finger glides over it. However, it is still difficult to put my finger at the proper angle to use the reader, since the silicone comes up at a fairly steep angle from the base of the reader. The case also makes it impossible to insert many audio plugs into the audio jack. I ended up buying an audio extender cable with a very narrow plug to work around that issue.

Magnet is thin and strong but it interferes with charging and completely blocks the charge when using a charging pad/dock that you just lay your phone on. This will only provide great value if you charge using the traditional charging chord. Both my wife and I put the magnet on the inside of our phone cases and we have to remove the each night to charge since we both use charging pad. The other bad thing is it blocks AC/Heat flow from your vent when your phone is attached to the larger vent magnet. We live in Florida and constantly have the air on. Which ever vent holds the phone will be 80% blocked.

Used this case for my Samsung Galaxy S10e. Case offers good protection from drops and has a nice raised edge. Buttons are clicky, good grip, not much bulk for the amount of protection it provides. Couple of issues, most minor. The paint on the back scratches off very easily so it won't look new for long. I can scratch it off with my fingernail. The kickstand, although it works, feels cheap. I wish Spigen would use a metal one secured with a magnet. Lastly, the volume up and down buttons are difficult to find in the dark. I wish there was a more tactile feel to them so I could distinguish volume up from down, similar to the ridges found on the bixby button. Overall, very solid minus the paint issue.

We have several wall plug fast chargers, up to 45 watts, lightning fast. Needed something for travel that provides wireless charging. Did not notice the limit of 5 Watts when ordered. Our Samsung desk fast charger is 15 watts and takes 2hrs to fully charge Samsung Galaxy Note 10+ 5G cellphone. So if this one is only 5 watts, we are looking at only a single charge if that much with an approx. full charge time of 6-7 hours which would be excessive time. We have enough cable charger for the phone. Most likely will send back if wireless takes that long. Defeats our purpose of buying.

***I received this New Trent product at a reduced price in return for a fair and reliable review based on my user experience.*** I currently still use an iPhone 4S. Since I'm planning to upgrade to the 6S, I took advantage of the manufacturer's offer. This appears to be a solid product that will offer decent protection from bumps. It's not as robust as the Otterbox Commuter on my 4S, neither is it as bulky. The more streamlined design is better for slipping the device in my pocket. I'm going to have a friend with a 6S give it a test run and give me his assessment.

I would have given this five but the first one i received was perfect. It was soft rubber and sticky but not gooey. And not sticky in a what's-that-on-my-hand sort of way. But the second one I brought from here was harder rubber. Not as sticky. Completely different texture. And if you put it Down and pick it up again to move it. It will never stick again. The soft rubbery one was great. The second harder rubber not so much. But I still recommend the buy because the second one still doesn't REALLY move around on the dash. It's just the first one is better.

After terrible experience with the Moto G4, the Galaxy J7 was almost a relief. However, the call quality was often abysmal, and even at maximum volume, the speaker was inadequate--not only in-call, but also to allow me to hear the phone ring or give other notifications. Additionally, the Android experience has been less than user-friendly on three phones, although this was the best of the three. Many frequently used functions require three, four, five or more actions before they are available. I returned the phone and went back to my Nokia 635. Although not as tricked out, it does almost everything faster, more easily, and with far less confusion. Too bad that no one in the US, to my knowledge, is using the Windows phone OS. It is so much more user-friendly than Google's Android. If the Nokia ever fails, I will need to buy an iPhone, although I have used my daughter's and still prefer the Nokia.

The only thing I really don’t like is how the rubber on the sides gets yellow. And has like pressure cracks on the side of the case but it seems to hold up well. But it’s by far way better quality than life proof and the screen doesn’t get scratched or the camera screen doesn’t scratch. I wish they offered in different colors like black. Or clear black. Best of all the price is reasonable and you don’t feel like you are getting ripped off. The case only lasted about 5 months. It turned yellow with in a couple weeks before the front plastic cover separated from the case. It protects your phone but now at $70 I will not purchase it again considering how it yellows so fast.

This is a good phone case, but I dropped it a bunch of times and it cracked. I contacted the supplier and they gave me another one. I dropped that one as well and it cracked in the same space - the thin strip on the bottom. However, I did love the case. It was durable and loved the kick stand (I got a new phone - that wouldn't fit in the case). I loved that it came with a screen protector. And it stayed together even after I dropped it a few times. I'm rough on phone cases, I drop them all the time.

For the most part, this case is decent enough. The outer shell is very stiff and hard to separate from the inner shell. I had hoped it would be a bit easier to take apart. The inner shell is very brittle and though I was able to take it apart, I was fearful of cracking the plastic on several of the tabs. The built in socket is nice but also VERY stiff and not easily popped up. I have rough edges on mine and managed to cut my fingers in a few places. This will strictly be a back up case at this point. I'm not likely to order again but it will do in a pinch.

Been a big fan of the Spigen Thin cases for a long time. Used them on my previous Samsung and Pixel phones. They were perfect as the case was minimal, but offered the right balance of protection. comfort, and grip for me. UNFORTUNATELY, this new model case is nothing like those previous versions. For me it is a major regression for the type for the type of case I am looking for. Don't get me wrong, this is not a bad case, but it is not a thin case either. It adds much more bulk to the phone than any Spigen or thin case I have used previously. It also adds a more significant ridge around the front of the phone, making it harder to swipe near the edges. It is unfortunate as I will not be using a Spigen case for the first time in a long time.

Bought this for my iPhone 12 Pro Max. Had the same brand for my XR and XS Max, and LOVED them. For the 12 Pro Max...First one cracked on application. No idea why. Second does not fit correctly and appears to be incompatible with OtterBox Defender Screenless Edition case (which I used on my other phones, too.) On the 12 Pro Max, application of the cases front bezel lifted 3 corners and one side of the screen protector. I was able to get the side to lay down, but still have 3 corners that won't adhere properly. 5 stars for application process (easiest ever), -1 star for the one that cracked during application, -1 star for fitment issues. I've reached out to the company via email.

My husband, son and I have been using these Spigen SlimArmor cases for years and love them! I always get lots of compliments on mine. But this new design has a big flaw. The new version has a rubber-like upper section, which leaves a narrow strip of plastic at the top of the lower portion, which just shatters from fatigue after about 6 months of use. It happened to my husband, and then to me, and now my son. I switched to a different case for now, but would gladly go back to Spigen if they fix this design flaw!

I couldn't even get it on even while following the video instructions so I had to pull it off and put it on normally. I left bubbles but I had to keep redoing it so it had less bubbles but now the sides, top and bottom won't stick good cause of the case. I've owned many screen protectors and they stayed put regardless of the case so this is not a good screen protector. I'll have to keep it on temporarily till I find a better 1. I hate glass ones so I thought this would be good. As far as the video, it's too difficult to follow. And I only got 3 but the description says 5 pack.

The case comes in 2 pieces and has to be snapped together. It's a real tight, perfect fit and it came within a few days. Really happy with the purchase and will use the seller again. It's for the HTC One V. I bought my phone from virgin mobile directly. **UPDATE** 3-28-2013 - I had the case for a little over 4 months now and I'm noticing it's starting to peel in a few places. I'm really surprised since I hardly use the phone. It's for a no contract plan so I haven't used it since early January. Guess I shouldn't complain due to the price but under the little usage, I'm surprised it would peel. Downgrading to 4 stars.

This is a generically made product which far exceeds the cheapo original equipment. The original case from Huawei is hard, thin, and brittle. With care it has a very short life. This is thicker and soft with a nice wrap-around fit. There is no opening for the on/off switch. No matter. The case is soft and with no effort the switch can be operated easily. The product itself deserves 5 stars. I gave it 3 since the shipping is over the top expensive on an item that weighs an ounce. If you buy more than one, the shipping rate (Rip off) rises accordingly. There is no multi purchase discount

The Snugg Ultra Thin clear case fits and Iphone 5S very nicely. Clear case is very clear when new. It nicely shows off the good looks of the phone, adds a little grip and is not bulky at all. Good for somebody who is looking for something very minimalistic, small and non-intruding. Everything is a trade off, for the sexy slim lines this cover actually offers very little cushioning should you drop the phone. The minimal protection you get would cover you on very minor drops and from scratching the case in day to day use. After just a few days my case has a few very minor exterior scratches and minor dust between the case and phone. My review reminds me of a car review on a performance convertible I once saw. The reviewer had the audacity to complain that this top down high performance vehicle had stiff ride and was noisy. You can't have it all. A+ on looks, A+ on fit, A+ on size, D+ on protection.

Con highlights: finicky touch screen, speaker no longer works. so the instructions are, for the most part, very easy to follow. its just very meticulous. i love they have pictures with each instructions so you know exactly what you're supposed to be doing. however, pics are in black and white so they are helpful like 85% of the time because the pieces are so small without contrasting colors its hard to see. screen does have a different color display, not bad, just different- colors are more vibrant, so i like it. I have used it for about 2 weeks, the touch screen sticks sometimes- pressing a letter one time will produce three letters, not every time but enough that i notice. Also i have to press harder or lighter in some aspects to scroll, its a little finicky. also now my speaker does not work. i have tried three time to re-align it to make sure it all lines up and idk what else to do but now it doesn't work i can't hear anything from the regular speaker, so all calls are on speaker or i need to make sure i have headphones with me. this is either because i put it together wrong or the screen backings do not align properly for the connection to be made.

I love the look of this phone, but I don't think it will protect at all. The back of the phone case is really thick, but then the front is flush with the screen. Just thinking if I dropped my phone face down there would be absolutely no protection. I also don't really like that the logo is open. Seems like it will just collect dirt and scratch up the back of my phone (not sure if that really matters though). Just thinking I'm so clumsy and even though I love the look of this phone I will need to replace it with one that will actually protect it from my slippery fingers.

It’s a very cute and fun phone case to have, but strictly only for looks. It’s very thin and doesn’t protect your phone from any falls. The edges do not stick out around the screen for protection so my screen got pretty banged up on one of the falls. I clean my cases nightly to disinfect them and it faded pretty quickly, plus cleaning it doesn’t remove stains from grabbing it or putting it in your pant pockets. I wouldn’t buy it again. It was fun to have for those few weeks as a novelty. Not worth the crack on my screen though.

This kit has you use stickers to line up the screen protector on your screen which I find doesn't work well. Thankfully, I've done enough of these that I can line enough by sight. I put the first one on and it had a bubble so I used the second one, figuring I left a piece of lint on my screen. I cleaned my screen very thoroughly, dried it very thoroughly, and then use the little sticky sticker to remove every last bit of lint. Still have one bubble. Not enough for me to waste another cover but it's frustrating. Makes me wonder if it's a flaw in the screen protector itself. Another brand I purchased is known for bubbles and it happened on mine. And wonder if the bubbles are actually on the screen protector itself.

I wasn't convinced that this product would protect my phone screen but I've changed my mind. So far, it has protected it well. It is case friendly. It does show smudges and such but that's standard of any screen protector. What keeps me from giving five stars is this...the very edges of the sheet are raised...the edges do not adhere to the round contour of the phone face. This is not a result of installation but Is a design issue. The edges are raised and does gather dust. Past protectors I've used are just slightly smaller than the screen and adhere completely from edge to edge. This really isn't a deal breaker. Overall, I'm satisfied with this purchase and would recommend.

TLDR: If you are looking to have your Z Fold S Pen always next to your display on a budget that is a slim case then this may be just for you. Pros: - Budget Price - Slim case - S Pen slot is just right and can be put in either way - Slim cutouts for everything - Kickstand holds phone up for landscape viewing Cons: - Kickstand only has one position and cannot support it in portrait mode - No hinge protection - Fairly smooth and cheap plastic feeling - Doesn't sit exactly flat when fully opened If you just want a case for when your watching content in landscape and need an S Pen always on you there then this may be the case on a budget for you.

Looks nice, and made well enough, but: > Only two card pockets. Yes, I knew that going in, but not so hot anyway > Bill pocket is too short, so you can't actually put any money in it; this is the biggest problem for me. Folding the money makes it too thick. > When open, the clasp flops back onto the phone, blocking its use - should have a magnet or something to flip it back out of the way. *** Update *** - This does have it. you fold back the clasp, then fold back the cover and it holds it all. > The design is "tight" which is good, until you try to put anything in the pockets; then its all bulgy and overstuffed feeling. All-in-all, nice idea, but useless to replace a wallet which was my intended purpose. Will have to try another. Suggestions to make this great for me: > add a 3rd card pocket > make it 1/8" or so taller so I can get money in it > make it a touch thicker at the binding so that when you actually put in a couple cards and a couple bills that it still folds flat.

This is a space saver and it’s definitely more convenient than having 3 different chargers for my iPhone, AirPods Pro, and Watch. The main reasons I got this was for my Watch however it won’t charge it to 100%. After leaving it overnight to charge the Watch, it always charges to about 60-70%. Maybe I got a defective unit, I’m not sure. The AirPods and iPhone charge without any issues. As far as the styling goes, it’s one of the better looking 3-in1 chargers that I have seen at an affordable price. Based on my personal experience, I will only give it 2 stars. Also lost points for including a usb-A charger which I believe should have been a usb-C. It is compact and had it been working properly, I would have taken it on a recent trip.

I got these as a replacement screen for the one I had cracked. The packaging is great, but even better than that is how easy it is to use. The box has step by step instructions with everything to clean off your screen, even down to removing the dust. Then I aligned the screen protector and it began to apply itself. It was so easy! No air bubbles and so far the touch screen hasn't given me any problems. I have two more backup ones now and I'll update if it's not very durable but so far, I recommend these 100%! UPDATE: It’s been less than a month and I already have a crack in the screen cover. I’m going to replace it since I have two backups but Im little disappointed the crack happened by me simply placing my phone face down. Seems a little more sensitive than I first thought

This protector is sooooo close to being a great choice for the Mate 20. The only thing holding it back is that it is just a touch to short from top to bottom...because of this, each corner cuts juuuust a very very small part of the screen off. When I say just a small bit, I mean that. Most people probably wouldn't even notice, but I'm a bit OCD with protectors. Other than that, this is a solid choice of glass protectors...probably the best on Amazon for the Mate 20 (NOT Pro). Feel is great and I like that it is full coverage, including the front facing camera. They even included a clear skin for the rest of the phone, but I screwed that up when installing, so I just trashed it. Other than the one issue mentioned, this is a very good protector.

For the most part, it's a screen protector - not a lot you can say, but just wanted to add that the matte screen protectors in general are more difficult to work with. I really don't know why, it seems like it should be the same, but for some reason it's not (in my experience anyway). To get these to go on smoothly and bubble free takes a lot more patience. Find a dust free area, then clean it because there's dust there you don't know about until you open these things. Thoroughly clean yourself and the phone and yourself again. Then treat these as though you were working in a CDC lab and any uncontrolled movement might cause complete contamination. You might still have a bubble after following the above, but using the credit card/gift card/store card application method should result in fairly decent application.

Good looking case, not so good protection... I've had alot of tpu cases and none come off as easy. The lip does not COMPLETELY cover the bezel and slips off with a slight push on any corner. I also dont really like the extra edge on the bottom. I've seen many cases without this but with better protection as the cases will never come off after a drop or like this one by simply rubbing your thumb off the edge of the screen. If you've dropped your S5 with little to no damage that credit goes to Samsung. I've actually had mine rolled over by a car and only the crushed battery truly suffered, the screen stayed intact and is still a completely functional device with barely a scratch. With that said if looks are your only concern then this is a great case for all you teenage girls out there but if you're an adult with an active lifestyle this ain't the one. Though this case does add a very decent amount of grip to our devices. After all, we purchase these cases to protect our phones bodies and screens right?

Update: I re-read the product description and it clearly states that it won’t match the gold from anything other than the series 3 Apple Watch... mine is the first series. With that in mind, the quality of this band is great for the price. Ordered two of these (one for me, one for a friend) in ivory with a gold buckle. The band is more beige than ivory, which is fine with me, but the buckle and attachment piece that connects to the watch is more like rose gold. It doesn’t match our watches. Very disappointed. Quality seems okay; however, we haven’t worn our new bands because they don’t match our watches...

This is by far the best clip I have found for the Palm Pre if you want to use the touchstone back. The others I bought didn't fit properly with the touchstone back on the pre. I bought this in December and was thrilled. Unfortunately the clip broke today and it is useless. The plastic bridge holding the clip to the holster is only about 6 x 1 mm so it doesn't take much for it to break. I am not sure why this piece is so small since it would seem easy to add a bit more reinforcement here. I am buying another one since I really need this accessory, but I am going to look for a better option before my second one breaks again.

Truthfully I really liked this phone but do to the fact that I live up north where I'm either surrounded by thousands of trees or down in a valley the phone doesn't get reception for me so I had to send it back the nice thing about it was the seller was very understanding and had no problems with me returning the phone I just unfortunately can't rate the phone any higher because I couldn't put it to use. If you live in an area where you would have good reception this phone would most likely work great and it look very nice to. I just wish I could have gotten to use it and keep it.

Description claims that this case would work with a pop socket. It absolutely does not. The ridges on the back prevent anything from properly sticking to it. I ordered a ring style holder for the back and the 3m tape just pulled right off the case with ease. I even tried to super glue it on and the super glue just wiped right off. Was pretty surprised! In the cases favor it does fit well, has a decent feel, and isn't too bulky. Unfortunately I'm throwing it in the trash because I can't use it. If you are looking to attach anything to this case, don't buy it. If you are only looking for a case, it's not bad.

This phone mount is fairly easy to install and when installed does hold firm. The look is nice and the grip all around is great. The feet are the base are a bit small hit do the job. These feet adjust as well which can be helpful for some phones. I had this installed about a week into my air vent and it broke one of the slats in the vent. The hook is what creates a steady hold but I believe was also the culprit to its failure. Maybe the suction option would be better? Either way I sent it back and cannot recommend or will buy again.

Started off great. Bought in March, so 7mths in & now the screen is coming off the phone. It started acting possessed about 3 months ago; backing out of things, turning off, starting apps. It was weird, but manageable. I'm not rough with my phone, it has a case & screen protector. I haven't dropped it or gotten it wet. Lots of space to store things & with a 16g SD card I still have over 2/3 of storage left (I have a lot of songs, movies, apps) other than the phone now falling apart with no reason & no response from Blu it was a good phone. Still think the Blu Energy was the BEST from them

Purchased this case for a vacation we took on 2/26/22….after the return window closed, of course. Case was nice and has a wrist strap. It did allow for flash photos to be taken which was a big plus for me. However, the plastic over the screen scratched easily and even worse…this waterproof case turned out to be not so waterproof! Luckily the phone doesn’t seem to have been damaged, but it need to be removed from the case to dry overnight on two occasions…and of course any pictures taken when water was inside the case did not turn out. I was not taking the case underwater, this was just water from being splashed. Very disappointed. If you’re looking for a truly waterproof case, I’d keep looking.

THE PROS: - The iPhone Xr does fit - There are lots of slots for credit cards / cash / change THE CONS: - The "magic fabric" that keeps the phone in the wallet is velcro. It's a stiff velcro, so it's very secure now, but that makes it hard to remove the phone from the case if I wanted to, and I'm not sure it would stay stiff for very long - The "mirror" in the back is a seriously scratched up piece of shinyish ... I don't even know. Metal? Plastic? - The "long strap" is a piece of ribbon with clips at the bottom. (The wrist strap is made of the same material as the wallet itself.) NEITHER PRO NOR CON: - You do have to remove the phone from the wallet to take a pic. I knew that getting into it, so I can't fault the manufacturer for that. Just want to make sure it's clear here. Overall, I am returning this item because of the velcro. That's not an efficient way to attach the phone to the case, esp if the phone will be removed frequently to take pictures.

For those looking for a bumper that will work with a skin installed on your phone, this one worked for me. I have the armorsuit full body skin and turata 3d glass screen protector installed on my jet black iPhone 7 and this fit perfectly. It adds only a little bulk to the sides of the phone without the rear plate inserted, and overall feels pretty nice. My only real complaints are that the mute switch is hard to reach without using a finger nail and that there are some silver accents around the edges of the bumper and the buttons. Some people may appreciate the subtle silver accents, but I was hoping for an entirely jet black bumper. I can't speak for the durability or protection the bumper will provide as I haven't dropped the phone yet, but it feels quite sturdy and like it would take a small drop pretty well. As others have mentioned, unless you have the clear back inserted, you will have minimal to no camera protection, but that isn't an issue for me. I've experienced no loss in signal, and no loss in Bluetooth connectivity unlike another reviewer, my Apple watch still functions perfectly.

Thin! Perhaps not the product design fault, however, this is thinnest protector I ever tested. One other element is the drag factor. Sliding your finger tip on this thing feels is very unnatural compared with the glass surface previously exposed. This company brings an instalation process that takes a bit to get used to but works, matter of fact, I felt I learned something new by the end of the installation of the second protector. The protector themselves provided an uncomfortable feeling of failure. I installed the first one and ended up with 7 bubbles that resisted my attempts to mitigate them. Discarded, attempted a second one after a throughout cleaning with 90% alcohol to a more positive outcome. In conclusion, I'm not expecting too much from this product but hopefully it will minimize small scratches and normal exposure.

I struggle between okay and don't like. Actually, I love it! The case is perfect except for the durability of the plastic shell. I went through 3 replacements before I finally gave up. The case is low-profile considering it's a flipbook style case. Some reviewers mention they take it in and out less than 10 times before it broke. For me it was the 1st or 2nd time and it was done. You may be wondering why take it out. Well if you own a Nexus 6, which you probably do if you're reading this review, you know how large the phone is. If you have hopes of using this with any sort of phone dock in the car you'll most likely need to take it out of it's case. I don't like that fact but it's a reality. Simple because of how the case folds it makes it difficult to place the phone in the dock with it on. If Poetic fixes this one major flaw with this case I would buy it in a heartbeat and rate it 5 stars (despite the size issue with docks, not Poetic's fault). Poetic makes amazing cases and I've never been disappointed. Pros: - Great feel - Elegant look - Slim (low-profile) - Decent protection Cons: - Weak plastic shell, breaks easy - Can't use it in most car docks

I like the sturdiness of this case and the color - the bright pink is warm, so not too overly Barbie-ish. It is easy to put on and the ports are easily opened and closed. I like that it covers my headphone jack and charging port so they don't get lint/debris in them in my purse. I also like that it protects the volume and power buttons, when seem to be a vulnerability on this phone, and has a raised bezel to protect the screen. Two cons: - The rubber part (gray) gets smudged/dirty easily, and is harder to clean than one would expect. - I think it slightly negatively affects the sound quality with the speakerphone/playing music. Something about the reverberation, perhaps. I imagine that's par for the course for a sturdy, heavy phone case.

This is a neat cellphone holder, the spring holder is awesome. However the connection to the rear view mirror broke on first attempt, as you try to tighten it, it never seems to get firm enough, if you go to far then the top with a metal rod will simply just pop off and then it will not tighten at all. I bought 2, the second I just did not try to tighten as much as the first. But when you drive and make turns the holder and your phone sway with the turn, which I do not like. Price point makes it nice, but functionality on tightening it to your rear view mirror not very good. I would not recommend buying this one.

It really should get 5 stars, it's well made does what it's suppose to do. The issue with wireless charging is it's not fast charging which is built into the Note 4, at this time I don't think it's possible either. Putting a phone in a car mount basically means your going to running a GPS program, I prefer Waze, which uses some power so the phone isn't really charging much if at all...you're just not losing battery charge. Lastly the problem is heat, wireless charging tends to make the phone warm, well in the middle of summer on a car dashboard, wireless charging goes from warm to...too hot to handle, which makes the phone sketchy or is un-responsive. My remedy is to put the defroster on cold just to keep the phone "useable"

I always buy Otterbox cases for my phone, this one has been great at preventing phone replacement over the years and various models I’ve purchased, as a mom with small children my phone is dropped frequently. Funny enough, the product support expired in April ‘22 and now we are in June ‘22 and the case, which has had minor dings in the last 2yrs, did nothing to protect my phone from the last fall. Can’t even do a screen replacement at this point, need an entirely new phone. I just don’t get it bc otterbox cases usually outlast apple shutting phones down for replacement/upgrades.

I ordered this for a T-Mobile LG G4 with a leather back. This thing is entirely too difficult to open because it's not clear HOW to separate the front from the back and the Youtube video is WORTHLESS. Thankfully, my husband figured the thing out because I was ready to trash it. There are no other Youtube videos on how to put the thing on which are actually instructive. It does fit and it's nice to have the color options. My other complaint is that the tabs on the bottom of the rubber that are supposed to cover your ports don't snap in place and flap open. It seems sturdy enough and given that this phone has only been on the market for a month, it's a decent case until something better comes along.If you're interested in looking at other cases, Google LG G4 cases for leather back and see what comes up.

This is an awesome case, exactly what I was looking for...a thin, good looking case that does not take away from the Apple design, that also protects the protruding camera on the iPhone 6. And the Wisp Black color goes well with my Space Gray iPhone, allowing the back of the iPhone to show through the case. The buttons are all easily accessible and not covered like some of the other cases. The only minor issue that I had was that the part around the volume buttons would bubble up after some time. But I contacted Caudabe and they sent me a warranty replacement right away. Wow! And I noticed that the design around the volume buttons has been revised. This is by far the best case I've ever owned for any of my iPhones. As long as Caudabe continues to make these cases for future iPhones, I will keep buying them! Update: After about 8 months of use, my case is starting to lose shape and is loose at the upper right corner.

The rubber part of the case was great, the only issue i had and a major issue at that is the plastic frame the built in screen protector is in. Its really flimsy and broke on opposite corners. The only reason my screen didnt crack was because I had a glass screen protector underneathe but the glass one did crack. Seems like the best thing to do is to add another layer of protection would make the case work perfectly but you would expect the case itself to be able to handle it. Going to try and buy a different case and hopefully not run into the same problem.

Positives- Its a great looking case. I love the feel and texture of it. Best looking case out there in my opinion and also comes with a clear film to protect the screen Negatives- Putting on the film and case at the same time is a very difficult and tedious task. Unless you have your own screen protector, the process may take a while since the film isnt sticky. It also bubbles alot and it took me forever to apply it bubblefree. The case also does not fully close. I put it on properly but there is still space at all four corners. The spaces are pretty small though and not that much of a big deal to me. Have to wait until the first drop to see whether the case hugs it as tight as it does. Overall im happy about how the case looks and feels. The screen protector is garbage and the case could have been made better to fit the phone.

I bought these screen protectors almost a year ago and have gone through all of them. I found that every time my phone dropped my screen hadn’t cracked, which was great, but in very odd instances it would crack. There was one instance where my phone and chapstick were in my purse in the same pocket and when I dropped it on the floor from about the height of 4 inches and when I got to my phone out the screen protector was cracked by the chapstick. Another instance I bumped my phone on a ceramic sculpture lightly and the screen protector also cracked. And it is almost always from a corner where it shatters.

Reader beware: I was supposed to receive SMPL. Fast Wireless Charger, 10W Wireless Charging Pad but instead I received different (upright) charger as shown on the picture. I will still review the charger received but it appears that the review is going against the original product under this description and it’s overall rating. I placed Note 9 to charge at 34% battery left. Phone picked up the power immediately but it was showing 1hr 54min left till fully charged. Usually this phone will charge from 0-100% in about 1hr and 30-40 minutes max so charging time with this wireless charger is much longer. My other phone, iPhoneX would also charge but only with case removed. I don’t have other wireless charger to compare so I can’t tell is it the case or the charger. It looks sleek and futuristic but I would not buy because of the long charging time.

These are great if you don’t plan to “actually use” the phone under water. The case is completely waterproof (which blew my mind), but whenever I tried to press on the camera or anything else, it didn’t work. I was snorkeling off Ocean Reef, and wanted to make a video or at least take photos of what I found under water... But, it appears the plastic phone case is simply too thick. (It works fine until you put it under water)! I even made sure that my phone was very clean before I inserted it into the waterproof case... But, I’m bummed. I still use this case to store the phone while I’m on the boat and in the golf cart (cruising around Ocean Reef). However, I did purchase (from West Marine) a more expensive waterproof phone case that FLOATS! I love that feature!!! I believe it costs $60, but, while under water, I can make videos and take photos with the $60 case that FLOATS — It’s amazing.

"Imprinted and indented button covers are easy to feel and press." The POWER button cutout is NOT aligned with the power button on the phone. "Gorilla Glass Cover Case" - it is NOT responsive to touch screen - you have to press down hard to unlock screen and swipe up and to activate icons. "a raised lip offers screen and camera protection" - screen, yes; camera only slight protection; should have been more. "With one key switch to quiet mode ..." had to find the black button to make this work; a nice touch. DOES NOT WORK WITH FAST CHARGING STAND!!!!! Otherwise, a very strong case. Other reviews say the paint job will wear off and the screws tend to come loose over a short time of use. Time will tell.

I really like this phone, and I hate it. Google seems to really be cutting the corners with its suppliers and there seems to be tons of software issues with Google's own phones. With mine the camera failed after 6 months. There were other issues Google fixed with firmware updates but why are these not perfect in that respect? Google software, Google phone. Should be the most perfect combination available, right? Nope. Reminds me of my Nexus 4 when a firmware update rendered my bluetooth inoperable for 5 months until Google fixed the firmware. Google - stop releasing software updates until you actually check them out and are sure they work with your own phones! Back to the Nexus 5x - love it but it has been at LG for service for over two months. Yes, over two months. The phone is under warranty and is just now a bit past its 1 year release date. Apparently there are limited or no parts at LG to fix the numerous issues these phones appear to have. Many cannot be repaired - check the news. Hey Google and LG - I would really like to have my phone back sometime soon. I'm giving this 3 stars because the phone is great when it works, but two plus months for warranty service is pathetic. Likely will never buy a Google or LG phone ever again as a result. Note to Google - you really should not treat your loyal customers who have spent thousands of dollars on your products this way. We deserve better products, and better operating software.

Makes your phone feel safe from scratches and cracks, but you'll have to learn to live with have little pieces of dust in your screen and edges that are not flush. Followed all the rules, dusted my screen 4 times in a moist room. But as soon as I peel off the first layer of the screen protector to expose the adhesive side... the static electricity pull fuzz from lord knows where onto it. Stuck with some visible fuzz between the screen protector and the iPhone screen. Also no matter how I aligned the screen protector... the edge will never stick. Because of this, a lot of dust collects between the edges of the screen protector and my iPhone case.

So my phone feel not even a foot and landed on the back side, a phone that I hadn't even had for a week mind you, and I just spent 100$ to get a new phone to replace the one that I just got because the otterbox failed to protect it on a one inch padded carpeted area, and it didn't even fall far, but even though the case broke, I am happy to say I could submit a claim on it, but the claim is ridiculous, like why do I have to do all of this work and how am I supposed to submit pictures of it when I don't have a phone now.

Updated Review 1/4/21 If you use Swipe to unlock dont buy this case ... the lip part of the case near charging port has becomes loose and wobbly which now exposes the top part of screen . This part of the phone is mostly used as I swipe to unlock or multi task. I didnt expect this from a UAG product . I am planning to return it . 2 stars because it still fits well . Initial first week Review Its a sleek case which just fits in once the box ans its BIODEGRADABLE so thats a win I think . I agree with other reviews , the volume buttons are bit sturdy to press . The other thing I noticed is that there are small slit opening under the volume cutouts which kinda exposes small part of the frame on side . Not a deal breaker but I didnt expect that small slit. I dig in the feel and hardness of the case tough Overall a good case if you take care of your phone . This is my first UAG product too.

Upon receiving this item, I noticed it was well packaged. I wasn't expecting it for another week, but I got it early which is definitely a plus. The color of this case matches what is pictured pretty perfectly. It is lightweight but there is padding on the front so I imagine it would protect the phone nicely. The reason I gave it four stars instead of five is because there is a small scratch on the top plastic piece where the phone itself is held. Otherwise it would have been a 5 star. I am overall happy with this product. **Update. After using this phone case for several weeks, it has began to fall apart. The corner where the wristlet is attached is tearing and if I used it 24/7 I don't feel confident that the product would hold up. I take care of my things so I know this isn't due to my lack of not taking care of the item. I expected it to gain some wear but not as quickly as it did. I do still like the product and will continue to use, however, if you are looking for a more durable case that you want to last a while, I wouldn't suggest this one. My rating did decrease to a 3 star after using this product.

This case does provide a lot of protection for the Pixel watch, but it covers over one hole on the left side of the watch near the speaker. The speaker is uncovered, but it's not perfectly centered; see attached picture. I had to loosen my watch by one notch after putting this cover on because it felt too tight with the case overhang. I'm not sure if this would interfere with the sensors at all because I just couldn't wear this case on my watch after trying it out for a few hours. The dial on the right side is very hard to move with this case on. You can also see the pressure point dots on the screen cover, which bothered me a little. I really like having something clear for my screen.

With everything going to USB C, these little adapters are becoming a must-have for anyone with an even slightly older computer. These are nice, very solid pieces made of zinc alloy. I really liked the non-slip corrugated design on the sides. They worked well with no issue transferring files off my iPhone. The only problem with these is that, inexplicably, they are apparently NOT USB 3.0! It makes absolutely no sense to design a USB C adapter in order to keep up with modern technology, and then omit this significant performance feature. I conducted some test transfers comparing these to a USB 3.0 adapter, and the latter was indeed faster. While these worked just fine, my recommendation is to skip this product and go all the way with one of the many similarly-priced adapters that support USB 3.0.

The Defender is a pain to "install" and causes my screen protector to lift up around the edges. If I didn't use a screen protector I might have given this 4 stars. To my mind, though, it's nigh on impossible to use it with a plastic screen protector. I also found the the inner hard plastic holder to be too hard. I was concerned it could actually scratch the phone during the installation. Then there is the bulkiness. Unlike the OtterBox Symmetry (my favorite OtterBox), the Defender bulks up the phone too much for my taste. I am not sure that extra bulk translates into extra protection, either.

Ok, I tried giving this case a chance. It is supposedly waterproof however my dogs hair is still able to get in under the screen protector. Case is sealed tight from what I can tell and when I ran the water test, it didn't appear to leak, but hair can get in when the phone is in so I'm glad I didn't test the water test with the phone in. The fingerprint scanner sucks! I guess because the case isn't a truly tight fit the sticker comes loose and stops working. Push it down and it sometimes starts working but the dot lasted maybe a few weeks before it wouldn't work at all... and of course that's how I log into most apps, fingerprint. I haven't contacted the manufacturer yet, but I'm wondering if it's even worth it. I think the case protected the phone for the most part, dropped it a couple times without any damage but really disappointed with the dirt and hair it let's in and the fingerprint scanner most of all...

This has been a pretty good case for the last 6 months. I've been gentle with opening and closing the card slot because the hinge didn't seem very strong. I drop my phone from about 4 feet multiple times a day due to bad hands and it has kept my phone safe so far. The case broke at the card slot, hinge side. No damage to my phone when it fell and broke the case. Overall good wallet case, only fits two cards and card slot broke from dropping (a lot) but that's not really a fault of the case. I do have to buy a new case after 6 months of using this one, so if you consistently drop your phone consider a different option.

This item does a good job of protecting the screen, and does seem to show fewer fingerprints. However, it is no better than the ten dollar job I had on my last phone. We bought two of them for our new iPhone 13’s. The guides in the installation kit for my mini must of been for a different phone entirely. As a result it ends up being a free hand install anyway…just like a cheaper one. Additionally, the protector had a hard to see imperfection in the glass which, of course, grew a little “ring “ around it when mounted. It’s only been on the phone for a month but is already showing crazing around the edges even though it hasn’t been dropped. All in all it’s just not worth the premium price

This screen protector was easy to install on my S22 Ultra. I lined it up perfectly with the front facing camera but noticed that the protector didn't extend all the way over the cuved edges of the screen. Didn't think much of it at the time. After a month I noticed that the hole for the front camera was a little offset from the camera. After a few more weeks the protector had shifted over the front camera so that it blurred the camera's vision. Took off the protector and replaced it with second one from the box. I was super careful to line up the hole with the camera, but here I am about four weeks later and I can tell this protector is shifting too. It's a shame because it's otherwise a great protector against scratches and fingerprints.

If you like using your finger print reader, you may want to consider looking around some more before purchasing. I've bought this exact screen protector but from a different source previously. I got a 5 pack and of that only the last 2 were fingerprint reader compatible... Unfortunately, I dropped my phone in sand and the protector got badly cracked. So I needed a replacement. This product did include both phone screen and camera protectors. And although these protect my phone screen and camera really well, I lost usability of the fingerprint reader... I even tried turning up my touch sensitivity and rescanning my fingers.

I went "APE-S*T" trying to install and get the bubbles out from under the cover. After installation, I found the "touch" sensitivity to operate the iPod screen definitley less if not totally disfunctional. If I get alarmed about screen scratches and the like later, I might try it again later. For right now, the two unused screen protectors are going back in the box for a while. The first one went into the trash. FOLLOW UP - Based on follow up dialog with Tech Armor Support, detailed instructions were provided on how to correctly install the covers. In addition, I received not one but two free-of-charge replacements for the ordered item. I have increased their product rating to 3-Stars; I would rate the company and their customer service with 5+ Stars.

I have had many Supcase for at least 4 phones. They are very durable and protect your phone very well. I was a little disappointed when I got the case and set it on the kickstand for easy viewing to find it very unstable and wobbly. I had just come from the Note 10 case which had a rock solid kickstand. This kickstand seems to have a rounded bottom. I love everything about the case sans the kickstand. Of course if you view your phone in soley a horizontal position it is more stable but if you try to stand it in portrait then any mild bump or disruption, like holding your workstation and adjusting your seat, you will most likely be picking your phone back up from a tumble. Or you will find another way to stand it up w/o using the Supcase kickstand at all.

Using on iPhone 6. Good, clear sound quality for both me & the other party -- much better than past headsets I've used on prior phones. Fits comfortably on either ear -- multiple pivot points to accommodate different positions. Included charger has a magnetic attach point -- easy to attach, but also easy to knock it off the charger. The battery life seems too quick, though. The voice prompt says "talk time 7 hours" after a full charge. Then, after a call or two amounting to maybe 10 minutes, it's "talk time 6 hours". Next time it's "talk time 3 hours", etc., until it says "battery low - charge headset" after maybe 45 minutes of talking. Unless I'm charging it wrong, this is not acceptable.

So.. this is not what I was expecting.. the print on the case is so blurry like the photo was stretched too much to fit. The gold isn't vibrant AT ALL the photos in the listing are 100% misleading. I spent days looking for a phone case before I chose this one and I'm quite disappointed with it. The only reason I gave it 3 stars is because it is definitely a snug fit - protective case, no issues there. The print quality is just very bad. I honestly keep looking at it and I'm thinking i might return it.

Review for Galaxy S20 5G. Easy to install and does work well with the Spigen Rugged Armor case. Does not have full adhesive. Only around edges and finger print reader and front facing camera. This leaves a weird circle around the finger print scanner (that you can't use) that's pretty visable anytime the screen has light colors on it. I found it quit annoying. Glass screen protectors used to be so much better when they had full adhesive. After install, I could not use my finger print reader. I made sure that the reader area was completely adhered to the screen, I deleted by existing fingerprints and could not get it to read any new fingerprints. When it recognize I was touching the reader, it kept telling me to press harder, but regardless of how hard I was pushing, it wound not recognize a finger print scan. I ended up removing it shortly after I installed it. I guess I'll take my chances.

Super stylish but it does add quite a bit of weight to the phone. I guess thats due to the padding used under the plastic exoskeleton. This case has three components, the soft endoskeleton, the backing and face. The endoskeloton is a very soft and flexable, rubber material that fits around your phone like a sock. I found I had to fiddle with it a bit to make sure the sock was on completely as to eliminate gapping when I placed the hard plastic exoskelton on. There was still some gapping around the volume buttons but not much. Once you get the exoskelton on you will need something to help you get it off again. There are groves designed into the case on the power button side to allow it to be opened. I used the blunt guard of a box cutter while the blade was retracted of course. The stand is pretty sturdy which props the phone up horizontally but it will not stand up vertically. I noticed the colors on the argyle bled onto the white a little but didn't rub off on my hands. Not sure what the little gold android was for but when I tried to place it on the phone he lost an arm. He didn't make it. :( Overall, decent for the price. I'd buy again.

This product was purchased for the iphone 7 plus and use with Spigen Tough Armor and Slim Armor. Bought three product and notice quality declined with each. The initial purchase was great so decided to buy additional for other family phone. However, ran into the following issues: 1) All packaging after the initial purchase had no wet wipe in the packaging. The instruction indicate there is a wet wipe to do initial clean of phone screen and a dry to dry screen. However, both wipes were dry. 2) After initial purchase both product cracked easily even though there were no drops. One instance there was a sharp crack around the rim of the home button so it was not safe to leave on for use. In an attempt to remove the screen protector the failure point caused the whole screen protector to crack. 3) Does not feel like its one whole tempered glass piece. Positive point: 1) It was perfect cut and fitted perfected with the cases. Initial purchase and one other is still usable. 2) Looks like the main screen protector would protect phone.

Kinda disappointed that the case is so thick, it makes the fingerprint scanner impossible to use. The opening should have been made a lot larger to access. My picture's are not as clear as they used to be before I changed to this particular wallet style (I've been using the wallet type for years). Not easy to hold either, as soon as you put your ID and a couple of CC's it barely snaps closed. The wraparound strap /clasp should definitely be wider to be more secure. I do like the wrist strap. Can't use with a wireless charger anymore. It is a nice smooth surface and color.

I didn't realize I picked a two piece case. But it arrived in 2 days. And I suppose the 2 piece system helps insulate for falls. Once I finally figured out how to remove the insert and apply both pieces it's what I expected as far as a case. Not Slim. It definitely adds a little bit of bulk to my device. The edges come up from the phone front. Unless I dropped on an object like a rock dead center it should fall on a flat surface and be okay. The backside camera cutout is almost flush it appears. Anyhow, it's what I expected for the most part. A nice cheap clear case that will protect my device and show off it's color/design. Maybe one issue might be if you have uh fat fingers. Trying to remove the stylus might be an issue? I used my index finger without much issue. But then again even without a case I felt like I had a hard time trying to grab and remove the stylus.

Bought this a few months ago and the stand broke. I bought a few other models in the past and the same thing happened. The paint started chipping off on my other case. I really want to give a higher rating, b/c i like how the case holds up for my phone. I wish the stand was somewhere in the middle so i had an option to keep it up on either side.. its annoying when you have to keep it only to one side. And everytime you want to adjust the volume you have to pick up the phone again.

I ordered these screen protectors for a friend's Motorola E5 Play smartphone but experienced a couple of problems. The installation was a little more difficult because the pull tab for the protective back sheet was on the bottom rather than the top of the phone, which made using the adhesive "hinges" somewhat trickier. A more significant problem was that the screen protector seemed too wide for the phone screen and overlapped the slightly raised edge, making it impossible to completely remove the air bubbles on both sides of the screen. The screen protectors I have seen on other phones are typically leave a 1 mm space all around to ensure that they are well within the flat part of the front screen.

The case looks exactly like the picture! However, after a month or two of usage, the rubber lining started to come off, and some threads are coming loose on the bottom. Otherwise, it is a really pretty case that does everything described. *6 MONTH UPDATE* After 6 months of usage, the rubber lining inside the case has completely fallen off, providing no support for the phone. I dropped my phone with the front open and cracked my screen protector. Also, I have noticed that the wide angle will catch a smidge of the screen protector. Although it is very hard to notice, it is there. Overall I would still recommend this phone case just for the price and everything else.

Just so people know I got the Gold Slim Armor w/ kickstand and I have a Black S6 It's good for protection... but terrible for feel and meh for looks. I loved this case a lot for when I first got it because anything was better than a naked phone.... but it wasnt enough for me. I LOVED the feel of metal and glass for the 3 days I had it naked, and I dropped it once and already had 2 small nicks in the metal, and the glass is really slippery and I'm afraid of dropping this thing a lot. The feel is terrible though, it reminds me of holding a galaxy s3. I feel no rubber and feel plastic 24/7 and it's not textured or anything so it's pretty bland. The buttons are really easy to miss, as they are perfectly flat and dont poke out. I had the same case on my Galaxy S5 (spigen gold slim amor) and I was more impressed, it had a bumpy back so it reminded me of the naked S5 and that was great. The S5 case also had the buttons poking out and in a cool sort of rhombus shape. The S6 one does not. I'm not gonna go crazy on this but is annoying that you don't have a chose with the kickstand, because I don't use it often & it doesn't look too attractive either. My friend just got a gold S6 and bought a black leather & gold trim case from caseology and I instantly fell in love with the looks AND feel. I will probably be heading to the carbon fiber black & gold trim case from Caseology and sell my Spigen case. Disappointed with this one, I loved the one I had on my S5.

I ordered the black 4 style 38mm & it's a really sharp, dressy band for the price, which is what I was looking for. The tool is incredibly easy to use for removing links; I had to remove 4 or 5 links and it still looks nice. My only concern is that it appears the band may be stuck in the band slots. I tried to slide the band back out, but it doesn't seem to move. I'll have to power it off & try again so I don't continue to press buttons & apps as I try to finagle it. I really do like the band & it's comfortable while working out as well.

Both my husband and I had a hard time figuring out how to open the case to put phone inside. It might be helpful for you to know this case comes in 3 pieces, not just two. There is a video online that talks about the pros and cons of this case and they show the case being opened. Through that video I was finally able to open the case. With my phone finally in its new case I can honestly say I’m happy with this product! I wish I had more helpful tips on how to open these. Just remember there are 3 pieces. A back, than a back and front that you’ll pull apart.

Seems impossible to find something to hold my phone in my car. Thought this product looked perfect, but it was lacking in design and usability. The dash of most cars these days, or every car I have had, is slightly textured, so it is difficult finding anything that will stick securely to the dash. Peeled the plastic from the back of the product and paced it on my dash. Pressed firmly, but it still came off very easily, so not sure I would trust it to hold my phone securely. Still testing it but the first time it loosens and my phone falls, it will have to go in the garbage.

Trident don't make these quality cases like they used to. I went to their website for cases for a newer phone and what I saw is junk, junk, and more junk. If I'm not wrong and please correct me if I do, why do all their best cases have a built-in screen protector. I don't want some silly built-in screen protector. I just want a good quality hybrid case. So when I buy a new case for my new phone I have to wrestle with a built-in screen protector? I want my screen protector whatever it is tempered glass for PET film separate. That is what the real knock on Trident cases are. That is so ill-advised by Trident to have almost all their hybrid cases have built-in screen protectors. As for this particular case for the old Motorola Atrix-2, that was the Trident I used to know which is making good quality cases. They need to come back to that same design. Not the garbage they have now.

I'm usually skeptical of dashboard mounts that employ some version of a suction cup. But this sucker (pun intended) REALLY sticks and, as advertised, has a high chance of sticking onto non-smooth surfaces! The only caveat is if the surface that the suction cup covers isn't fairly level, the suction cup won't stick. That's to be expected. It doesn't need to be COMPLETELY level, just fairly so. I'm noticing that, with these dashboard mounts, that it's generally safer and better to mount down towards anywhere from the center to the right of your field of vision, as the driver. I tried mounting it on the left side of my driving position (close to my left side-view mirror), which at first-hand seems like a very convenient spot, but I realized how dangerous it was as my eyeballs darted left and downward quite often. UPDATE: After 2 weeks of leaving the mount "permanently" on my dash, the whole kit and kaboodle-- mount, phone, charging cable-- came FLYING OFF last night as I was executing a normal left turn in my 2010 Prius. The base had left a grease spot residue on my dash (which I'm not too worried about), but this kills my dreams of calling this a keeper. I was hoping I could find a mount that I could set and not-worry-about-flying-objects-in-the-car. This was supposed to be the holy grail of suction cup mounts for me. I'm going to try out the Mountek nGroove Snap next. I'd love to try exchanging it for a replacement, but Amazon won't allow me. I initially purchased this grip at a discount, so repurchasing would cost more.

Read closely and do not think this is a GOOGLE product, only a google inspired product. Their play on words inspired me to write an inspired 5 star review, but since mine is only inspired and not an actual 5 star review, they get a generous 3 stars. I bought this for my iPhone 6s Plus, expecting it to fit per the description. If by "fit" they mean both ends of my phone extend a bit outside each side, then yes, this is made for the iPhone 6 plus. Must be the meant they were inspired to fit larger phones. I see double images in every app but one so I really do not believe this is the right VR viewer for larger phones.

Ok, First things first. This thing feels great, it feels like a solid piece of engineering. The problem is, is that it immediately failed on me. I tried to charge the with the thing, fully charged I believe, or at least near it. And after about a min of charging my note 4, it just stopped, the lights on top never turned back on when a cable was connected to the usb ports, and it never charged my phone again. The only time it seemed to work at all, was when I was charging it. When it was plugged in to be charged, it would give me the proper animation, but I let it charge all night and it still didn't work. So I sent it back and got a refund. Bottom line, the thing feels great, but its not.

i already have an incipio case, and was looking for a wallet case when i found this and it seemed perfect. when it first arrived, everything was fine, same great quality as my regular incipio case. i put my popsocket onto this case, right in the middle of the door, having read reviews from others who said they'd done the same. by holding and using the popsocket, it was emphasized that only one corner of the door physically pops latched and closed with a clicking sound, the other does not, and it is obvious to tell by looking at the door that one side closes differently than the other. i had wanted a wallet case because i needed someway to keep my ID and debit/credit card on me at concerts, thinking id never lose them because my phone is basically glued to my hand (lol) and i'd lost my wallet before, so i thought a wallet case is the perfect way to go. but i had just went to a concert recently, and in the crowd, the door of my case opened up while i was taking photos and my card fell out! thankfully the venue is returning the card to me, but way too stressful to think about! im also frustrated because this happened just days after the 30 day return window, so i cant figure out a way to return this; i wish i could, because i cant afford to use this case again and lose anything else important. NOPE

The stylus that cane with my Note snapped in half and I purchased this to replace it. The stylus seems very flimsy compared to the original. It fits perfect in the phone which was a positive. However, the tip has a bump in it which makes using difficult. It came with replacements but they were all the same. "Samsung" Is on the top part of the stylus but as already faded which leads me to believe this was a knock off. If you are tight on money and need a stylus this will work, but otherwise i would reccomend ordering from the factory for a few more bucks!

This screen gets the job done. I have done many iPhone repairs ... this is my first Sony Xperia z1s. It took some work as these phones are held together with adhesive as opposed to screws. I did receive some tools with this screen, but they were not the exact same ones pictured. Not really an issue as I have my own phone repair tools. For someone looking to do this repair, you should note that you will also need some adhesive and a heat gun. I would also recommend an Isesamo tool. You can find both here on Amazon. You will also need a very good video to do the breakdown and reassembly. I had found one on YouTube, but there was a step missing and I neglected to reconnect the digitizer cable. It took a few minutes to figure that part out. Otherwise there would be no touch capability to the screen. This is not the easiest repair for someone who is not patient nor handy with small tools. Otherwise, the screen itself works fine, fits fine and does what it says.

Good Cover and totally shockproof, However incompatible with Tempered Glass Screen Protectors I had purchased and installed the Dmax Armor Screen Protector, [Tempered Glass] on my phone, which worked great BTW. When I put my phone into this case the sides and top/bottom squeezed the glass hard enough so that the screen protector was bubbling up and had to be removed. Therefore it is a choice of a case like this or a screen protector; a very difficult choice. The BLUE CASE IS A RIP OFF IF YOU ARE LOOKING FOR A STYLUS IT DOES NOT HAVE ONE IN SPITE OF THE TITLE. (Galaxy J7 Prime / Galaxy On7 Case, Dual Layers [Combo Holster] Case And Built-In Kickstand Bundled with Hybird Shockproof And Circlemalls Stylus Pen (Blue)) I really like the idea of the screen protector and it installed easily and did a great job. So here I am faced with the choice of one or the other. right now I am looking for a case that will allow me to also use a great screen protector like I had.

Bought this so my gf would play using xCloud for iOS and I have to say, I'm a little disappointed. Everytime we adjust the clip to fit the controller, it feels like it's about to snap and break. Taking the clip off the controller is hard too because again, it doesn't seem durable enough. Holds phone decently enough but I expected more. We use a Xbox One S controller and she has an iPhone 7. Hopefully this doesn't break soon or else I'm going to have to go elsewhere for a gaming clip. The pro is she says the grips feel great.
