Long story short I lost 2 covers because they don’t stay with a lot of movement or if something snags on the side of your watch face it will snatch it off. If you are an active person I would not recommend.

It seems to be strong in voice quality. It seems to be good with connectivity...but within a MUCH shorter range than other Blue Tooth devices I’ve owned. It’s battery is so-so. I say it “seems” so only because no matter which of the 3 ear adapters it provides. I can never get a solid “seating” in my ear. And the closest one I tried, has caused the most painful abrasions on my outer ear...to the point of bleeding! There is no comfortable gel earpiece...which my previous brands had. It’s more of a torture device, if you wonder about comfort!! I will never buy this again! The sound quality is excellent....as long as I constantly press my finger on it, to force a better connection to my ear canal. What a PAIN!! Not worth the hassle!! Funny! I lost my previous 2 different-brand Blue Tooth earpieces...which I still lament. But when I had thought I had lost THIS one, I rejoiced...because it meant I had reason to replace it with something better!! Unfortunately, I found it, the next day. So I’m stuck with this torture device, for now...until I can successfully lose it!! Ha-Hah!! NEVER AGAIN!!!

I bought this cable because I couldn't find the one for my iPod for the life of me and it was cheap. I got it and it looked perfectly fine. I plugged the cable into my iPod, into my computer and it charged it just fine. The problem came when I attempted to unplug it. I grabbed it like a normal iPod plug pulled and it basically fell apart. It did not break... it still works but you have to snap it back together constantly to keep it in one piece. Does what it needs to do for the price, but quality is definitely lacking. If you have the money just go and buy one that you know will hold up.

I really like the color and i like the feeling of the material but I have a few problems with it. For one it gets dirty easily, when i have it in my pocket all the lint and the loose fibers from the fabric of my clothing stick to it and it’s not hard to clean but it is annoying. Also before I bought it I was checking the customer questions to see if my popsocket would be able to stick to the material (i’ve had problems with other cases in the past where it doesn’t stick) and all the comments said that it would stick, but then when I got it, it didn’t stay stuck, it would stick until i would touch it and it would come off so that was disappointing

This is a good tool with some nice features but lacks practicality where it matters the most: suction power. Doesn’t stay holding on my dashboard for more than a few days. I have switched to windshield but then it’s too far away. Also the limit on lateral movement makes it very inconvenient to work with in finding the optimal position. It does have some great features not found in other similar items. It continues to work to free up the phone after power is turned off (as in car ignition turned off). Other holders will just keep the phone stuck and you’ll have to turn the power back on, but this was very thoughtful feature in this very holder. Secondly the buttons to free up the phone are very ergonomically placed on both sides, with good sensitivity for quick release. Those are better than motion sensors in other holders in my experience. Good product but needs improvements. I might return mine after trying a bit more to get the angle/position right, if that doesn’t work.

I bought this case thinking that having grip in the title would mean this case has a bit of grip to it. Sadly the case is far slippier than the phone itself is. The raised edges are nice because they protect the acreen when facedown, but the case is quite slick, it slides right out of my pocket and even feels slick in the hand. The screen protector is nice though. Perhaps the black one is gripper, I got clear thinking it would show less. Already the clear had many small scratches, so maybe I'll switch to a new more rubberized case.

This case is better than most but not perfect. I've tried a couple different cases like this. I'd rather pay this price for something imperfect then go to the apple store and pay something outrageous for the same thing. My phone has been fine in this case. It hasn't slipped out like others say. I like that it has a hole in the back so you can use the camera. I use headphones most of the time so its not inconvenient for me to talk but if you don't this case is bulky and can be a pain. I like that its a magnet feature to keep the case close. This case is functional and looks good. It's not prefect but I don't think you'll be able to find perfect in this world. I you do let me know, I'm still looking.

I don't know if I received a defective item or not, but placing it in several different locations, on each smart box channel, and I only received a max total of 8 channels. When I had a 1byone 50 mile flat screen one I received 40 channels. I'm not sure what else I can do with this one. I will have to return it. Again, don't know if mine is defective, or if the 50 mile ones just work better, but the only reason I purchased a 60 mile one was because I thought it would pick up more channels then the 50 mile. Two stars for me cause I have had luck with this company in the past with a previous indoor antenna.

I love the full-size version and didn’t hesitate to buy the mini version for a bit more room on my dashboard. Unfortunately, the mini’s don’t have the weight to keep the phone upright in certain traffic conditions. If you have to stop quickly, the phone tips over and you are left chasing your phone across your dashboard or searching for it on the floorboards. One particularly heavy traffic day, my phone flipped out of this stand three different times, sliding across my dash, hitting my windshield wipers each time (turning them on) as it slid to the floor. I now have the mini stand cradled inside my full-sized one for stability.

Wouldn't you know it... as soon as I get the case on, my phone falls down 4-5 (carpeted) stairs rather violently. I pick it up with just one eye open, and am relieved to find that it's perfectly fine. I'm giving it 4 out of 5 stars for one reason. The buttons are awkward to press. They are protected under the black rubberized layer of the case which does not protrude enough outward over the colored layer. Still, to me, it's not that big of a deal. The annoying part is trying to get to the silent switch. Since I have very small hands, I can get it to with minimal effort but my cousin with only slightly larger hands has decided not to buy this product for that reason.

I purchased this dock because I had something similar in my previous car, but when I bought a new car that has vertical vents it wouldn't attach properly. I thought that this product would work where the other failed based on the pictures that showed two adjustments... The first is that the "clip" portion can rotate to vertical or horizontal so that in the vertical position it will clip to the vertical vent. This works fine. Unfortunately the second feature shown in the pictures was not included on the product I received. The second feature was that the stabilizer "feet" could adjust inward. See, on a horizontal vent the clip can adjust up and down so that the feet can rest on something sturdy because the vent itself will allow for the up/down adjustment. On most vertical vents, the vents slats only move left and right. Therefore the lower feet need to be able to adjust inward; otherwise, they are just left hanging out in the air with nothing to rest on. The picture showed that this product had that adjustment, but the product I received just had the static, non-adjustable feet like my old mount. If the product I received had been as pictured, it probably would have got 4 or 5 starts, but since it didn't have the ability to work on my vertical vents I had to send it back.

The case was ordered on a Thursday evening and the anticipated delivery was the following Wednesday via the USPS. The case was delivered on Monday, two days early and was in fine shape. In one way the case was better than I had anticipated. Because there were no photos on Amazon of the interior of the case I had expected the phone would be secured in the case by four corner elastic straps. However, the phone is actually secured within the case by a nicley fitting full-form plastic holder. My only concern, and hence the 4-star rating, is that I am not sure what the longevity of the material will be, especially the magnetic flap. For the money I paid I was not expecting much, but the "leather" closure strap looks like it will soon begin to tear in the folds - especially if it gets get wet. We'll see. But like I said - so far, so good. Note that I have the AT&T version of the Samsung Galaxy S2 (I777) for which very few cases are available. As I said, this case fits fine and all the openings for the side buttons line up correctly. UPDATE: Well, I'm on my third case. The plastic holder in case 1 started to disintegrate after about two months. I blamed this on the fact that I took the phone in and out of the case frequently. So, I ordered 2. After about two months on 2 it was getting dirty so I ordered 3. However, as soon as I placed the order for 3, the plastic holder on 2 started to disintegrate as well, and I hardly ever removed the phone from case 2. So, I'm now on 3 and expecting this one to disintegrate after two months as well.

This is well made, comes with a nice tool to remove links and looks pretty durable. BUT unlike most Z-fold watch bands, this has no minor adjustment by moving where the band joins the Z-fold. This means you can only adjust by the width of a link, and in my case, and many people's I suspect, that means either too loose (for sensors to read), or uncomfortably tight. This renders it's pretty much useless for my Garmin as the sensors are not able to be comfortably snug against my wrist. So everything read with the LEDs is off, or missing. For a 'dumb' watch - nice band. Great shame.

I know pre-owned looks like a better deal, but they're using that classification to cover a multitude of defects. I've done this twice. The first pre-owned case I received, the volume buttons were missing. That one I sent back as I couldn't use the case at all. The second time I tried to order pre-owned, the listing said that the case has "superficial markings." This otherwise nice looking case looks like someone dropped it on an asphalt street or a gravel driveway a couple of times before sending it back and it has several deep scratches and gouges in it. I'm keeping it, because I guess in some places that counts as "superficial" but I'm not happy with it and probably won't use it unless I have to. The cases themselvesare all right, I guess - the cutouts are where they are supposed to be, and when the buttons are there, they work fine. The build quality is good, but not good enough to justify such a high price tag for a new case. In waiting to get this and the previous Casemate case, I ran out and got a generic $13 case at Walmart, and it's been as good or better build and protect quality than these Casemate cases. I probably should have gone this route to begin with rather than ordering a case sight unseen and trusting a seller when they classify an item they're trying to get rid of as Used - Very Good.

I was looking for a clear case (to show off my yellow iPhone!) and this one was a great price. It fits on my phone well, seems protective and durable. I loved the look of it on day 1! Unfortunately, if you’re someone who uses your phone with ANY regularity (and let’s face it, that’s all of us...), this is probably not a great option. By day 2 of using this case, the white was not-so-white anymore. By day 7, it was more gray than white. The white exterior gets dirty and stained SO easily, and the stains kinda “soak” into the silicone material, meaning they don’t come out. The case looks pretty gross after 1 week, so I’ve already gotta search for another.

I have the new iPhone 6s Plus. I would have given these glass screen protector 5 stars if it weren't for these couple of bad cons. Pros: Looks really nice. It is a crystal clear screen. Touch screen is still very responsive. The coating on the screen is great and doesn't leave finger prints really. And if your fingers are a little greasy and do leave prints it all wipes away easily. Also the application is SUPER easy. The little wings they have on it to use to apply it work great. Make sure to follow the directions and watch the video. Cons: The edges are not rounded like in the pictures and feel a bit sharp. It isn't quite sharp enough to cut, but when you use 3D Touch on the side of the screen ( right on the edge of the screen protector) it can sometimes hurt. Plus on a different issue the screen is just a hair smaller than the touch screen portion of the front. It isn't a huge deal but just looks a little funny. And begs the question, is it just defective or they didn't get the correct measurements. ( seeing the other reviews it seems like I am not the only one like this. ) Hope this helps everyone decide if this is the product for you.

Bought directly from RhinoShield b/c they don't have the back protector listed on Amazon. I'm a big fan of RhinoShield. I've had both their Crashguard and screen protector on my Nexus 6P for a few years now and it has held up to LOTS of abuse. Which is why I'm really disappointed this has happened. I wouldn't even take the phone out of the box until I received the case and then it cracks my new (albeit last gen) phone right off the bat. I'm really hoping it doesn't get any worse. I'm going to contact RhinoShield to see if maybe they'll at least give me a free screen protector or something. Cracked screen aside I don't like this one as much as the one for my Nexus. It seems harder and smoother than the previous one which makes it hard to grip. I'm sure this is all due to the curved screen design so I can't fault them too much but still I am disappointed. It was extremely hard to get on and I don't think I'll be able to get it off without doing further damage to the screen.

I like the product, but the second set that I bought came used. When I first opened it was taped with masking tape, but it looked like both screen protectors were in there. So I figured someone held it up to their phone and returned it after realizing that it wouldn't fit. The first protector worked fine, but when I went to put on the 2nd protector today, I discovered that the backing was removed and the protector was stuck to the foam sleeve. Unfortunately it is too late now to get a return or replacement. I will go with a different brand or seller in the future.

Have used a screen protector on my phone for years along with a case. I have a two year old who is very hard on my iPhone and my screen protector has always worked to protect my phone. My previous screen protector was bought from a different company and worked great for over a year despite the protector itself cracking many times, my phone never did. I put this new one on and dropped my phone once and all the edges on the screen protector cracked and worst of all my phone cracked all the way across the screen. It is still usable. I put a new screen protector on and the crack is not overly obvious, but I am disappointed in the effectiveness of this product compared to my previous one.

I purchased this in “frustration free” packaging and was able to get it supposedly brand new from amazon for $27 and change. I feel like even for $27 it’s over-priced plastic and all you’re really paying for is the Otterbox brand name. I also feel like I was not sent a brand new item. It came in a double plastic bag (which is possibly the “frustration free” aspect) and had product papers inside but there were smudges all over the clear plastic parts and several hairline scratches that I feel wouldn’t and shouldn’t be there in a brand new product. Pretty disappointed in Otterbox for this. I previously had a Supcase Unicorn Beetle case for my iPhone 7 Plus for roughly $12 and I feel it was just as good quality. Had it for about a year, no problems with it. Only reason I got this one now was because it has raised power/volume buttons which I came to dislike about the previously mentioned case which did not have the raised buttons.

I thought this would be the one!! I've searched high and low for a phone holder for my truck that will charge my phone without all the messy cords. While it looks nice, the brackets that hold the phone are right in my way when I get a phone call and need to push my home button......it will NOT charge my phone with ANY case on it (and who wants to have to remove their case from their $500-$1000 phone EVERYTIME they get in their vehicle in order for this thing to work???)......and last but not least......the vent holder almost broke my vent. =/ I guess I'll have to keep looking.......

I've only had this phone a week and truly I do know know how the screen protector could have cracked already, no drops, no scratches on the screen. The problem is that the screen protector is thick, and has a very high noticable edge, so I think just have anything graze against that edge is enough to the break it. The installation process was OKAY, easy but problematic. I did get bubbling between where the two drops of glue are placed in that step, because the two glue spots never met during the screen drop step. The bubbles became less noticable, but more started to appear later. The screen protector also does not cover the screen. This phone has a curved screen, and this screen protector covers like a fourth of the curve, which is awkward because the touch screen wraps into to curve, so you constantly are touching the edge of the screen protector when using those edges. The best aspect of this protector is the texture, it's very silky, lovely to touch and use the phone through, but the fact that it's already chipped after one week is discomforting to say the least.

Nice enough case, but I had a few major problems with it making it a case I’ll rarely use. 1. The case is extremely slippery. If the surface you put it down on isn’t exactly flat, it will slide. 2. No raised lip on the front. For a case that’s back has a design you want to show off, you’re going to want to put the phone down on its face. With no raised lip, be prepared to potentially damage your screen. In just one day of use my screen protector had scratches on it when it had none the day before. 3. Somewhat related to 2, the glow in the dark design isn’t that bright. Could just have been because it didn’t get enough light exposure during the day, but it wasn’t very bright even in a completely dark room.

I've seen better...they are just okay screen protectors. They are very thin so be careful. I flexed my extra one just to see how much strength that they have...I'm not really impressed. Initially I was convinced that they weren't even really glass until it shattered when I flexed it. They apply like any other screen protector but for some reason they don't adhere to the phone very well. Both surfaces (phone and screen protector) were spotless when I applied them but there are bubbles that just don't go away. You can push them out but they come right back within seconds. Keep looking...

My daughter (17) fell in love with the pirate ship version of this case. It fit her iPhone 14 nicely but personally I would prefer a case that came up "higher" on the edges to protect the phone screen when dropped. The blue liquid moves nicely, but the pirate ship was stuck upside down when it showed up in the mail. Much tapping and warm water over the stuck area allowed her to inch it around a little, but it has yet to "float free" We got it upright in the middle of the case but there it sits while the water moves around it. She will have to correct it every so often. So cute, but disappointing since the floating image is the "hook" for getting this case. Good enough I guess

This case is very sturdy and feels like it would offer excellent drop protection your phone. It's a little on the thicker side but that is to be expected and goes hand-in-hand with excellent protection. I really like the dust plug for the charging port, as well. Unfortunately, the plug does not enter into the charging port, it only blocks it superficially, so you would likely still get a minor amount of dust build-up from the speaker and microphone openings located on either side of the dust plug. This case isn't the easiest to install but that's nothing new with this type of case. It's dual-layered and three pieces. The inner hard shell is two pieces that snap together around the phone, followed by the soft outer layer that stretches around the hard case. My only gripe about this case is that the power button is very difficult to push through this case. I'm not sure if it is because it is located directly next to a snapping point on the hard shell or if it is because the buttons are very deep into the phone case & maybe the rubber buttons on the soft case were not made correctly. I'm more inclined to believe the first option, as the volume buttons work quite easily; it is just the power button that is difficult. I should add that I am not some elderly or frail person. I am in my early thirties and work with my hands. In the end, at around $11, this case is a value for the money, as long as you can get by with the power button difficulty.

Really like this product, works great, fits my AC vent nicely. Had one for about a year until it broke, it broke where the clip holds onto the vent, one of the teeth bent and snapped off making it incapable of grabbing onto the vent, so i ordered another one a week ago, was very excited to be using this product again and then within 4 days the same clip broke and i might as well of thrown 20 dollars out of the window, it truly is a great product when it works, but very frustrating that i just wasted 20 dollars. don't know if I will take the risk again and buy another one.

I have used Snake Hive wallet cases exclusively for years. They’re beautifully made, a great design, and I like the ethics of the company. I am so disappointed in the 13 version. It’s great in every way, except the cut-out corner does not protect the camera adequately. Like many available now (and unlike past models of the Snake Hive cases) it is open in that one corner and the silicone case that enwraps the phone doesn’t stick up high enough on the upper right corner to protect the lenses of the camera on the 13. I ultimately ordered another beautiful leather case by Bluebonnet Austin (not pictured here) that is also ethically made by a small US company and protects my phone camera much better (albeit at twice the price) than the Snake Hive. Please change the design for the 13!

When I first purchased the phone case it seemed to work great. It was water proof and I could use the touch screen fine. As time passed, I noticed I was missing calls because I didn't hear my phone ringing and when I did connect with someone they couldn't hear me. I found myself taking the phone out of the case and to me it was defeating the purpose of the case. The speaker on my iPhone is located at the bottom of my phone on the edge not the back of the phone where the speaker placement was on the case. Maybe that was the problem? In any case, I would have returned the case because I couldn't hear it ring properly; it was muffled. I was sad to return this case but I really had no choice. I couldn't risk missing important calls and right now it seems like I have a lot of important calls coming through. I really don't know how to rate this product. It does what it says but other things get factored in like hearing your ringtone or people being able to hear you properly. I've decided to keep this case even though I can't hear through it properly. I figured I could use it at the beach and places where water damage could occur.

Bought the first one for my son about a year ago. Works fine, especially for the price which was about $57 and free shipping. Bought another for my daughter last month, but this one had a defective touch screen that would not power on. Amazon's no-hassle return policy is truly terrific and between them and/or the vendor, a UPS driver was soon at my door with a completed return label, all postage paid. Soon after, the purchase amount was fully refunded to my credit card. As long as such great customer-first policies are in place, I'd have no qualms about trying this phone yet again. After all, the first one is a real trooper, now in its second year of service for my son.

This is a generic fitbit charge 2 screen protector. Directions were poor and application was not fun. For the price and for what it is it gets 4 stars and it comes with 6. There are better but they are more expensive. A similar item with different branding is [[ASIN:B01LY4PNCS Fitbit Charge 2 Screen Protector (6-Packs), Kimilar Lifetime Replacement Warranty High Definition Full Coverage Screen Protectors for Fitbit Charge 2 bands HD Clear Anti-Bubble Film]] A higher end more expensive, but IMHO a better product is [[ASIN:B01LA1ADXG Fitbit Charge 2 Screen Protector (6-Pack), IQ Shield Matte Full Coverage Anti-Glare Screen Protector for Fitbit Charge 2 Bubble-Free Film - with]] It just depends how much you care and what you want to spend and how easy you want the application.

Love the look of it on my phone, but I'm just so disappointed with the quality of the bumper frame! This case protects my phone well, but the bumper frames on these cases from Spigen just keep breaking! I bought similar looking cases for my previous iPhone 6 plus which also looked amazing but the metal bumper frames broke on those as well. I thought this one would be more durable since the frame is a more flexible plastic, but I was so wrong. It's been less than two months since I bought this and it already broke. It really is a fantastic looking case that does protect the phone well but with bumper frames that keeps breaking, I'm reconsidering ever buying another Spigen case again.

I was already wear my ID batch for work, thought I could combine two things in one. Well, it turned out that my ID batch does not work thru that card holder and the straps wrap right on my phone power button on one side and another button on the other which are what I pressed to capture screen shots. So that was annyoing on the first two days. And depending on the weight of your phone, you neck could get a little fatigue after a long day wearing it. So it was a good product, but it takes a little getting used to.

I had been using Ghost Armor but after about 2 years the edges were lifting enough that I decided to replace it and try this instead. It seems to be just about the same however it is about 1/8" too small so there is a 1/16" gap around the edges. This sounds small but it is quite visible and I wonder whether this means the edges will wear faster (start to lift). This also makes it very hard to get it exactly centered on the phone. Also, a minor point but the T-Mobile Vibrant version of this phone doesn't have a front facing camera so the screen protector shouldn't have a cut out for one.

Sometimes, not always, I get an error when using these and it tells me to use my original charger. Once when I used it, my phone didn’t actually charge at all, just stayed at the same percentage, although it said it was charging. After I had the trouble, I swapped the cord for an original that came with my phone and just used the adapter, that seemed to fix the problem and it charged normally. It does say fast charging when I use them and, when working properly, it takes the same time as other fast chargers, a little over an hour for a full charge. The plug in adapter and cable seems a little on the cheap side. I haven’t been very impressed overall, I would stick with getting an original charger if possible.

If I'm on a call on my phone and switch to the plantronics headset, there is a delay of several seconds while the headset announces that it's on, what phone it's connected to, and battery level. Meanwhile the person on the other end is either talking (and I can't hear them), or thinking the line has disconnected. UPDATE FOUR YEARS LATER: I bought the new Poly 5200 version of this headset (still the same listing on Amazon). I contacted Poly first to make sure it is bluetooth version 5 as advertised. They confirmed that all versions of the 5200 are now bluetooth v5. I compared the old plantronics voyager with the new Poly version. The new version does seem to have slightly better range and *slightly* better noise cancellation. BUT people say the background noise is MUCH worse than on other headsets (compared with wired boom-mic headsets and the Sennheiser Presence). The noise of doing dishes was unbearably loud on the Poly. Comfort is a tossup between the Sennheiser and Poly. So I'm going with the Sennheiser. Honestly I'm just dumbfounded that there have been almost no improvements in headset tech in the last 5-10 years. The Etymotic Etyblu 2 was the best compact in-ear noise-cancelling headset, but it came out over 10 years ago and was discontinued (it did have problems, but sound quality and noise cancellation were not among them). Now to get the best audio quality and noise cancellation you have to buy a full over-the-head trucker headset from blueparrott or similar.

This gets the job done at a good price. It surfs the web OK if you download Opera, and it can do facebook, email, etc pretty well. I Like the keyboard for both web navigation and texting. I don't like the phone implementation. Half the time I accidentally hang up when I try to slide the virtual slider to answer. The camera is half decent, but it is very slow response. The biggest peeve is that it can multitask most every app except the mp3 player! So you can't listen to music and text or surf the web or anything without exiting and stopping the music. I bought this when Virgin only had one bad Android phone, but anymore this isn't worth the few bucks saved. Get something with android so you have a real OS. This phone doesn't make sense in 2012.

Got this for my son and he loved the looks as did I. What drove him crazy and why he does not use it is the 2 sections do not line up when you open the phone. It's off slightly. That was his issue. I used it on mine for a while, but the case slips off a little too easy. When you pull it out of your pocket, you are constantly pushing the cover back on. Very affordable, but you get what you pay for. We don't use it and found other cases that offer more protection, a kick stand (this does NOT have one) and are more secure on the phone. We don't recommend this case.

To be honest, I should give this product 5 stars, and someday I may. I bought this because I generally really like Anker products- a quick review of my Amazon orders shows 33 orders with Anker products, and 10 of them are chargers. But this is to replace one of those Anker chargers that is failing. The problem with the failing device is the folding power prongs. The only time I touch the failing charger is when I find my tablet dead after it's been plugged in all night. Then I look at the charger, and the power indicator light is not on. So I unplug it, flip the prongs up and down a few times, plug it back in (sometimes in the same outlet, sometimes in another), and it's fine for a while. And now I'm concerned because intermittent power connections are a fire hazard. I've plugged this new device into the same outlet and it's been fine. I bought this simply because it's an Anker charger that has a power cable and not fold-able prongs.

Motherboard seems to have crashed after one year and 364 days! I never dropped it or abused it. Tried system recovery reset. It didn't work. Saw others had same problem of it suddenly cycling on and off when first turning it on. Wish I would have put an SD card in it to save everything I took pictures of, etc. Lesson learned. I have 2 Asus computers, one tablet, and this phone. I've never had a good experience with their customer support. I won't be sending it in for repair. I hope to find a new phone that uses the same battery, as I bought and extra one and a charger. Liked it a lot while it lasted.

I gave it 3 stars only if you plan to set it up and then leave it alone. The tighteners for the tripod and light are plastic! They will take only a semi firm tightening and then they will not function at all. So.... for a permanent set up you're good for the price. If you plan to dismantle and reassemble often, keep looking. The light is neat. FYI the cell phone holder is about a half an inch or so too small for a Samsung Note 5 phone. Overall.it really should get 2 stars for tripod tightening quality. When they fail, it's all over and they do so nearly immediately.

I am not sure how long these are supposed to last on your phone. My first one I bought from Target and lasted almost 2 years. They have since discontinued that brand, and every one I have tried since doesn’t last very long… I bought the 2 pack of these. My husband is a plumber and way more rough in his phone than me. His phone ring hook lasted about 4 months before coming off. Mine lasted about 8 months before the metal ring came off the adhesive back. So the adhesive backing itself has been fine, the ring attachment to it was weak. Also, the ring did not remain stiff for long; maybe about 2 months. Then my phone would always slide into its back, no longer able to be propped up by the ring stand. I have an iPhone 2020, so it is one of the smaller ones. Basically this hook ring was cute; we both love cats and my husband loves colorshift, so great combo. However the rings themselves did not last long and were not able to uphold their purpose. I would not buy again.

While I love the product overall and find it very useful, I was having trouble setting up the tripod. The instructions aren't too clear so the setup took a bit of playing around. I have come to think that the knob at the bottom may have broken during shipping because I cannot for the life of me get the stand to stay where I want it. It lowers as soon as I let it go. I went to order a replacement today and realized my window for return expired yesterday. Is there any chance I can still send it back for a replacement?

So, I have had this case for about a year. I immediately noticed that it causes problems with the flash. Anytime I use the flash, it reflects back into the lens and causes the photo to be over-exposed. Being the busy and frugal mom that I am, who also owns a great actual camera, I didn't bother returning it. However, I finally gave up and just ordered the black version of the same case to see if I have any better luck with a darker color. That being said, this case definitely protects the phone. I paired it with a third party tempered glass screen protector and, after multiple drops (I'm quite the accomplished dropper), neither my phone, nor the case are any the worse for wear. That's why I ordered the same case in black.

I purchased the 45mm case for my Series 7 Apple Watch. The second day after using it, a crack occurred along the bottom horizontally. No bumps to the face in that time but I did put it on and take it off a number of times. I think this was the cause of the crack but... It still shouldn't have happened. Even with the crack, I believe it can provide some protection. At least I thought until after I contacted the Manufacturer via their provided email address. No luck though. Never received and response. Fortunately, there were two in the pack. Will see what happens with the second one in time. Because I didn't get response from the Seller and for the Crack itself, I'm deducting Two Stars...

Ok so i ordered this a month in 2019 december i think and its definitely not like the original that comes with the phone. For one, the metal tip on the top isnt neatly nitted its like some just grabbed a bunch of wire and placed them next to eachother. It doesnt look well made. Second it is lighter tgen the first one too. Made from plastic probably. Also im writing this review now because i tried to take my pen out just now and the handle broke away from the actual stylus... Its styck in my phone atm.... Not worth it

This is a basic phone. It comes with no software cd. It makes calls, receives calls, texts. If you are used to a smartphone, this will be a major disappointment. While it has a the touch screen, it is not a smartphone. The screen is not very interactive. The touchscreen is basically for texting. I find texting to be particularly frustrating. You have to use the stylus because the keys are so close together, so automatically that slows you down. Trying to use your fingers is just as frustrating.... You can't select the widgits from the home screen. You have to go thru the menu. Of course my gripes might be because I had a Nokia N97 before this phone, and that has a lot of bells and whistles. But I got this phone for the dual sim feature. I'll keep looking for a dual sim smartphone....

Not using as a cell phone but as a music player for kids. -Power on start setup -disable mobile network and wifi in setup wizard -activation will fail because you have or want to connect to boost -enter bogus name -decline using google account -When into phone enable Guest Mode -Follow wizard for setting up the two swipe patterns, one for parent and one for guest -Follow wizard to select only apps for the kids that only operate locally and read and write to the sd card such as camera, music player (NOT GOOGLE PLAY),voice notes, DO NOT ADD SETTINGS so child cannot enable wifi and get outside of any data on the sd card. -Give child the gest swipe pattern, only parent has the other pattern to administer device when needed. -Connect phone to laptop and copy music files to the phone storage. Make a folder called music if needed and drop it in. Only non protected files will work such as mp3, wma files. -Still look at the device on occasion to make sure the child is NOT on your account. You will be able to tell from the desktop because there will be icons there you know you didn't specify for Guest Mode. -If you enable wifi, youtube, browser, or any other app that access the internet ALL BETS ARE OFF they will not run into explicit content eventually without complicated and costly parental control systems.

Impressed with how well the sound comes through. I actually have to turn down the volume because I'm hearing everything that's going on around the person I'm speaking to. I only use the headset in spurts throughout the day so of course I expected to not charge it at least for a few days... It took a few WEEKS for me to run the battery down. On a recent call, the sound cut out often thru the conversation and I had to ask them to repeat every time. I don't know if it was their phone or mine or just the headset but that is the first time I've had any trouble. I'm hoping it was a fluke.

I bought this phone in 2018, and by 2020 it was unusable. By 2020, the battery life was terrible (couldn't last a full day of idle use), and eventually it began to randomly freeze, restart, and then have a hard time turning back on. I ultimately had to get a new phone when this one got into an infinite loop of restarting, and then I couldn't even get to the homescreen. Still, for nearly 2 years this was a fantastic phone, and the price is well-below that of a premier smartphone, so my expectations can't be too high. I would've given it 5 stars had it lasted a more respectable 4-5 years. However, it didn't, and becoming completely unusable in under 3 years is pretty inexcusable to me. I want to give 2.5 stars, but I'll lean towards 3 just because it has a nice camera and UI.

The turtle is very pretty, made of metal, but it is attached to a plastic piece that fits inside your phone's headphone jack. My Note5 has a normal-sized jack, but I found the plastic plug on this item did not fit securely. After a day or two, the dust plug fell out of my phone and I found it one day, by chance, in my driveway with the plastic plug part separated from the metal turtle figurine part. I have it sitting on a shelf now and am not using as it was designed, due to the insecure fit. I have not tried to repair, but it looks like it could be, with the right type of glue. I would rate 5 stars if it weren't for the plastic.

This screen protector does not come with any device to help you install it in the right place - you just have to wing it. Just a fraction of an inch too close to the phone case causes the protector to not adhere closely to the phone screen. You then have no responsiveness to touch on the screen near the edge. The fingerprint reader absolutely doesn't work 95% of the time. Maybe more. I've gotten it to work maybe 2 times so far. Even away from the edge, the touch screen doesn't respond to a normal touch. I'm about to take the dang screen protector off my phone after a couple of days banging on it to get a response.

I used this case for a day before returning it to my local verizon store. I dont really care much for bulky cases but I was paranoid about my all aluminum One slipping out of my hand. While the case feels good in hand, I was quickly annoyed. The cutout for the capacitive buttons and speakers at the bottom of the device caused me a headache. The HTC One introduces a double tap on the Home button to launch recent apps list and swipe up from the home button to launch Google Now. These are 2 functions I use often. The screen protector that is integrated into the otterbox defender does not stick to the screen and thus slightly sits on top. This caused a problem with my swiping up motion for Google Now because my finger would get caught on the edge of the screen protector. Its actually kinda thick and its rigid so swiping up for Google Now is pretty much impossible. I understand that if they extended the screen protector to cover the capacitive buttons they may become unresponsive. Otherwise all your ports are covered with a flap and adds a lip so if it falls on the face it'll be protected. Good case if you don't do the swiping up feature.

I tried to write a review before I got this in my possession but it was denied. The case itself is pretty nice. The bulk of the case is a nice solid rubber. Almost plastic feeling. The phone fits nicely into it and then you force the screen protector into a grove along the rim of it. Locking your phone in very nicely. The plastic belt clip is very hard to get your phone into. Making it way more hassle then what its worth to even mess with. So if you are buying this thinking to use the belt clip, you might wanna find another case. The plastic, not class screen protector is very cheap. I dont see this actually protecting the glass on the phone much if at all. Rated this 3 starts for 2 main reason. First and foremost the screen protector, if that is even what you can call it, is a joke. The second reason is the shipping. Literally took this company 9 days to ship it. If you do decide you have to have this case, spend the few extra bucks to have them ship it in a reasonable time frame.

I have gone through a lot of these cases, a lot. I like the way they fit the phone and how they look, but the kickstand feature is not very durable. I have had them last months, and I have had them last two days. This last order I received for another three cases, had that issue solved. There was no kickstand, which is the whole reason I keep buying these things. The description says "With Kickstand", the photos show a kickstand, but the ones I received have none. I can only surmise that they just started leaving that out due to complaints about them breaking. It isn't very easy to find cases for older phone models. Everything is new, new, new! Now, now, now! Why replace a phone that costs as much or more than a laptop just because a newer one is out. It works fine, still gets updates. I just want an inexpensive case with a kickstand that doesn't break off.

The material has a strange feeling to it on my fingers. Who knows if it's safe or has harmful plasticizers such as pthalates? No mention of this anywhere. I don't like the color, why don't they have better options besides dark green and black? The case gives almost no feedback to the power and volume buttons, it's hard to tell whether I am even pressing them. It's also difficult to tell apart the volume and Power button because they feel identical to the touch, are right next to each other, and the case is completely green. It would've been better with a colored highlight around the buttons that goes to the lip around the screen so I can see where the power button is every time. Whenever I pick up the phone, I have to hunt with my fingers to find the power button (and not the volume button) to wake the device. The case fits the phone nicely and gives a lip around the screen to somewhat protect the edges. It's not overly bulky either.

The cut outs are not precise or fully encompassing of the iphone. This was released before the iPhone6, as such and they do not show the cut out on any of the pictures. See my picture.The top and bottom both have an incomplete pattern, or rather too much cut out. I suspect they did this because they did not know the exact specs of the iphone 6 so they best guess left out big cut outs for the button and camera. Having these wide open gaps also makes aligning a little more difficult when putting it on. If the cut outs were more precise then the application would be easier. Otherwise the protector works as advertised, once it is on without dust, it adheres nicely and is invisible to the eye.

I love the color, which was the part I was most skeptical about. The skinny band is sleek. I just wish it came with more info, like an instructional guide on how to install it. I did end up figuring it out and I know the customer is capable of doing their own research, but it would be an added bonus for the company to provide something in the package for that. The only other thing I don’t like is fairly minor. It’s that the end of the band doesn’t attach to anything so it sometimes sticks out. I have very small wrists so I have a lot of band length to have to tuck in.

I’ve used Otterbox Defender series for every IPhone I have owned until now. It always protected the phone very well and felt nice & sturdy in my hand. I recently purchased IPhone XR. I’m so very disappointed to learn that Otterbox has decided on “Screenless Editions”. I would like for my entire phone to be protected especially my screen because that’s what cracks & shatters when dropped! I saw alpha glass as an option to purchase separately to be used with Otterbox. Alpha got mixed reviews and it’s was very close in price to the Otterbox itself. I preferred to find an all in one case and would have been willing to buy Otterbox & Alpha if I couldn’t find an all in one for the XR. I found Lifeproof Fre. Although it has excellent reviews it felt so low quality vs Otterbox Defender. I’m going to give Lifeproof a shot because of high reviews AND all in one casing plus it’s cheaper and more convenient than buying Otterbox & Alpha separately. Sorry Otterbox I will be returning the screenless Defender. Wish I could give higher rating.

I THOUGHT that I had made sure to order one of the screen protectors that was actually sized right for my Samsung Galaxy S6, after reading reviews of other screen protectors describing how they did not cover the entire screen surface. The quality of this screen protector seems to be good, and installation was fairly straightforward. I was able to lift it up and reapply it, to remove a dust particle or two that had been missed in the original cleaning prior to installing the screen protector. Touch response good. However, this does NOT cover the entire screen. Even with a case that provides a "bumper" or lip that comes up over the edge of the phone, there is a gap ALL AROUND between the screen protector and the edge of the screen. This is definitely not edge-to-edge coverage.

Good phone for the price. Obviously you are not paying for a top-end smartphone, so you shouldn't expect the performance of one, but this phone works pretty well if you expect that going in. Biggest complaint has to be RAM, apps close randomly and some are extremely slow. The Google app is the worst example, voice search is virtually unusable because the phone is too slow, and when you do a regular search and open results in a web page, the web page almost always closes before loading the full page. Again, at this price, that's not surprising, and not even that disappointing.

I ordered a clear and a smoke case so I could switch up the bands from time to time. I’ve had these cases for about two weeks now and they seem to be holding up nicely. The watch itself is a 49mm so keep in mind that these cases will add at least another 4-6mm to it. I personally enjoy wearing large/xl watches so that was a great size and fit for my wrist. It be great if new color straps could be added for purchase to switch up as well. Color suggestions: red, gray, white, brown, yellow. I guess price point could be decided once I’ve worn this case at least a couple of months. I’m still iffy about the quality of the straps. ***UPDATE*** After about a week or so of use, the crown fell off!!!. It’s no longer useful because I had to glue it back on. What a bummer! So now the crown is on for looks only. I hate returning stuff.

I love the idea of this product. The materials are great. I used it for a the iPhone 5S. Everything about the product is perfect, except the phone doesn't fit snuggly. It won't fall out, but it's hard to reach the volume and mute buttons.When taking a picture, I had to adjust the case on the phone or the back of the case was in the picture. Also, the front of the case was too close to the keyboard which made it difficult to type the letter you wanted, and to slide apps between home screens. I ended up returning it for another product, but would definitely try it again with some improvements.

PROS Sliding shield for cameras S pen holder Comes with extra adhesive if needed Aesthically pleasing MIDDLE GROUND "Kickstand" is more like a ring-like holder as it doesn't allow you to support the weight of the phone unfolded CONS Built-in front screen protector is a cheap piece of plastic that holds onto every smudge possible Built-in front screen protector also is EXTREMELY easy to scratch(dont keep your phone in the same pocket with any other item) The overall quality of the case is that of a mid-grade plastic OVERALL CONSENSUS I was expecting to be in love with this case but was quite disappointed. The price point seems a tad stretched out for the quality of the case. Will I continue to use the case? Yes, until I can find a better option. Would I recommend this case? If you're purchasing for pure aesthetics and have an office job then go ahead, you'll enjoy this case. Otherwise, if you're looking for quality and live a more active lifestyle, I would look around a bit more before settling on this case.

To start, I know that the recent Samsung phones have issues with regular plastic and tempered glass protectors so I decided to look for the military grade protectors which use water to apply. This screen protector is actually one of the better ones material wise, but I don't feel like it's wide enough. Another issue I ran into while applying the screen protector was that it was a pain to get the edges down. I actually still have a corner that is noticeable. You can tell that there is a screen protector and this after three attempts at applying the screen protector.

This is a BEAUTIFUL case & I am disappointed this didn’t work for me. I really love the eSamcore ceramic rings that you stick into the back of the phone case so it can be carried with a finger if my hands are full & is compatible with wireless charging. The adhesive wouldn’t stick to the “leather” (faux) back of this case since it has an uneven texture. I can’t speak to the durability of the case or how it will wear with use, but the initial quality is very high & is an absolutely gorgeous case. I was so bummed that this didn’t work out & I had to return it, but the ring-back is more important to me than this case was since there’s no shortage of gorgeous phone cases out there. I purchased a shiny/flat plastic marble print case and the ring stuck with no problems. If you don’t care about having that sort of stick-on accessory on the back, trust that this is a solid purchase & a gorgeous case!

The product was fairly easy to install and you do have to wait about 15 minutes to be able to push the sides down. Touch is responsive and when new you can't tell it's there. Here's the bad. One lift with a kettlebell and a scratch appeared. Faded a bit but didn't go away. More troubling is that the screen is now ruined by getting bug repellant on it. This was a quick spritz with Off Deepwoods. I've tried everything I can think of to get it off, but as you can see in the pictures; residue is still there. I can only assume it would do the same with any other aerosol. Good thing is I have several other replacement shields, but this result was disappointing.

Item is as described, and very durable. I love the handle at the top, and it’s nice that it can be stood up or elevated by the back posts. It arrived quickly, I ordered another type the same day with my Prime settings on and this one came within two days but the other one is taking a week. I removed one star because the screen protector does not sit perfectly flush with the screen, so there’s a bubble or gap at the bottom of the screen that is annoying when I’m using my finger to tap or draw things. This protector was originally for my daughter but the gap is enough to make it difficult for her to use her stylus doing schoolwork so I’m keeping this one for me, and we will see if the other iPad case is better in that regard.

So ... the last phone I really LOVED was the LG G7 ThinQ, but I had to upgrade to a 5G phone ... This was more-or-less the same phone, so I thought I'd love it ... but ... As others have mentioned ... this is an ATT specific phone that has been somehow unlocked ... and it SORTA works with other carriers, but not great! WiFi Calling can not be enabled on this phone with T-mobile/sprint/boost/Hello mobile, etc. and THAT feature is IMPORTANT to me as I only have a bar or two of cell service at the house. So, I'll most likely return the phone. Too bad, because I love it! It's just crippled by ATT remnants. A couple other notes: It BARELY can make it through a day on a charge. The sound quality rocks! It "feels" cool and high quality. If you're already using an ATT carrier, go for it, otherwise ... probably not.

Have used these for a while and they are pretty nice. Every now and then the phone will show that it's slow charging, but just unplugging and re-plugging fixes it. Downside is that they do not all appear to be proper data cables. My red cable will not work with Android auto or allow you to play back media files on a radio via "USB mode" on the head unit. The green one is untested, but the blue one does work SOMETIMES for Android auto/media file playback when plugged into a 2018 Kia Soul Exclaim. Doesn't work in any other car I've tried. Only the Soul somehow worked.

I've had the same phone case for a long time and never had an issue with the Popsocket I had on it. I had it on there for about 2 years, until the plastic part came off and I couldn't find it. So, I took that one off and cleaned the case and got a new one, expecting the same quality product. However, the adhesive just wouldn't last. I could no longer hold my phone with one hand because the thing would just keep falling off. I tried a new one, the same design, on a different case. Same difference. I ended up just Gorilla-gluing it to my case in both situations.

I like the metal kickstand, I was looking for one with a portrait/lanscape kickstand. I wish it had dust covers for the ports. Oh and whatever you do, DO NOT go by the video on here to install the screen cover, it's not the same and it screwed me up to begin with. In fact, just toss the screen protectors that came with it. I managed to get almost all the bubbles out, then peeled off the exterior top... and it completely unseated the entire screen protector! More air than contact! It's trash!! Now I've got to go get a screen protector

i dont know if its defective or design, but if its not perfectly placed in the outlet it does not work, on too many occasions i have come back to my laptop completely discharged and although the light is on on the charger it is not charging. Its too late for the amazon return window and I am now using it daily instead of intermittently since I am 100% remote due to an injury. They reached out to me after a query and replaced the unit. So far the replacement unit works fine, The first unit was obviously defective. good customer service

The production quality is high. The biggest problem is that to place the arm band on your arm in a way that you can easily turn your head and see the full screen is almost impossible. Think about it: try to hold your phone against your upper arm and move your arm so you can see the full screen. It's not really possible. The screen may be visible, but it's angled away from your face. Moreover, if you're running or doing anything with lots of movement, you'll need to make it extra tight to keep it from moving (especially if you have a larger (6"+) phone since the bouncing from the weight of the phone will tend to move the arm band. At some point, this tightness is cutting off circulation. Finally, the tiny pocket for a key is pretty useless, as the key is likely to just fall out (the pocket has no closure). That's not a big problem if you have somewhere else to put your key, but then why did they bother to include this "feature"?

This charger was really great for the first few months it actually worked. It charged very well and was very handy to have a double space for charging. However, this charger was no better than a $5 one that you could get at Walmart considering the time it lasted. Note that The charger didn’t have any sign that it was going to break and it looked in perfectly good shape. I was thoroughly disappointed that it all of a sudden stopped working when I had spent $15 on a charger that I thought was going to be top notch based on the reviews I saw. If you are going for something durable that you will use on an everyday basis and not for traveling, I would not recommend this.

I gave it 3 stars because it is very pretty and I am using it. However, anyone buying this cover needs to be aware it is nothing more than a plastic skin that will provide no protection whatsoever if you drop your phone or spill anything on it. The plastic on the back is already showing scratches from 1 week of use and I am not rough on my phone by any stretch of the imagination. The opening for the charger hole is too snug so whenever I unplug from charging there's a nasty "snap" noise. I hope I'm not damaging my phone because of this. Would I buy it again? No. And based upon what I'm seeing in terms of wear and tear after only a week I'll need another case soon.

My previous, cheap 3-in-1 charger was starting to malfunction, and this one was on sale, so I gave it a try. Even deeply discounted, I think it's overpriced for what you get. It charged just fine, although I was disappointed that the blue light stays on when a device is charging. I would think that most would find that undesirable as this unit is probably doing most of its work at night. My biggest gripe is that the unit emitted a high-pitched whine all the time when it was plugged in. When a phone was charging, it was a little less noticeable, but it was still there. I have about a dozen other Anker products, and this one just didn't live up to my expectations.

Only holds 2 cards but it holds them well. Kind of annoying getting them out though. The mirror was cheap plastic and was a pain to slide in/out of its built in space. It broke which no big deal anyway since I actually placed a magnet there to attach to a cell phone holder in my car. I was concerned the back would open randomly but as long as it's not overstuffed it holds really well. I'm able to use my contactless payments (NFC) and wireless charger with the car in without any issues. Overall I like it and will keep using it until I need to get a new phone I'm sure.

There's way better products out on the market. I ordered this for my phone and ordered a different stand up one for my second phone just to see which one works best. This one is very sensitive on where you put your phone cuz you have to put it just right for the battery to catch the charging Portion of the pad in order to charge and if you bump it or if it moves slightly it might not charge. That's why I like the stage up certain better from both my orders and I ended up ordering 6 of the stage up NANAMI chargers instead. I will keep this as backup but it's just not as convenient as I was hoping it was.

I had a similar mount that stopped working because of some modifications I tried to make. I like this one a little better as it's a little smaller, yet still strong enough to hold my phone. I don't know about it's longevity, but the initial grip it has on my vent is very strong as well. Time will tell if that starts to loosen up, but I hope that won't happen. Love the swivel ability of this grip, as well as not having to mess with clips and springs, etc. It's just pop the phone on, and pull it off. No tricks or gimmicks. Since I have a clear case on my phone, I added a sticker to the metal plate so it doesn't look too add. Now people think it's a custom case with my favorite team on it. EDIT: Well, after using this for a good while, I am sad to say it's pretty useless now. There are metal clips that are covered by the rubber grips that hold onto the vent. Well, they have torn through the rubber and now are scratching the vent while also losing the grip. There is another style of grip that is heavy duty, all rubber that requires you to squeeze tabs to open it. That one grips like a monster and I don't think it has metal inside waiting to bust out. I would use this one only in an emergency, but not as a daily phone grip.

The frame system makes these screen protectors nearly foolproof to install. Unfortunately, the screen protectors themselves do not cover the entire face area of a Pixel 3a. There's a solid 3mm all around between the edges of this thing and the inside of my phone case. The edges of the screen protector are pretty abrupt, too. You'll definitely notice them if you're swiping in from the sides, especially swiping down from the top. The impact that destroyed my previous screen protector actually happened on the very edge of my phone, in an area this thing doesn't even cover, so obviously I'm disappointed that this one doesn't offer full coverage

Do you like following instructions exactly only to have the installation ruined due to manufacturers? I don't. Both of my installations were ruined. One COULD have been my fault while the other certainly was not. Floating degree like cardboard or something was in the package containing the films, ruining them. Case friendly?? Yeah, with an otterbox case there is so little room left at the bottom that it kept lifting the film, certainly needed that extra protection huh? And the sides... Oh boy, the sides. I thought I had a somewhat decent installation but was proved wrong later when I seen dust/dirt on the sides, later finding out that the curved part of the screen failed to have the film stick to it, but I guess that's a fault of the phone itself. Fingerprint sensor works though!! Still would use it, as there is no other better choice

It arrived at the end of the estimated delivery time but it was in great condition. The leather appears to be good quality. It closes completely with all of my ids and necessary cards. It easily flips in order to talk on the phone without taking the it out of the case. My main concern is that the case holding my phone in the wallet is not good quality. It broke soon after first use and now does not hold my phone securely. It also became partially detached/ unglued quickly after use. (I am considering buying another plastic insert to glue in myself...) Overall I like the wallet but will need to do something about the plastic case sooner than later.

Sturdy case...There is plastic to be peeled off the hard plastic on the case Update...bought this case a second time since I like it its my favorite for the lg k92 but had a complication upon opening the package once delivered...1st one came with what the case would have been in I was very unhappy that there was no case enclosed and so I reached out to amazon support and got a replacement two days later im happy that amazon went above and beyond however I will never purchase any case from this seller again due to the inconvenience ill find one else where...thank you amazon for your tremendous customer support :)

I just got this and plugged it up right away. I was waiting onthis to come. Arrived on time and as described. Highly recommend. The braiding is soft nylon. It’s just long enough for what I want to do. Update: 07 October 2017- I like this charger. I’ve been using it and it’s charging my phone pretty quickly compared to other chargers I’ve used. But I’m also using a special Anker 4 usb charging port with it. Really nice! Update: 05 May 2018- I just bought more of these cables. They don’t seem to last long. We opened one up approximately 2 1/2 weeks ago and it’s dead already. Had to throw both of them away. The other one I had a little bit longer. But not that long either. Maybe a few months. I just got the new ones today and of course like everything else we buy, it says made in China on the package. These feel a lot less sturdy than even the last ones. These feel thin and cheaply made. They don’t even have the little plastic casing around the end that holds the USB and the lightening charger on the cable itself, like these other ones I bought previously. I don’t know how long they’ll last but I think these are the last ones I buy like this. I’ll have to look for other cables that will hopefully last longer. I can’t recommend this item any longer at this time.

The plastic feels crappy. It doesn't feel quality and it's not grippy in your hand so I had to get a pop-socket attached. The magnetic insert is garbage. Unless it's a very powerful magnet it will not hold your phone. Most automotive attachments will not be strong enough but luckily they sell super thin adhesive metal plates you can put on your phone cases to remedy this. The pro's of the case: - It has corner pockets which are important. If the phone drops on its corner it will certainly shatter the glass without these hard pockets to gap the energy disbursement. - The case gaps the screen from the ground so if it fell flat or fell and slid for a bit it would not scratch the screen (even though you should 100% have a screen protector of some sort too) - The case gaps the camera on the back so the same as above applies - I high-visibility orange has grown on me and is useful since I'm outdoors often I always remember to place my phone screen down everywhere I go The "non slip" advertisement is BS. If Ownest thinks I got a bad product that is slippery by all means feel free to send me a new one however, I purchased 2 different colors to chose from originally and both felt the same cheap slippery quality.

Ultimately it's nice to have an additional source of batterfy power and it provides that for sure. The Iphone slides in like butter, the case is a bit heavy but I like the smooth feel of the back. My only complaint is sometimes when my phone is in the case charging, the touch screen acts a bit funny, something it does NOT do when the phone is not in this case. It would also be great if the case was made not only to charge but to protect. I'm being super duper careful with this because it's cost to much to replace!! I purchased the black one cause the purple and the cyan colors were off the chain expensive.

Awesome phone! The best out there of the ones I have tried (and I have tried many) and combining it with a MicroSD of 128GB it sky rocketed. The only sad thing is that Sony isnt making themselves responsible for the International Version now and after 2 months my phone died out of nowhere didnt know why and I still dont know. I had to purchase an OEM battery and that did the trick. However, for whomever is thinking about purchasing this phone be warned, it heats up when using the default camera app, like a lot! If you try to use the video camera is even worse since the app shuts down after 10 seconds (even if you are not recording!) I had to get a different camera app because of that, and so far I havent found one with the 1080p60fps option, only 30fps. Its a big shame really being a powerful phone and having this design issues. Also because of the heat (or at least thats what I think) the stickers/tape that attach the back cover started losing power and the back cover started to fall apart easily.

I love this phone case. I am able to hold 2 cards on the inside pocket and 4 cards plus a little cash in the zipper pocket. It holds the phone very well and keeps it very secure. Even with the cards in the case it is thin enough that I can put it in my back pocket comfortably. My only complain about this case and the reason I gave it 4 stars is because when I use the flash on my camera the pictures turn out the color of the case I got. Thankfully I rarely use the flash so it's not a huge deal. Update: my case broke after only 3 months. I loved this case, I could carry everything I needed and not have to worry about carrying a purse. But the plastic piece that holds the phone cracked and would no longer hold my phone. Was very disappointed. For the price of $20 I expected it to last a lot longer than 3 months. I won't be buying a new one.

I'm so glad to have gotten a new screen so quickly! The same-day shipping was great! They also have great customer service following up with you after you order it. The screen protector itself is kind of small though. It doesn't quite cover the whole front of the phone (near the edges of my phone case) which my old one did. It just barely covers the actual screen itself on the side edges. You can't mess up putting it on, otherwise you'll have to waste one and put on the other screen protector it comes with. I know that's why it comes with two, but who wants to waste such an expensive screen cover...anyways, after its applied it's great! Only tiny complaint is that I which it was just a smidge bigger

Regular iPhone 14 rattles around inside the lock box. And with a case on the top does not close. Despite these factors my daughter quickly learned that if she wants to keep her device then don’t use it after hours, or else it gets locked away. There is some availability of the phone in case of emergencies - but you can’t do much like play of game or watch a video without it becoming to annoying to work. We accidentally set the lock for 99 hrs and could not unlock it, so don’t mess about with it unless you really want to lock the phone away. There needs to be a way to override the lock if needs be.

Its not that great... It was amazing when it came to dropping it, not one crack or scrath on my phone... The case was very protective. there was just one problem... It wasn’t waterproof. I never even put it in water... Sometimes my hands were wet and water would leak through. This prevented me from typing as the water went throught the home button opening and wet the bottom portion of the screen... I barely wet it by accident and water was leaking into the case. if you are looking for a good case and you know it wont get wet, this is for you... but if u really want a good waterproof case get an otterbox. They are expensive but worth every penny. I probably wouldn’t buy this case again

Loved the phone at first because it feels much faster and more responsive than my two previous cheap phones (Samsung A11 and Moto E6). It runs at 2Ghz, which is faster than either of those phones, so it makes sense. But it has some built-in shortcomings: 1) camera is worse than any phone I've had recently, very pixelated when zoomed in. I good light it is okay. 2) Does not connect to wireless at high speed 5Ghz 3) I've had problems with connecting to bluetooth with 4 separate devices, and have to reboot the phone to get it to work, very annoying if you switch bluetooth devices a lot. Also, strangely, the volume control has like 5 levels, and so often I want the volume to be between two settings, ie, it is either too loud or too soft, and there is no work-around!

Definitely a good case, it's clearly very durable and the stand can withstand a good amount of force. The case sits almost perfectly flush with my screen protector, which is really nice. But the cons are that the build and material make it tough to operate: you have to use your nails to get the stand open each time, so not super accessibility-friendly. The camera protector is also really hard to open AND close, so I've already accidentally left fingerprints on my lenses several times in my efforts to operate it. Lastly, there's a sticker on the inside of the case that is either not supposed to be removed or just hard to remove: I tried to remove it and now I just have a really ugly bunch of sticker residue inside my case. Overall, not sure if I would buy this with my own money but the stand is a REALLY nice feature.

I seem to alternate between this brand and SuperShieldz. This brand worked well on my previous A50 and came with an alignment frame. Because of this, I bought a set for my new A53 5G and well, I'm not as impressed. First: There is no hole for the camera. This probably isn't such a bad thing, but it seems like an odd thing to omit. Second: Getting one on without bubbles ON A BRAND NEW FRESH OUT OF THE BOX PHONE was basically impossible even with the instructed prep work. Third: Pocket lint. The unholy amount of lint attracting static from this glass... I've never experienced such an insane amount of crud on a phone BRAND NEW. On the other hand, I dropped this new phone on the first day and after bouncing off a corner (mark on the Spigen case) it landed face down and didn't shatter, so a bonus 2 stars for that.

So apparently, this is a generic Samsung flip cover and not an authentic one. This is a great color and I chose it because Samsung does not offer this ferrari red version on their website. Also, I liked the fact that I only paid $8 for it versus the $60 Samsung was offering. The inside of the flap as well as the outside attracts dirt very easily. The screen is highly susceptible to scratches and smudges. In addition to that, the view window appears to be quite slanted and off slightly by a few centimeters. The back of the case doesn't appear to snap on fully and you can see a small gap around the bezel. Although, it seems to stay on well without falling off. The back of the case will get scratched, but it was not as noticeable compared to the plastic view. To add, the color on the back of the case definitely doesn't match the front flap. It looks as if whoever created it decided to slap on the two colors that appeared similar and glued it together. The cover does not close all the way as would be expected but if you place it face down very often, you can easily overcome that issue.

After using this for about a week; I'm going to edit this review and my rating. The little metal piece on the kickstand that I initially raved about is not working on my case any longer. Now, while my phone is mounted on the magnetic vent mount, the phone will drop off the mount leaving behind the little metal insert from the case on the vent mount (see photo). Phone falls and now I have to find my phone and reattach the piece of metal to my case. The Samsung A51 is not a light or small phone and the manufacturer should have adjusted the adhesion qualities accordingly to prevent this from happening. What attracted me immediately to this case for my Samsung A51 before anything else was the built in metal on the backside that also serves as the base for the kickstand. Why? Because every other phone case I have ever owned I have had to provide that stupid piece of metal myself and stick it on separately to my phone. Not only did I have to provide it but I had to dig through my junk drawer in the kitchen upsetting the organized chaos of that ecosystem. Second to that, the price had me sold on this case. Why spend more when you can get this for $10 bucks and it comes with a second screen protector! What?!? GTFOH with all that crazy talk. And for $10 I feel like I can virtue signal all day knowing and explaining to others how the packaging is completely biodegradable. No joke. And all for $10. This thing makes my phone look sick.

For visiting the US as a tourist, worked fine as a SIM card to drop into my phone. Problem came when it came time to put money on the card - US credit card needed! Had to call and give CC details to a person who really didn't seem to listen to my problem and couldn't understand the issue. Expect to spend 10mins setting up SIM card before use, plus another 10 to put money on it by phone - unless you have a US credit card, in which case the online top up looks pretty simple. The card itself worked flawlessly, and cheaper than AT&T option. T Mobile also do a Tourist SIM card, but you have to go into a store and buy it in person. This one I wanted to work from the airport (how could I easily find a T Mobile store without my phone? What did we do before Google Maps again?), and it did it's job. Might be unfair to dock a star for the customer service on the phone, but it stuck with me that much I guess!

The screen protector was cut a little off meaning that the speaker hole at the top was further to the right so it never was able to line up properly. Beyond that it makes the screen harder to see. The only way to describe it is it dulls the picture and adds a slight shimmering effect very wierd. I would not buy again. I am now using the Spigen GLAS.t SLIM Premium Tempered Glass screen protector. 1 word to describe. AMAZING! Dont waste your money on anything else. I am sold on this company at this point they have the best case and the best screen protector for my iphone 5. Never going back to low quality junk.

If you're looking for something cheap to just slap on your phone, there's probably better, especially since this is an expensive phone. It does have slightly raised edges for the camera/lens, like it claims (most noticeable around the lenses), but it isn't raised at all around the sides of the phone. This results in leaving those areas very exposed and prone to damage. It's also pretty slick freshly applied. At $10 I'd suggest you spend another $5-10 for a more protective case than any of the sub-$10 options like this offer. Especially since the 7 Pro is far from a cheap device.

Update: I got about 50-66% of advertised standby life on my new headset with latest firmware. I gave it a full charge on Friday at 3pm. On Monday at 8am, I was down to 3:15 remaining on a 7hr estimate of total talk time. I wish I had kept the packaging to return it. I've had two Legends and this is just as good as my last Legend.
