I've tired a number of other top-of-line headsets w/ noise cancelling mics, these are the best by a good measure - I didn't even bother looking this go-around. If you talk to customers in an urban environment, airports, or the car I'd only look at this line of headsets. Complaints here: 1) Each generation of this model has a different 4-prong charger. They included a micro-usb (!!), but if you're going to include the 4-prong why should it be a difference physical design than the last 2-gens?? The old cords and chargers don't physically fit. Not a huge deal because I have micro-usbs everywhere. 2) The other big deal is the improved noise cancelling mic. I don't think it's all that much better than the last gen.

It worked…sort of. Once, anyway. I barely tapped my watch on a toilet tank while installing it in my house. It shattered like I hit it with a hammer. So, it works, just don’t expect it to take much abuse. If I were to continue buying these it will eventually cost as much as replacing the watch. My suggestion is…if you’re going to do anything you suspect has the possibility of damaging your watch…just take it off. I’m pretty sure my watch could have taken the tiny tap that destroyed this glass no problem. So basically I feel like I spent money for no reason.

This screen protector is great but you need to get the hang of it. Minimum you have to have 2 on hand because you'll probably screw it up like me. I always buy skinomi for all my products with great success but the s7 edge is tricky precisely because of the edges. It would have been great that the company would have sent 2 like it says it would but in my case just one arrived. I RECOMMEND after watching the tutorial video on you tube and doing every precisely as shown, re-wet the edges that are wanting to come off and take a tough, strong paper napkin, wrap the phone facing down so that the ends of the napkins are enjoying the back side of the phone and tug so that the edges of the phone are forced into place. Use a hair drier being careful and heat those edges a bit so that they take the form of the phone. Keep tugging until it cools down and don't but a cover until 2 days have passed. The edges won't come off after that.

This case would be awesome if it were more durable! It allowed my 13 year old grandson to have cash or a debit card with him in the hidden compartment, My only problem is that here it is less than a week after the return window closed and he tells me that for the last couple of weeks, it has been randomly popping open, causing the debit card to fall out on more than one occasion. If only he had told me when it first started happening, I could have sent it in for replacement in the hopes that this was a fluke and that perhaps the replacement would be more durable. Sadly, I will never know.

I looked at multiple cases and even bought one that I had to send back. This one is working just as intended. So the pro's are: like the color and built-in stand, it fits perfectly, durable so far (2 1/2 mo), the charging cable still fits perfectly into the port on the phone without interference from case. Cons: the magnet part is apparently not as strong as needed, so in the car it keeps falling off the holder. I even added the the old magnet I used between phone and case, but since the holder/magnet on this case is raised slightly the added magnet in-between just can't connect. I can't speak to the screen protector that came with it, it did seem a little thin and I wanted a camera protector, so I purchased those as a package separately.

I love this thing. At first I was a little worried about the pic of the Logo since it looks large and overtaking the whole look but I ordered it anyway. To my delight, the logo is quite small and blends in so you can hardly see it. I got the silver with aquamarine stones and it's just beautiful. I've only had it a few days so I don't know how well it will hold up yet. I will update my review if so. It looks extremely nice on my Silver iPhone XS Max because it picks up the stainless steels and coordinates quite nicely. I took off one star because the base of it ( the part that stick to the phone) is make of rather inexpensive plastic but once I got it on the phone it seemed more sturdy. I would recommend this highly if you like a lil bling on your phone. Oh, also the shiny base part can also work as a small mirror to check and see if you have any spinach stuck in your teeth. HA HA! UPDATE: After having this for a while, the ring no longer holds the phone up. It plops over from the weight of the phone and is very loose. Sad because this is a beautiful ring holder. I wish they would fix this.

This really is a great case - no doubt about it. It is waterproof (so far in limited testing) and the touchscreen performance almost seems better than without it. I do really like the case ... Why 3 stars than? Because the cover that plugs up the lightning port keeps coming off. It's not attached to the case and can easily slip off. If lost, this case is then useless for water protection. If only this piece was permanently attached to the case - it would be PERFECT! *** UPDATE *** I spent two weeks in Belize tubing in rivers, swimming in pools, waterfalls, and the Caribbean without incident. This is a great case other than the need to pay attention to the part that covers the lightening port. I highly 100% recommend this case - just keep an eye on that cover!

Well this review isn't too helpful since this is no longer available, but maybe if someone comes across this it will help. This band was fine until a few weeks ago. So ten months of not quite daily use as I did rotate with other bands. I did have to cut the strap much shorter to accommodate the large watch on my wrist, didn't make it seem too well tailored to this watch. And the perfect length was of course between two holes so I usually wore looser except when working out. But then I noticed recently the two rubber colors coming apart at the hole, which then led to a small crack in the pink rubber (from the pressure of the thick band underneath?) which then turned into a large crack. The teal rubber hasn't cracked yet so it's still useable, but it's only a matter of time.

This nifty little tripod is great! It holds my phone for me when I'm watching movies. I've mostly used it in bed and I can shift and shape it how I want and it still stands. Had to knock down 2 stars because after a few days of use the bottom part would slip constantly and the phone would slide right off the tripod. If there was a material that held in place and would prevent sliding it would be perfect. One star for the lack of hold and another for the light use and the time it took to get to the point where it's almost unusable for its intended purpose.

I'm slightly disappointed I had to use several within a two month period on the Fitbit Charge 3. The first one I used peeled the exact same way it shows in the photo, and I was doing nothing but going to bed, when I moved my wrist to look at the time I saw the plastic had lifted half way and looked like lint from fabric got under. I followed the indications of how to install and how much time to leave it before using the watch again. I installed the second one on a Friday night and left it "dry' until Monday morning. It lasted about 3 weeks before this happened, and all it took was me to scratch my back for the plastic to lift up and get lint underneath. I love this screen protectors, I had a great one that I used on my Fitbit Charge 2 when it came out and lasted a long time, I never had to change it to a new one. Unless you don't mind changing it every month and a half or so, then go ahead.

I was really impressed with this Apple Watch band initially. It came with the tools needed to resize yourself and the fit is really comfortable. I wanted something nice looking for everyday use and for the first couple of months, this did not disappoint. About three months in to wearing it daily though, I noticed the paint was rubbing off. I sent a message to the company today to see if this was normal or not and am just waiting to hear back. If this isn’t covered by a warranty or is common for three months of normal use, I can’t say I’d buy a replacement from the same company. Update: the company responded within the day and since said the warranty on the band was three months so since Mine was under warranty, they are sending out a free replacement. Very pleased with their service and hope this one doesn’t scratch up so fast.

Overall, the case is good. A little different to put on than say, a regular Defender series case, but it doesn’t really hold to the test of time under regular use. The charging port is only held on by a thin, rubberized dovetail joint for lack of better description. The piece can, from my experience, either pop out of its socket, or eventually just have the rubber tear off so that the whole piece is useless. Other than that, I did like the case, mainly for the OtterBox brand that I trusted, and for MagSafe compatibility unlike the more rugged Defender series case. Currently shopping around for a different case, unfortunately.

I've owned 3 previous waterproof cases and i change them every 6 months or so because i take pictures on the beach every day and they get scratched with time. Went with this brand and as careful as i was assembling it, it scratched over my cameras immediately. The whole reason i get these types of cases is so i can safely take pictures on the beach. If that's your goal, I'd get another brand. I have to get another one now unless i want to take my phone out of the case every time i want to take a picture.

Just another cheap glass screen protector that doesn't truly fit what it says it will. Protector's edges won't stick no matter how well you pisition it. I guess this is due to the A51 having a slightly curved screen. It'll do for now, but those edges are going to collect dust and gunk like crazy. Eventually the protector will catch on something and lift the whole thing nearly or entirely off, causing grime and bubbles to appear upon reapplication. It'll be unsightly and mostly unusable much earlier than if it was made correctly. Also should have a hole in the glass for the front-facing camera. Pictures will be slightly less clear now. Like I said, it'll do, but not for as long as if it were made correctly. This was disappointing.

We all run into this from time to time, where you think something is totally different. Well, I bought this for my desk at work, from the images online I anticipated it being a little heavier or better made. Oh was I disappointed. It is cheaply made and it weighs about as much as a paperclip so it gets knocked around pretty easily when I am fumbling or shuffling papers around. I guess I expected it to weigh more like a paper weight or something. Also, I purchased the white one to match my phone, and I wouldn't call it white. I would call it more of a primer color. Dingy even. The product isn't so bad I would return it, I just want to make sure others know when they buy it not to have their hopes up.

When I purchased this item i was expecting it to protect my phone when it falls. If my phone were to fall flat on the face or back my lens and screen would crack because the length of the protector doesnt exceed the phone. I have to purchase a tempered glass for my screen and lens for added protection if it were to fall flat on those sides. If it were to fall at an angle the case would probably absorb the shock but that is all for maximum protection. Currently looking for another case with longer ridges to exceed depth of phone so if it does fall flat on screen the case would prevent the screen from touching the floor/cement,etc and getting cracked!

This was a really good screen protector and im really happy with it but i just wish i didnt mess it up. i had some liquid trapped underneath it, and thinking it was just air bubbles which go away as advertised i left it and 2 days later it was still there and i took it off and re applied it but i just made it worse so at this point i just need to know how to use the lifetime replacement. i would definately recommend this screen protector especially if they do get back to me about the lifetime replacement. 5 stars if they do, but at the moment 4 because im not sure about the replacement yet.

Got this for my Ricoh GRIII, package came with two shields, which was helpful because the first installation was terrible. I wiped the screen with the included cloth. repeatedly blew off dust, caught one tiny spec underneath (not the shield's fault), but the edge adhesion was terrible. Lots of air space around the edges that would not go away. Then, when I tried to remove the rear protective cover, half of the shield lifted up. Which made the edge adhesion even worse. 2nd attempt I cleaned the screen with lens cleaner, removed the rear protective cover _before_ installation, then applied the shield making sure I didn't curl the edges or get my fingers on the underside. This worked much better, but there's still a 2-3mm tall air gap all along the bottom edge of the screen, and some smaller scattered gaps along both sides. Smooth the shield down, the gaps go away, but reappear almost immediately. Two stars because it does seem like it will do a good job protecting the screen, but I have much better installation results with glass covers. I don't understand the purpose of the rear protective cover, and the adhesive bond holding it on seems stronger than the bond that forms between the shield and the screen. My advice would be to remove the rear protective cover immediately before installation. As long as you don't try to smooth the shield down with something that has a sharp edge, you're not going to scratch the shield surface. I have another ExpertShield coming in for my GRII, but I'll return that unopened and look for a glass cover.

This stupid charger auto opens and closes if it is touched in any way. So if you touch the screen to answer a call or touch the screen to put in an address or anything at all, it opens and the phone pops out. And the clip is in the worst place so you have to contort your fingers to get it in place and then it will randomly pop out and fly at you while you are driving. I’d return it if I had not already used it. Horrible!!! EDITED TO ADD - their customer service has been very helpful and they are supposedly sending me their updated version at the end of April. Updated to 3 stars for now. Hopefully new one will work and I can edit again.

My first impression was they were nicely packaged. Each protector has its own individually packaged install kit but the alcohol wipe in the first one I opened was completely dry and useless. I had alcohol so I used my own. No big deal. Prepping the screen with the other supplies went smoothly. I was very disappointed to find one of the protectors had a defect along the black boarder on the touchscreen side, so I didn’t use it. The screen adhered perfectly without any bubbles and only minimal pressure. I give a 2 Review due to the defective protector & dry alcohol wipe. If the seller could replace the one defective protector I’d give the product 2 additional .

I will say that they sent me an email with video instructions on how to apply the screen protector. Pretty cool. Also, I think they sent me a few extra protectors! Neat how it comes with a frame to place over the phone to make sure it goes on straight! -BUT- I do not care for these screen protectors at all. They do not cover the entire screen, leaving glass exposed which is now scratched. (at top near speaker.) The edges of the screen protector have CHIPPED... and I’ve not dropped my phone (yet). I now try to be careful about putting my phone in a pocket or purse with change or objects that could scratch it, as that is the only thing I can attribute the chips around the edge to. I have a FULL phone case coming this afternoon from amazon.

There is definitelly a significant signal booster with this case. I was used to getting 2 to 3 bars from my house. Now its always at 4 or 5 full bars of signal. One downside to this case is that its more slippery than the phone itself. I had to learn to balance the phone in my fingers. But i cant remove a star from that because pong has the other thicker case. So just know this is the sleek slippery case. ****Update**** went from 5 stars to 3 stars. The case was made to be a sealed shut fit. i used my nails, pen, keys, eventually a screw driver and scratched my phone getting this case off. Way To Go!!!

Everything I read affirmed this phone to be one of the best dual sim phones on the market. When I received the phone it only had a single sim tray. I returned the phone and am waiting the refund. I then went down to Best Buy and bought the phone after verifying the dual sim tray. The down side is that I needed to down load an app for everything to work. An app for the dual sim, connecting with my computer, playing music etc. It should have had these from the factory. I like the phone and it has better reception than my last phone. Only had it for a couple weeks, still learning.

This is the second time I've purchased this product. You get what you pay for. The first time I purchased was about 2 years ago. The charger was working perfectly fine up until a year into use. I noticed they have a 2 year warranty so I contacted the seller and they replaced my charger. Excellent customer service. Then after a few more months the replaced charger died. I contacted the seller. They issued a refund instead of replacing the item. I was satisfied with customer service, but still out of a charger. I went a few weeks without a charger. I really wanted a replacement so I bought another charger for the second time. Technically this is my 3rd charger from this company. But only the second one I've had to purchase. Anyway, 3 months in and the 3rd charger is dead, again. I wanted to contact the company but I rather not. After 3 attempts of getting a charger that last more than a year, I decided its best I try another company. They get 3 stars bc customer service is great and bc I was able to get some charging in.

It was good for the little while I had it. It had this unremovable stain of grease on the screen that you couldn't see it of having a quick glance, was about the size of a fingerprint. Tried to take it off with the cleaning supplies but nothing. And the size of the screen protector was a little to big and stuck out.... I moved my hand across a door and it got caught and broke my protector.... Didn't need much force to break it. It did good I guess for what it was. But very flimsy and it started to peel off my watch after a week or so. I've inly had my protector for about 2 weeks or so.

Got one of these for free when I got my S-6 Edge +. Not real impressed, first one I had would not charge for more than 5 minutes before it cut out. Took it back and exchanged it for a white one. Worked a little better but still cut out a lot. Tried it with and without a case. Put paper between it and the phone (forum suggestion), nothing worked good. Went to the Samsung Genius at BB, not a lot of help other than he told me it was a known issue. Since last software upgrade seems to be better but still not trouble free. Bought the Pleson one on Amazon for less than 1/2 the suggested price and it works 100% better. Even when this works it won't charge past 93%

The item is advertised as a "premium" cable. I expected a premium cable to charge my iPhone 4s at a full 1.0 amp charge rate. That's not happening. Received 5 cables. All cables fit a 30 pin connector on an iPhone 4s. Cables have been working for the past three months. They seem sturdy enough. No issues with cables breaking. I used an inline charge meter to test these cables with a couple different Anker chargers I have. With the battery of my 4s under 50%, all five cables could only charge my device at 0.8 amps. When I used a three foot long Monoprice 28/24 AWG micro usb cable with a 30 pin adapter, the charge rate increased to 0.95 - 1.0 amps at 5.0 volts. My conclusion is that this cable is approximately 16-20% slower than a decent cable from Monoprice. I haven't done a teardown of this cable, which I'm tempted to do, but the conclusion that I draw from this test is that the power conductor wires in the cable are possibly undersized if you need a full charge rate of 1.0 amps. If time is not of the essence and you're happy charging at 0.8 amps then the cable is fine. I certainly wouldn't call this a "premium" product, as the title describes it. I had a hard time deciding between 2 or 3 stars. But for the claim that this was a premium cable I would have rated the product as three stars. There is a one star penalty for creating an expectation and not meeting it. That said, I've used these cables for overnight charging for three months and they still work. I'll likely continue to use them for overnight charging though I do wish I had purchased something different in retrospect.

I'm an artist who uses a Cintiq and other Wacom products in my studio daily; I'm writing this mostly for other artists who are shopping around. Bottom line: Pogo's new pen is just a step away from using a standard iPad stylus. I bought the pen mostly for the "you can keep your hand on the screen while drawing" selling point, but apparently my usual pen drawing position (which lifts my hand off from time to time for brush strokes) causes a break from apps quite a bit. Yes, if you can keep your brush pressed to the screen, remove your hand, then remove the brush, it will work as promised (it won't notice your hand). I just ended up shifting canvases around a lot with my palm. The connectivity seemed ok - hard to tell aside from Pogo's app as none of the apps I used ever confirmed I was connected to any pen or device. There were drop outs where I had to quit back to the Pogo pen app to make sure it was reconnected. It's not like the Adonit with the plastic disc point; you will be using the big soft crayon tip again which obscures precision. And it's not going to act like a Wacom pen and give you any sort of *subtle* shifts in pressure. If you think of it in five stages (light, medium, heavy, heavier, heaviest!) that's about what you'll be getting out of the pen for levels of sensitivity. So, is it solving the iPad's lack of pen pressure problem? No. I'd recommend for curious gadget heads only at this point. (I tried this with Brushes, Sketchbook, Procreate and Zen Brush)

I gave it a 4 star because I've only had the case for a few weeks and the color/design is fading where the crease is. The material is a little stiff so it does make it hard to fold in half while I am talking on the phone. I wear make up and it does get on the screen so where my cards rest against my screen I get lines. They do come out with an eye glasses wipe so no worries there. I am very satisfied with my purchase and I would definitely buy it again. I have been using this case for over a month now and the color on the fold is coming off.

I just purchased this phone recently and for the amount of features and options that come with phone the manual is pretty much useless. They might as well not even give you one. There are certain features that I have no clue what they do, whether or not it would be better for me to change them of turn them off etc. Battery definetily could last longer. Does anybody know how to clear out the alarm clock so I can start entering new times. After you enter 5 times you can't enter anymore and I am not sure how to erase them so I can start entering new times again.

The stand is really nice and charges my Pixel 5, Pixel Buds and Fossil smart watch with some minor caveats. It comes with a really short cable and I ended up ordering a cable to plug it in where I needed to. If you're plugging it in next to a bed or somewhere where the power outlet isn't almost exactly next to it, you'll need a longer cable. The smart watch charging slot is sized for iPhones but if you have a Fossil watch like me you can order a small ring adapter from Shapeways.com to get a snug fit.

I've had this case for 6 months now. Here are my pros and cons. Pros: -This case can hold 7 cards including an ID. This was something that was difficult for me to find. -The phone can still fit in my pocket. -Does not negatively impact the fingerprint scanner or cameras. -Has two small pouches by the cards for money. -Stays shut when you want it shut. Cons: -Can feel a bit too bulky. Feels more like a wallet than a phone. -The edges of the case have started to fray. -Not easy to prop on its side to watch videos. -No phone protection. I've damaged my screen several times.

I consulted Samsung sales support before purchasing this item to confirm whether it supports two sim cards in USA and I was assured that it does. On receiving items it was found that it doesn't support dual SIM. I contacted Samsung sales team again and they asked me to try few things which didn't not work, they however were still convinced that it supports two sims. Eventually when they couldn't resolve the issue they asked me to contact their technical support team, adding that they can remotely enable the feature. I contacted technical team, only to find out that it can't be done. Technical team confirmed that phone does have all necessary hardware to support it but it is not supported in USA for reasons that they didn't know. Phone looks sturdy and good however phone switch using Samsung smart switch app didn't work for me when used with Google Pixel 5 phone.

NO instructions, not even a web site, but there were ample alerts in the reviews to plan on using You Tube. The reviewer who said beware of small screws, wasn't kidding! They're about 1/3 the size of a grain of rice. My 75+ year old eyes were significantly challenged, but I did prevail. I strongly advise the use of a white pillow case for a work bench or table top cover so you can spot those little suckers if you happen to miss. Ended up using a refrigerator magnet as a sweeper to find one that landed on my tile floor. The other issue was getting the bottom-most ribbon cable connector to snap into the receiver. Worked on it for over an hour, called it a night, and tried again the next morning. I used the old screen's connector to test the integrity of the receiver, no problem there. It appeared there was a piece of material on the connector plug that was preventing it from seating fully down into the receiver. Using a small exacto knife I carefully scraped as much as I dared, and one more hour later had success. Other than that challenging issue the quality was what I would have expected. Everything else has worked as advertised,

[[VIDEOID:f4263ab9702d1028df03b9421fbd8312]] Very compact design and it works well, but there is a learning curve. The instructions take some time to go through. Creative way to show how much battery power is left in it. The weakest part is the corresponding app. All the photos and video were taken on that software and it flipped the images. Frustrating. I’m going to play with it and see how much functionality I may loose using my native camera app. I have an iPhone 13 Pro Max and with a case, it barely fits into the phone holder. If you need something like this, go for this one, just keep in mind you will need to work with it until you understand what everything does.

Expensive for a lighted phone case that does not protect the phone from damage. The lights are nice, they effectively distribute light to take clear and bright photos at night. I've also purchased the small square light that plugs into the charger hole and although it wasn't as effective, still provided a similar effect for much less and allowed me to also use my phone case. For this price, I wish it accomplished both of what I wanted--a durable case to protect my iPhone AND well distributed light to take nice photos in the dark. Honestly, the times i would want to use it are the same times my phone probably needs extra protection from damage.

Honestly, this bag looks better in the pic than in person. I bought it for a cool change up to my normal, everyday crossbody. What I was expecting was more quality. Just remember, you often get what you pay for. The canvas is sturdy and the pockets are great. They lost it in the details. The belt-like decoration on the bottom of the bag became a nuisance very quickly as somehow or another the metal prong that pokes through the belt and rests against the buckle got lodged on the backside of the buckle. I first chalked it up to a fluke and it was very hard to get back into place. These are metal parts and are not flexible. But then it happened again. I still cannot figure out how it happens as it is REALLY hard to correct when it does. That aside, the leather-like details of this bottom belt and the brand on the flap and the zipper pull are all very cheap. I have had products before with fake "leather" details and some are fine and well done, others are not. This bag could have left off these leather details and been a very good basic canvas crossbody...but then again, I was looking for those details and probably wouldn't have bought it in the first place! Go figure! Bottom line, move on to a better option.

Received three screen protectors as advertised. If you have a steady hand and a completely dust free space these are easy to put on. I had neither. It's hard to get it on straight the first time and keep any dust from getting under the protector. I got away with only about 3 or 4 tiny specs of dust which caused a tiny bubble. Not really a big deal,you can't see it when the screen is on. They fit the screen of my Acer Iconia a1-840 well with the cutout for the camera. I can't blame them for my lack of patience and unsteady hands.

Its a decent looking case but the build quality is not good at all. I’ve had this case for about a month and the back is full of tiny scratches and the paint on the side is getting chipped. I havent put it to rough use though. Its been in my pocket, and on the desk and maybe only once it has falled from my desk on the floor and the sides already chipped from that. I’ve had other Tech21 cases and they’ve been great, but this one is cheaper both in price and quality. I’d just spend a little more and buy the old one i had but i cant find that one on amazon.

It's nice and clear and probably provides good protection against blunt force trauma. So far it seems scratch resistant but it had a small from the factory on the underside so once it was installed you can see it under the glass. The only real issue I have with it though is the lack of sensitivity of the touch screen after installing this protector. You have to noticeably push harder to type and click on the screen with this screen protector compared to other types. It slows down your typing speed and causes many more mistakes because of missed touches. I may go with a different brand or go back to the stick on vinyl film protection I've used in the past.

Anti glare is great, so is the tint from the sides. Unfortunately this screen protector DOES NOT WORK with some, maybe all, phone cases. I have an otter box because I'm accident prone, when I put the case back on its causing it to bow up and create a permanent air bubble. Which makes the lower 1/3 of my screen very difficult to use. You have to MASH the buttons for them to work. Very disappointed. If you are someone who doesn't use a phone case, this does cover a high percentage of the screen and I would recommend it for you.

Product was easy to install, and fits decently. However I am missing the adhesive strip that helps seat the display for a better result. My Touch ID worked once I moved the original home button to this screen, however it doesn't sit as well and has some slop once installed in this screen, I think that's mostly due to needing to break the adhesive bond on the rubber boot to transfer it over to the replacement screen. As far as quality goes, the front facing camera supplied with the screen seems to be about the same as the original: but I never used it much so take that with a grain of salt. The screen however is noticeably worse than the original, and frustratingly doesn't auto dim like the original (but maybe it could if the original earpiece and camera assembly were transferred over). The resolution seems to be worse than the original display as well. It seems like regular text and most images have this fuzzy edge around them unlike the original display. If I knew this before I bought the display I likely would have saved my money and gone with a higher end replacement, (I suspect the display from iFixit would have been better) but unfortunately it seems it is difficult to know what quality you are getting unless you get it from Apple (Sad since I'd think some of their original suppliers might be selling surplus displays at this point) Frankly despite the price, with all the positive reviews on this product I was hoping to get something of higher quality, to the point where the display quality wouldn't be obviously inferior in just everyday use.

The case works to keep the Iphone XS secure even when the top flap is open and the case rotates 180 degrees. There are two main issues I have found with this case: 1. The magnetic clasp pulls out of the flap in-time causing the flap not to close. 2. The plastic ratchet on the rear of the case can break and snaps out of place when the unit is caught on a seat belt or other. I am on my 5th case because I have not found a replacement case that snugly holds the Iphone in the case as well as this one even when the flap is not secure. The case has a reasonable cost and I find it lasts for 6 to 12 months with nominal use.

I give this case three stars because…like all the other reviews I read before I bought this one, the design is chipping off. When I took it out of the package, I noticed right in the middle of the blue, some of the finish was missing. Also, around the edges by the buttons the blue finish began to wear off right away. Luckily for me, I have girls and lots of nail polish in any color you could imagine. So, being a resourceful Mom, I grabbed a blue polish that matched the color on the case and painted over all the edges that were rubbing off and filled in the missing spots as well. So, bottom line. I really love the owl look. The colors are so brilliant (shame they don't have better staying power!) but it's an eye catching case, something a bit different from most of the other iPhone cases I am seeing right now. The price is right. Just be aware that unless you have an extensive collection of nail polish to touch it up with now and then, this may not be the case for you!

New battery will not show charge icon with lightning bolt, animating battery charging g shows for several hours, and it charges but later it states the battery is fully charged and to unplug it.
