There are a few notes I'd like to make about the product though. -The connection isn't the most reliable. Sometimes my device wouldn't recognize that it's connected to the MHL adapter and I'd have to unplug it and plug it in again a few times before being able to use it. -The plug requires power. Haven't tried any other plugs so I can't say much here, but I did find it to be somewhat annoying that it is required. -Subtitles aren't streamed from the HTC One to the connected device. I like to watch foreign shows and use English subtitles. I haven't found a way to make them show up yet (using MX player) The overall build quality of the connector is great. I carry it around in my pocket and have had no issues with it for the past 2 months.

I loved how this case looked on my phone. I liked the squared off corners and the lime green color. I wasn’t quite sure how well it would protect my phone, since it didn’t seem to sit very high above the screen. I decided to take a chance because I loved how it looked. I got lots of compliments, but sadly, the case was dirty within a month or two. I tried a magic eraser, wipes (both alcohol & disinfecting) and nothing took the dark marks out. A different color, that is a bit darker, might be the solution, but the lime green is what won me over. I was saddened to see it look crummy in such a short time.

Unfortunately, it didn't work on my Pixel 6. I wish that it had. The lens doesn't sit flush with the phone camera lens due to the camera bump and ridge on the case around the camera lenses. This causes severe Vignetting and distortion. It may have worked if I took off the case, but I'm not going to do that every time I want to use it. The description does say that it's compatible with all smart phones, but not with every case and not this one.. It's also larger and heavier than I imagined. It adds a good deal of weight to the phone.

Fits my Pixel 5a well and hasn't inhibited the sensitivity of my touch screen at all, but the first one I installed cracked within 2 weeks of installation. The biggest point of apparent damage is right next to the side lock button where there's a small chunk of protector shattered/missing, which is weird because the lip of my case is right there and extends past the protector, so should have prevented a direct strike onto anything other than something pointy from an elevation or with force (which I would have noticed happening), and crack extends up to the top, so the whole corner is compromised and now lifting. I haven't seen a drop or anything that should have caused this failure. The surface is also scratched in several places, so not super durable - it hasn't been exposed to anything extreme - just normal carry in purse, pocket, etc. I hope the second one in the pack lasts longer than 2 weeks.

I read the reviews and asked questions on Amazon to help me figure this out. You have an hdmi plug, a USB plug (which on my TV is the AV outlet), and the other plug goes into the Galaxy Note 3. Basically, I wanted to love this phone, however, the one that I received was full of bugs. First off if u tried to use the navi wheel all of the keys (except for the power button for some reason) would lock up until you reset the phone. This would also happen at random times. Also, when I first booted the camera i got an image for about a second before the image went black and never came back. I ended up returning the phone on the same day I got it. I guess the build quality is pretty good though.

I initially loved my case, however, I realized that it didn't work well with the protective screen cover that was already applied to my phone. The screen cover made it difficult to push the icons on the screen. I tried removing and reattaching the screen cover, but ultimately it became too frustrating to use. I tried using it without the screen cover, but that doesn't work and I ultimately cracked a piece of the very thin plastic on the screen cover and had to trash the whole case. I have now purchased a similar item that does not have its own screen cover.

This was the first screen protector I used when I got my watch. I liked how easy they were to install, the downside for me was that they only lasted around two weeks before they started peeling up on the corners and once that started there was no way to reattach it and it was only a matter of time before it was gone. I have had difficulty with the phone. I cannot make any calls or send text messages. I see a message (not registered on the network), when I try to place a call. I contacted Tracfone for support and was on my land line phone for nearly two hours. Turn phone off, turn phone back on, do factory reset, and nothing worked. I've attached two pictures here. The first shows two onion root tips on a microscope slide taken with the Apexel APL-MS009. The second I took holding my phone up to the eyepiece of a compound light microscope (10x eyepiece and 10x objective). Clearly, the Apexel phone attachment is not coming close to the 100x magnification that it advertises. That is an important reality for a consumer to understand. It is easy to attach to my Pixel 4a (5G) phone. That said, I also found it easy to bump the lens so that I had to recenter it on my phone's camera. I would have appreciated a way to lock the lens in place once I had it positioned. The LED light was helpful but limited in that it could only be turned on or off, not dimmed. The piece that attaches to the phone is sturdy. While it has a place where it can be attached to a tripod, I find it hard to imagine that it would be useful since the instructions indicate that the lens has to be 5.4 mm to 6.8 mm from the object to be in focus. Does this magnify things? Yes. Does it magnify things 100x? Definitely not. This could be used to take extra zoomed in photos of things that move little or not at all, but I would be disappointed if I had paid the $40 list price for this.

I just took this light on a one week vacation, and used it as the key light for my YouTube channel. Check out the screen capture uploaded in this review. The camera used on this video was an Osmo Pocket, attached to my iPhone XS Max. The light is a nice brightness. No, it won't overcome mid-day sun, but it works well enough for most indoor situations, and gets bright enough outdoors. The ring light produces a pleasant catch light in the subject's eyes. The stand is decent enough, and adequately holds the ring light. It's adjustable by twisting open and twisting tight. The ring light also has a cold shoe on top, which is a convenient place to mount an external microphone. You can select from three light temperatures on the control pendant, ranging from approximately 3800K to 4800K. This controller is also where you set the brightness of the ring light, and turn it off and on. The actual clamp and phone mount is less than sturdy. The gooseneck mount is very easily overloaded, and this results in your entire rig slowly falling. Anything more than a small smartphone will overwhelm this mount. Additionally, the way it attaches to the stand is a simple and ineffective knob/clamp. I ended up replacing this whole assembly with a SmallRig clamp and small adjustable arm, and this worked MUCH better. Again, see the photos. My need to replace the clamp cost this review 2 stars. The light is powered via a USB plug that can be inserted into a wall wart and plugged into A/C mains, or what I do is connect it to a power bank, which makes things very portable. All told, this is a lightweight, very portable, and useful lighting setup.

Purchased this as wife wanted something that was simple and "cute" just to hold phone upright on computer desk. This was exactly that, and a lower price (why it got 2 stars instead of 1). I really liked that is does have different grooves on the chair, to hold the phone at different angles as you prefer. However, as soon as I unboxed it, 2 of the 4 chair legs, just fell out. They seemed to not even be glued or secured at all which was very disappointing. It only took a couple drops wood glue to get this back together and once that was completed it's extremely sturdy. But considering the packaging wasn't damaged at all from shipper, I would expect it to hold together on it's own out of the box. I was not expecting much at all,

I bought this case expecting the case, a screen guard, mircofiber pouch bag and case opener. I recieved the case and a screen guard. I did NOT recieve the microfiber pouch bag or the case opener. I'm upset that I decided on THIS case because of all of the extras and didn't recieve them. So don't pay more for this fictional set if you can buy just the case cheaper from someone else. I am very happy with the case. I was afraid it would look big and bulky on my nice thin light phone but it looks great! It has a great feel to it also, not plasticy, but nice and smooth. This is a great case but don't pay extra for extras you won't get anyway.

I had to get rid of this band after about 2 months. It fit fine, was durable and comfortable, looked nice... But the smell from my wrist had become intolerable. I'm a runner, and perhaps it's due to my sweat getting into the leather, or maybe from frequent hand washing (I'm in the medical field), or both ( or neither). But I noticed after a month a musty smell coming from my wrist. Cleaning the underside of the watchband only mitigated it temporarily, it always returned within a day. By two months the smell was often noticable from about a foot away (for instance sitting at my desk I would get a waft of the smell). I had to change bands back to the original set and so far so good.

The wallet part of the case is great! Cute design, flips up easily and feels very secure when it’s fastened shut. Cards are easy to slide in and out. The huge flaw, which is ultimately why I’m returning, is in the lip that’s supposed to protect your front screen. The case doesn’t really snap into place… it’s tight and when you push your phone into it, there are certain spots where the screen sticks out more. It’s almost like I can’t fit the top right so the lip doesn’t completely cover the entire top. I’m too clumsy to risk not having my phone completely protected so I’ll unfortunately be returning it.

I just want to note that this is my third purchase of this screen protector over the course of 14 months. Installation is flawless every time, thanks to the wonderful tools provided. The extra layer of glass hasn't reduced my overall touch sensitivity, it's smooth and really wears like a second-skin. This was the best protector I had ever come across, until it wasn't. You see, I confidently installed a fresh screen for the third go round, and upon the first drop, I was thrilled to see that the screen PROTECTOR was 100% intact. My actual phone screen, on the other hand, is ruined. I have to say, wow. The impact was enough to shatter my phone's screen and leave the screen protector completely untouched. What a conundrum. Now, I'm terrified to remove the protection out of fear of permanently rendering my screen useless. The crack has breached where the screen protector seals, causing bubbles, and now cracks, in the protective glass. Screen protector: $12.00 Insurance claim to replace phone screen: $225.00 That feeling you get when your phone screen shatters, but your screen protector doesn't: Priceless.

*Update 9/11/2020* Customer service through TechMatte was very helpful and is sending us two warranty replacement protectors which is fantastic. That said, while waiting for the replacement, my fiance's phone fell out of his pocket and the protector did not protect the screen. It started with a line across the screen and shortly followed with full discoloration. He has a case as well. *Update 9/4/2020* After only a few short months of having these on our phones, both have cracked. Unfortunately, the protector is not very durable. I will be reaching out to amFilm customer service and I will update again with how they respond We purchased this to use on two phones. We watched the video beforehand and then again as we were doing the installation. We both had a bubble that had to be pushed out and we were worried it would mess up the adhesion but it didn't! Once cured, both fingerprint readers worked with the fingerprints that had already been registered. No issues with dust but we were very careful about getting both screens nice and clean! The only complaint is that the speaker protection sticker failed on one and we had to use a pin to get adhesive out of the speaker. Fortunately, it does not seem to have caused any damage to the phone. I would recommend people be very nitpicky about making sure the sticker is actually stuck to the speaker to prevent any adhesive from getting in there. Overall, awesome and well worth the price!

Sold mount that stays in place and I love how clean it looks-- no cables to plug in or droop from the charger. Works very well in my Acura TL with the power port on the center console. However, I retract one star for: - The locking mechanism doesn't work well, and eventually broke after a few months. I just leave it unlocked, and the phone has never fallen out of the mount. - My bigger issue is that I changed to a thicker iPhone case, and there's no adjustment for the lightning connecter to make sure it works with a case on your phone! I hate this, and have to take my case off when I get in the car. If they had an adjustable lightning connector, or different sized buffer pads, it would be a five star product.

This phone not bad, the screen looks good, it's relatively fast considering it was running an older SOC when it came out. Having 128GB of storage is amazing for audio content. The sound quality is good. The Camera does an acceptable job. When I bought the phone, it had ad's, but those have been removed by Amazon. Since the Android 8 update, performance lags at times. I suspect the performance lags also affect GPS position updates which can lag. It's interesting that the maps application will lag, but if I run another tool to monitor the GPS position sensor itself, things seem fine. I would avoid buying this LG G6+ Prime Exclusive phone in the future is that the bootloader cannot be unlocked and Second, you're in no mans land for software updates. Look at the question for this phone related to security updates - LG claims the carrier has to authorize/approve updates. This isn't a carrier phone and as such should get the unlocked software updates. But it's an Amazon phone that has Amazon content so Amazon has to release security updates specifically for this devices. There hasn't been security updates released since September 2018. When I contacted Amazon tech support, the response was to point me at the US Cellular version of this phone which has updates as recently as February 2019, however, those updates do not apply to this phone because it's an Amazon Prime Exclusive. When contacting LG, they tell me that I should get updates OTA when they're available, and that's the extend of their help. Moral of the story... Spend the extra money and buy the unlocked, NON prime edition of the phone.

Issues with sensitivity. Feel glass could do the job, but due to adhesive issues, it affects how much pressure you have to apply. Sides are coming off so need extra pressure for touch screen. Bubbly cracking sound when applying pressure. Glass is actually slid down since application last week. Disappointed, really wanted to work. Used same for my samsung tablet and worked great. Wanted to give them benefit of doubt going against past reviews. Says to email issues, but unable to locate where to. Will be probably returning this one. Update: Found an email contact and contacted the company and informed what had happened. They were cordial and gladly sent another protector. Stated may have received a defective one. FYI the adhesive is around the edges, none on middle of screen. The black part is where adhesion is. When applied correctly this works for an S7 if you are not using a case. Realized what was going on after applied second one. With the first one application was easy, so was the second one. It stayed on and looked great. Left it like this for several days. Issues began as soon as I put the phone in the case. This is not case friendly protector. The tempered glass is curved slightly and dips down with the screen of S7. If the case you have encroaches on the curve part it will put pressure on tempered glass and eventually will push edges off and loosen the adhesion and cause issues listed above. The company itself was helpful, but the screen is not case friendly. Went to using a flat film versus a tempered glass. Have had more success w/ flat film that does not drop off the edge.

First off, there don't seem to be too many reviews for these lens protectors. I'm sure they are all owned by the same parent company. In any case, how are they? this item came with 2 protectors. They were sealed in a little plastic container that was quite difficult to get open, and then, the protectors themselves are so small you have to be very precise when removing the stickers on them. I ended up tearing one of the protectors trying to get the sticker off, and then, I dropped the other one. There wasn't much I could do about it so I just used the dust sticker thing to get rid of whatever I could. Ultimately, I got it on, but it could have been much cleaner. I just wanted my camera to be protected. I don't care about image quality too much as long as it isn't too noticeable. Ultimately I got it on but there is probably some remnants of fingerprint on it, but I'll just live with it.

it is so disappointing to buy a new device and being unable to find a good screen protector. Have owned spigen cases before and been happy. Don't like how the buttons work on this one. I've only had this on my phone for a couple of days so I can't speak to the longevity of the screen protector, but so far it looks great. My only beef with this is the instructions do not match the actual product itself. The instructions say to pull off one protective sheet, apply to the phone, and then pull off a second sheet. I hope they update their instructions so future users don't get as confused as I did.

While this case is sturdy and durable, The detachment case is not , I dropped it once from waist high on the vinyl kitchen floor and it left the removable case looking a lot worse for wear. The magnet is not strong enough to hold the phone in place, which makes it awkward to hold. I was using one of those electric shopping carts and while holding the wallet open trying to get my debit card out, the phone side was heavier so it flipped to that side and my phone fell out face down in the cart. Needless to say it busted my screen, luckily I keep a glass screen protector on my phone so it busted that screen and not my actual screen. The magnet is just not strong enough to hold the weight of the phone. This is not my first wallet phone case. I’ve been using different ones since they became a “thing”, years ago. I usually buy them based on color/design. But I’ll never buy another one from here again.

I thought this case would look nice with my phone but it instead attaches to the color in a way that makes it look like its “wet”. I wouldn’t have minded this if it was consistant through out the phone, but it is only in some areas. Attached is another case I had that does not do this to my phone for reference. I do like how thin it is compared to my original case. I think this case works best on iPhones colors that are silver or black.. thinking of returning this case based on the price point and disappointment of the look on my red XR

Like: that it went on super easy and didn’t affect touch screen capabilities. Dislike: I bought a new iPhone 11 in July, purchased the screen protector on July 10, on August 8 (less than a month later), I dropped it (with a hard, durable case on as well) at a gas station and it shattered the protector, phone case AND my screen. Luckily I had Asurian insurance with Verizon wireless and only had to pay $29 for a new screen but that was a major hassle and just as of yesterday They replaced the screen. I am buying a new protector now and it will not be these since they did not work.

It's a good phone, my whole family like xiaomi phones, we have 4 redmi note pro 8, 1 redmi note pro 9, I want to play game so I bought this new one....everything is good but that tiny defect brought my attention when I started checking wand see if there's any scratch on the body....then...here we go....I found it right away after I opened the box....so I am wondering is that a factory defect or ......this item was been re-sealed to pretend like a new one....and I posted question with seller....not responding, but amazon told me to return it...maybe I should do that...sad....need to reset everything all over again.

Looked nice at first. But the finish is beginning to wear off after only two days. I'll post up a photo. It's not extreme, and mostly where it goes through the clasp. It's only been a few days and I didn't expect the finish to wear off so easily. It's also a struggle to put on. Firstly, the clasp side is very short making it difficult to put on with only one hand. And then you have to thread the magnetic clasp through the metal slot, and of course, the magnet is fighting you the entire time, trying to attach to the metal band. Once it's on, it looks nice and is comfortable to wear. But after three days, it's gone into the draw, I'm returning to the apple band.

We love battery charging cases and the ones that we have ordered in the past did not disappoint. This one, however, only lasted a few weeks. We purchased the cheapest one we could find and that is probably our problem. We ended up ordering a different, more expensive one, 1 month later. The top part of the case broke off within a few days. My son just kept trying to use it but it was a hassle as the top was constantly falling off. So, finally ordered a new one. I wish I would have looked into getting a refund first but now our time has past.

The stiff rubber case very durable and I have no fear about banging my watch against things. The negative part is the band is also very rugged and stiff and wants to stay round when a wrist isn't a perfect sphere. The rash shown was caused by the sliding part mostly that holds the end of the band down along with digging into your skin. I have other red spot rashes from the rest of the band that aren't as bad but still enough were I've stopped wearing my watch. Seriously, you easily have the best product on the market if you just eliminate the awful band. Just because of the band I have to return it and wait to heal before wearing my watch again.

It was not very easy to install and develops air bubbles even after being placed. Over all it worked well keeping my screen protected, but it scratches easily. Also I got a little water on it, though the phone is "water resistant" it allowed water right underneath the protector causing the adhesion to loosen, replaced it with another one that also got air bubbles even after rubbing them all out. They are hard to clean too I dropped my phone in some dirt and wiped the screen clean even used water to get the dirt off and it constantly seemed to stay dirty. Positive side was that even though it scratched it seemed to be a tough product never did the scratches reach my screen, it doesn't peel easily off like some of the cheaper models, stays put where you leave it. I was happy with the protection but seemed like I went through one every month due to how easily it becomes scratched I use a stylus and it seemed to scratch the protector even though it never did it on the regular screen.

The girl thinks this case looks like what she would want if she had a phone. Since she plays with my old one all the time, I put it on that phone and so far, it has been working great. She thinks she is extra important. She is not quite a teen, but looks like one and is tall enough to be one and she wants to have what others have. The phone the case is on, is only set up for wifi, so it is not anything she gets to take anywhere but she can watch her favorite videos and watch streaming movies - and that makes her happy. Oh, I also put a tempered glass screen protector on this phone, which.has had more than one screen protector. This way, I know the screen is going to be safer.

I have used this rocker intermittently over the past several months and it was worked great. Sometimes I found I had to flip my phone upside down for it to log steps, but there were days I'd log over 50km on Pokémon GO. However, it has recently stopped rocking back and forth as much and no longer logs very many steps. I will maybe get 5 km after 8 hours. Also, it can be very noisy due to the phone not fitting snuggly in the cradle. To remedy this, I attached a rubber band vertically from the top ball to one at the base of the phone cradle. This keeps the phone in place and rocking completely silent.

This case fits really well, the kickstand is strong enough to hold the phone AND the camera cover clicks into both opened and closed positions. I was hoping to be able to use the kickstand as a hand holder since my hands are small and I’m still getting used to this new phone. Unfortunately due to the square shape and the metal kickstand it is very uncomfortable to hold this way. I was going to deduct a star or two due to this but I noticed that the listing never claimed that you can use it as a handhold so that is on me for assuming such. Wish I had chosen the teal instead of the army green but maybe I’ll just get a new one in a few months time.

I purchased an iPhone 6 Plus recently, and wanted to protect it. Unfortunately, many of the usual-suspect case makers had yet to offer cases for the 6 Plus. After doing some research, I decided on the Spigen Neo Hybrid Metal case. The case was easy to assemble on the 6 Plus, despite the fact that the "directions" drawings were pathetic. The case appears to be well-made and designed. It adds minimal bulk to an already big phone. The case buttons also function well, and the openings tor the lightning charger and speaker are properly placed. Without dropping the phone, there is no way to know how much protection it really offers. Now for the bad news.....The Spigen website lists no contact phone number. They have an internal website e-mail function. I had a question regarding potential interference with the iPhone 6 Plus antenna. I sent my question to Spigen and never heard back from them. Ten days later, I sent the question again. Once again, I never heard back from them. Although this appears to be a quality product, I will never purchase a Spigen product of any kind again. Companies that ignore their customers don't deserve to have customers.

I personally love the wallet type of cell phone cases. It eliminates the need for a purse when going out and it's nice to have in my pocket at the hospital for when I go to lunch or down to the coffee shop without having to run back to my locker. This case is made of a sturdy and, what seems to be, quality leather. The colors are nice and rich. I really like the two tones on the back! The part that holds your phone is sufficient. All ports and buttons are accessible. The reason for the 4 star rating is because normally when I've purchased similar cases in the past, they are designed in such a way that you can use the case as a stand to have the phone in a landscape position. This case does not allow for that. Note: I received this product at a promotional rate in exchange for my honest and unbiased review. All the opinions are my own. If you have any questions about the product, feel free to ask and if this review was, in any way, helpful, please let me know by hitting the helpful button.

I bought this for my iPhone 11 and it fits great. PROS: – Magnetic chargers hold on to this case well and it doesn’t fall off my dashboard in my truck even though this is not a MagSafe phone – the clear case seems to be staying clear and has avoided many scratches – charging cables fit great – Inductive charging work with the case on the phone – fits well with edge to edge glass screen protection CONS: - the buttons are very difficult to push – this case is slippery, don’t take it skiing and try to hold it on with your gloves or wet hands, (or even dry hands for that matter). I would like some texture along the long edges where you hold the phone, or some rubber inserts similar to the Speck grip series. – the lips that protects the screen could be a good bit taller . I’ve had this for two months and I’ve already cracked two screensavers glass protectors.

So here's the thing. This phone case is beautiful. I'm kind of thinking it doesn't really deserve 3 stars. My main problem is that it's advertised to have drop protecting. The entire case including the corners is just above paper thing. The case is beautiful. The color is nice. The rhinestones are, for the most part placed in adequately. A couple are wonky but I could deal with that if the case offered real protection. It doesn't fit the frame of the phone the way a quality case would. I'm more than likely going to send it back. I know it's a "cheap" case. But there are plenty of cases on Amazon for $11 that offer more than enough protection. I was drawn to the pretty of the case and it didn't work out.

Only a cpl concerns. The screen protector fell off after a cpl weeks. No directions came for where to attach the lanyard. I had to go thru the pics of the cases on Amazon to figure it out and the only one where it actually shows is the pic of the red and black case. The description that comes with the case is misleading as it shows rhe extra clip and swivel clip and i thought i was missing peices till my hubby said he didn't order the extra parts. Other then that, love the white and turquoise color, the sturdiness of it, the kick stand and the length of the long lanyard. Great product worth the price! And a perfect fit for my LG K30!

I haven't really used it yet, I tested it in a sink just to see if it worked. My phone is waterproof so I didn't pay a lot of attention to the seal although it seams fine. My S21 in its Otterbox fit with no problem. I was able to use the screen while in the case and it has a clear spot for the camera that didn't appear to interfere with the image. It floated well which was my biggest concern since we are doing some water activities on vacation in a few weeks. Even if it doesn't last long the price is right to just replace it.

I really loved this case until the kickstand broke. I'm so sad, the little nipples broke off and now the entire kickstand it's worthless. You'd think by now they would use something other than tiny little plastic nipples to hold these in there. I know I can repair it using paper clips, but I don't know if I want to put out the effort for it. I will miss the this case. Maybe customer service can step up and get a replace out. It's not like I abused it. Just regular use. One day it just snapped apart. Oh well. If you decide to buy it, just know it won't last forever.

Bad Experience: However, I also have a bad experience that I'd like to quote. I ordered the same phone on a Friday morning. I chose 1-day shipping option that costed $8.99 expecting it to arrive on Saturday. I had plans to deliver this gift to someone on a Sunday. To my surprise and disappointment, I received an email on Saturday morning that the shipping is delayed and all my plans went astray. This is a serious problem from logistics point of view, as you promise and don't deliver. Either don't provide this option to raise expectations and create a sense of big disappointment later. Good Experience: The product is worth it's price. The product was shipped to me in the estimated time once I re-ordered.

The case itself has a good idea, the durability, sturdiness. However, the screen protector does not work well with the finger print reader and I have to hot my screen harder than normal to hit my keyboard or access my apps. When you're talking on the phone there are no speaker holes in the case to hear through it so you're basically talking into a box and having to hear the other person through it. It has good structure, but for it being 20 bucks it should be better. I ordered a different one because I just don't like how this one is set up.

I loved everything about this product, besides the fact you have to take the phone out of both parts of the case just to be able to use the note 5 stylus, because of the magnets in the wallet part to hold the case in, and then the magnets in the case. The magnets make it had for the phone screen to process and tell where the stylus is and if you use a drawing art app on your phone, such as Medibang Paint, and you try to draw on the app with the case on, the magnets will either stop the stylus from drawing altogether, or will make it draw in a completely different area.

Seven months into ownership the top part of the case has started falling off, making the case useless. The case itself is bulky, but did provide good protection from a couple of falls. Each time I dropped the phone, the case entirely detached itself from the phone. However, it seems the case does not survive the falls. Update 5/15/2014 After writing the above review, I stuck the top part (the bezel) to the phone using double sided sticky tape, and it has pretty much stayed there. Several falls have not dislocated it, but the back came off each time - no damage to the phone. Today the phone fell out of my pocket while no less than 8 feet up on a ladder, straight onto a concrete floor. All the pieces of the case came apart, but the phone was unharmed. Amazing. I would like to give it more stars for the protection, but fewer for the fit.

I bought this for my iPhone 6 & it worked great! My old phone survived many falls with that case. So when I finally upgraded to a iPhone 11, I bought this case. But I was so disappointed because this case did not fit my phone adequately. The side buttons stick out a lot which caused them to activate the volume & voice/power button. The case itself fits the phone poorly because it feels slightly loose & the side with the screen is flushed so I was afraid my screen would not be at all protected if I dropped it.

The back is phenomenal. It’s cute, sturdy, and feels like it’s actually protecting my phone from my existential clumsiness. The front screen is a whole ‘nother matter. It’s not always flush with the screen, so it can get a little clicky-clacky, it has this weird dot pattern that is obnoxiously obvious in the sunlight, and it scratches up like nobody’s business just through normal use. I’ve attached a picture - nothing crazier than pockets has happened to my phone that would cause this level of scratching. But I can feel it and it interferes with the touch a little bit. Oh, and because it’s not flush with the screen, dirt, dust and dog hair get trapped between the screen cover and my screen. I’ll be buying a replacement, which makes me sad because I LOVE the back. I just wish I could use the back without the front and put a more durable screen film on.

I purchased this phone holder because I thought that it would work well for my Jeep Wrangler and my Colorado. In the Jeep it is a real pain to work with due to the location of the cup holder in relationship with the gear selector and the parking brake handle. In the Colorado it is still not what I would prefer do to the location. I am going to purchase one that mounts on the dash so it is easier to view. For me it is just too dangerous having to look down when you are in traffic. The device also has shims for putting on the legs for larger size cup holders, constantly fall off. I do not recommend this cell phone holder. It is now a display item for my work bench.

First I was aggravated bc no instructions. So I went back to the page where you buy it and theres a video which makes it easy to install. The back panels were a breeze. The front I did exactly as the video showed and just as I had done the back and it ended up just as shown in the picture I posted. I thought it was smudges but no matter what they will not come off. Its scratches. I'm not sure how I got scratches under the top protective layer while I was installing it but when I removed it there they were.

The mount is very stiff sturdy, and it sticks to my dashboard very well. I placed the metal plate on the back of the shell of my OtterBox case, underneath the rubber sleeve, and the magnet holds on to it strong enough that withstands bumps and sharp turns and all that but it still feels a little weak when I press the home button and the phone tilts off the magnet a little. The plate is also really small, exactly the size of the magnet, which makes it a little difficult to place my phone on the magnet when I can't see exactly where the plate is under my case. All in all, it's satisfactory, however, the only thing is, and this doesn't affect my rating, that placing the metal plate on the center of my phone blocks wireless charging. Because of that I'll have to ship it back, but if you don't care wether you charge with a cord or not then go for it.

The mounting tray did no help with putting screen protector on. I HATE the black at the top and bottom. You need the screen on to make sure the black part doesn't cover part of the screen as mine did during application. Thankfully I was able to pull the protector off and realign it with the screen. There are visible lines on each side of the screen protector. I don't know what they are but they are part of the screen. The touch screen seems very responsive so that's good. Also, I use a case and the screen protector doesn't show signs of lifting near the seams.

It was a good case, but the fact i t broke at the veru thinnest part of the phone,with 20 days of me owning it. Not only that I've never dropped my phone. Meaning, it just broke from regular uses like taking it in and out of the case. So the build quality of this particular case is pretty suspect. Because the Edges oddity it may be hard to manufacture, with regards to "sturdy" build quailty. I had the gold one which is like a flimsy matte finish. Very thin. I recommend getting the matte finish version. The extra coating should make this more sturdy. But the gold model just couldn't hang. Rearth is actually know for quality cases. What gave??

Needs compatibility listing. Atrix 4g users ignore this device, the hdmi and usb plugs are reversed and inverted from jacks on Atrix. I'm also a bit disappointed they didn't bother to include a full sized HDMI port on the adapter. there appears to be plenty of room and would certainly make integration easier. I'm sure it works great... but its useless on my phone. 4 of 5 stars for product itself that I'm sure works great for a phone it can actually connect to. And i suppose if you peer at the photo long enough you'd realize the connectors are different. But i shouldn't have to. For that you lose a star Motorola. Will be returning in exchange for a bulky, clunky dock that doesn't work with my case.

The cover casing itself and the mount are actually pretty good. A number of reviewers complained about the unit coming with scratches on the screen protector. You MUST remember to remove the film before installing the phone. My biggest complaint is this cover keeps pressing the volume down button on the side of my phone. My second gripe is that the screen cover bubbles terribly, even after thoroughly cleaning the phone screen. The casing holds the edge of the clear plastic screen protector just barely off the phone at the edges, so full contact is not possible. I may decide to just cut the thing out and solve at least one of the problems.

It's a decent case, it feels nice and premium. It about doubles the thickness of the phone, but it's not too terrible. It seems to get moderately warm during charging, but nothing alarming. The battery does have a higher capacity than the phone, so it more than doubles how much battery life you have. But I have a few quips with it. It charges the phone very slowly, most of the time just barely keeping it at the same level it was at when it started charging. It also emmits this high pitched beeping noise when it's charging the phone, which can be very annoying. I'm considering just switching back to a regular case because it really doesn't help too much. It could help you out in a pickle, but so could a regular portable battery

It's not "Premium Leather", just cheap vinyl, would have expected a little better even for $10.99. I mean cheap enough that you can tell it's not leather just by looking at it, you don't need to touch it. It says something about Amazon and it's vendors though that this sort of blatantly false claim on the product pages is common. Having said that it's not too bad for the money. Fits iPhone 6+ very loosely and really needs a substantial bumper case to fit properly. No padding and no protection if you drop the case with your phone in it on the open end since only the strap closes the opening.

The case is sturdy and feels well built. It fits my iPhone 5S snugly. I like the little lever on the side that connects to the Silence button. I wish the actual silence button was a lever not a switch. There is one big flaw in this case. Since the case blocks the speaker port at the bottom of the phone in order to make it waterproof, the designer cut a hole in the back of the case that is covered with a waterproof mesh to allow the sound to come out. The fact that the case allows the sound out the back instead of the bottom where the actual speaker is causes the sound to bounce around in the case and vibrate it. I tried to ignore it at first but it got so annoying that I had to get rid of this case and switch back to my old case. Bottom line: The case is very well made from a durability point of view. The one flaw is in how it deals with the speaker and sound. I was unable to continue using the case because of the flaw. **Disclaimer: I received this item at a discount, in exchange for a fair and honest review.**

Ordered this for the H810 variant, and was disappointed when after aligning it perfectly, my charger blinked and ceased to work. Now my NFC doesn't work either, even when returning to the previous sticker. For those that say I haven't aligned it properly, I peeled the sticker off the back and used scotch tape to perfectly align the sticker on the contacts while applying decent pressure to the wireless charging contacts. Still, no dice. Will try the QuickCircle case next, hopefully this sticker hasn't somehow permanently damaged my NFC, though not sure how that would be possible. EDIT: Newisdom got in contact with me, and after some impeccable customer service, I learned that a possible source of my problem was that I initially removed the black metallic sticker that came on top of the product. This is a ferrite sticker which serves to increase the transmission power, and is not to be removed. I would recommend not removing this, as it is easily mistaken for packaging, but seems to be fairly critical. Otherwise, they refunded me fully, and I am extremely impressed with the speedy customer service I received.

The case was put together well enough. I had no issue with the quality of the case itself. My issue was that you can put very little in the pockets (cards, cash) before the case was hard to close. I bought this so I wouldn't need to carry a separate wallet, but I need to be able to carry cash as well as cards. My screen protector ended up cracking because of the contents of the pockets... thankfully it was only the screen protector, not the screen itself. I would recommend this if you want to actually have stuff in the pockets... if so, I would go with a case that puts the pocket on the back of the phone...

This is a quality phone wallet - it feels super durable, the material is stitched very well, the velcro closure is really strong. The belt clip and straps are great to keep your phone secured on your body. But... the slot for the side buttons does not align at all with my Samsung A32. What will work is the earbud jack, you can push the phone up a little bit to have that cord running out, above the elastic. It might come in handy for me, it might not - especially since it isn't quite the right fit. I was looking to use something like this while mowing, to keep the airborne dirt out of the cracks & crevices. I don't think this is going to work very well for that purpose.

The shipping on this item was fairly expedient, it came in a bubble envelope. I can't see that it would've provided much protection especially since this item is plastic. For the price I paid for the item itself it was worth it, however not worth the money in shipping costs. This is definitely dollar store quality.It works, for how long? That's to be determined. I don't think with the costs of batteries that I could even justify using it anyway. Chalk it up as a cheap novelty item and not an investment. Lesson learned. Not every deal is a GOOD DEAL .

This case lasted me for three years until I replaced my Samsung Galaxy S1 with a Samsung Galaxy S4. The argyle pattern is very nice, and the case itself is very durable yet flexible. It was a relatively snug fit as well. However, dirt tended to build up behind the case pretty quickly, and since it is a semi-transparent case, that grime was easily visible. Scratches tended to accumulate as well, and the vibrant color seemed to fade over time. I feel like most of these are issues that apply to almost all cell phone covers though. All in all, a very nice case for the price.

For six months it worked as advertised. No complaints at all. Then, it stopped recharging. I was ready to dispose of it but thought of looking at the warranty. Hallelujah! It was still covered. I contacted Anker website and followed directions. Within 24 hours we received a response and in a weeks time we had a new charger. I’m not ready to give the charger a good review, however, their customer department is wonderful. The new charger still needs to earn a good review, hopefully I’ll be able to provide it after some time. Meantime we hope...... and say thanks to their return department!

The case is more or less as advertised, which is to say it's a nice, basic option for the Pixel 6a. All the port and button cutouts are where they should be and don't impede use of anything. The matte black sides/rails of the case have a slightly exaggerated/raised eggshell texture, which makes it slightly more grippy in the hand. The tinted back panel has a soft touch feel, but doesn't seem to collect fingerprints, which is nice. Speaking of the back panel, it does allow one to see the Google "G" logo well enough, but the color coming through (my 6a is sage) is pretty subtle; as others have noted, the black tint on the semi-transparent back is pretty strong, so don't expect to see the pop of color if you do have the sage or chalk colorways. If you're planning to use a screen protector, this case does have *just enough* of a lip to accommodate one with a bit of extra space such that the glass doesn't touch a surface if you lay the phone face down. That said, it's probably less than a millimeter extra with a protector, so YMMV depending on the thickness of the protector you use. Only knock against the case is that it's a bit chunky and does make the phone feel both noticeably wider and thicker at the edges in the hand. They probably could have slimmed down the sides a bit without sacrificing much if any protection, but it's well within the norm for these kind of cases.

ArmySteve below said it best. Not for the iPhone 8. This case will not provide screen protection due to the new thickness of the 8. The screen rises above the edge of the case so if you lay the phone face down on a table or surface, the face of the screen is touching the surface. With the 6S and 7, the edge of the case rose above the edge of the screen to prevent the screen from touching the surface when the phone was placed face down on the surface. So not only will the screen tough the surface when placed face down on a table or such, the screen will seemingly also touch the padding of the holster as you slide the phone into the holster creating a possibility for scratching the screen. So this case needs to be redesigned for the 8 to provide better screen protection. I had really loved this case for my 6S and a relative had it for a 7. Also loved it. Best case/kickstand case combo on market. It I have to look elsewhere for a case until Aduro revises the case to properly protect the 8. I will be the first in line to buy this case once it is redesigned to fit the 8.

It was packaged well and can protect from scratches but it already has a crack that started on the rounded edge. I never dropped it so I think it is from a metal button near the pocket on my pants. Everytime I put my phone in my pocket it slides past that little button and one time I guess it slid too hard and caused it to crack. Pretty lousy really since it's supposed to protect from much worse. For the price it's not too bad, just be careful with it and possibly use a phone case so the screen isn't flush with the edges of the phone.

I bought two of these in July 2021 for my wife and daughter. The fact that they pack a lot of power and have the connectors built in, along with the compact size made these a great purchase. The color (white) was another factor. My daughter's is still working fine, but my wife's power bank will no longer take a charge. So, it gets four stars for working so while, but I will take one away for the fact that it lasted only 18 months. Should a power bank last longer? I think so. But it WAS good while it lasted and the other one is going strong.

I purchased this case because I like how the camera is protected compared to most cases where it's just a big opening around the lenses, this one has individual precise cutouts for each lens and the flash. It's not as easy to touch the lenses accidentally when taking it out of my purse or pocket because of this set up which is good because there's less chance of fingerprints on the lenses. I am a little disappointed in the front of the case because I think the raised edge could be raised a bit more. I already have a glass screen protector on so the raised edge is almost flush to my screen. If I didn't have the glass screen protector on, the raised edge is higher. Other than that issue, the case is easy to put on and take off, I like the textured back side near the 3 corners. The case is unique that the corners are angular and not rounded. I wish this case came in more feminine colors. The material feels nice, it's not too slippery. It is a very slim profile case, I'm not sure how much protection this will provide but for the price I think it's decent.

Price was incredible. It took a lot more finesse and determination to install than most of the reviews led you to believe ... and then the material is so thin that a corner of it cracked with one TINY drop on the floor!! :-( It was a LOT of effort for a disappointing outcome. My real recommendation is to FORCE you or your children to use the bulky, but inexpensive cases around it in the first place so you don't need this replacement kit!!! The price is right if you are careful enough with it once you've gone through the hassle of replacing it. Definitely cheaper than having the shop do it, but NOT for a beginner or someone who is not meticulous!!

TalkWorks Selfie Ring Light - Small Clip On LED Video Conference Lighting Circle Cell Phone Light Ring for iPhone, Android, iPad, Laptop Computer, Webcam/Zoom, Camera/Photography, Recording - Pink This is cute, box is cute, no weird writing. There are different brightnesses and I find the highest ones unflattering, but that's just the fault of it being bright - you can hold your phone farther. I find that it works the other way for taking pictures of my cat, as the flash on my phone always makes him close his eyes but the constant light he gets used to. It doesn't feel super sturdy but it works and it's quite large.

Update: well despite having a bumper cover and installing this screen protector, had a small drop, approx 3 feet and ended up with a cracked left upper corner. Disappointed as this never happened when I was using tempered glass but there doesn’t seem to be this option for the s8. I had read all the reviews regarding how difficult the installation would be. It actually ended up being really easy. I laid down some Saran Wrap to help keep the dust away. The key is to gently squeegee the excess fluid away, align the protector and then wait for the protector to start drying before trying to press down the edges. Do it at night where you can let it sit overnight afterwards. Time will tell how well it actually protects, but so far I’m happy with the aesthetics.

While I've lived Spigen phone cases in the past I thought this watch case would be awesome since I bang my wrist against stuff more than I would like to admit. While it does feel like it will offer some protection it doesn't feel as well made as the phone cases. I was under the impression that I could use my wireless chargers I have already to charge it since one of their pictures show the watch and case laying flat. It does not last flat. The band could have been a bit softer but it feels like a cheaper plastic that will eventually crack and break down the line. The band that came with the watch is more comfortable in my opinion and this one is just "eh". I'm disappointed that I can't just plop my watch on the wireless charger like I was hoping I could, that was one of the things that helped me leave on this all in one case/band combo. Maybe it'll grow on me but until it does I'll just deal with it since I'm a cheap skate and already have it.

Pros: Battery life is great. The charge on/off button works really well (some other brands are not so good). I absolutely love the red color. Not bad getting the phone in the case. Cons: case color scratches off very easily. I have only had the case for a couple weeks and as you can see from the photo the color has started scratching off in spots. I’m not even a very active user, so this isn’t going to work out for me in the long run. It was also fairly difficult to get the phone out of the case, I felt like I might break something. If your aim is to have a cheap battery case for a year or so and replace it anyway, this will probably do the trick for you.

Downgraded from 5 to 3 stars on 23SEP2021 after a few more days use. Due to excessive hinge material this case does not allow secure mounting in wireless car charger when using it to navigate, nor allows wireless charging to work. After trying several cases, I suspect that design engineers do not own cars and never test this function. Liked the idea of the OZLICE case's sliding lens and camera cover for my Samsung Galaxy S21 Ultra. However, in practice, I learned that the groove is too shallow, the lens cover comes off easily. I was looking for a flip cover style case (protects the screen) with a lens cover. When fully open with the flip cover folded against the back of the case (like in a car charger/holder for navigation) not all my wireless chargers work. They should have added two "bubbles" under the lens cover which would click into depressions, one for lens open, the other for lens closed and because the lack of friction as designed allows the lens cover to move unexpectedly. Thought this case was the one, sadly not. Beware! I just returned my $60 Otterbox Strada case (I've had them for my Samsung S8 and S10 phones) because the S21 Ultra version did not work with all my wireless chargers. I determined that the Strada made the flip cover and main case thicker, and instead of magnets at the edge of the case, Otterbox added metal and magnets to the flip cover and main case (magnetism passing through the phone to secure it closed), which appears to interfere with the wireless charging. The front cover is much thicker than older Stadas which further affects car charger use.

I have been using the Seidio iPhone cases for a couple of years and really like how they protect our iPhone collection. I wear the holster clip all the time on the iPhone 5S, but I don't think I will be wearing this one - it's huge, bulky, looks ridiculous, and I shouldn't have bothered with it. I'll use it when the phone is in a bag just to give the screen some extra protection. Live and learn. I do like the case itself (love the red, which is a bit brighter than shown on my iPad screen), but the stand is too flimsy for the phone - it's all the over to the right and if I tap on the left side, the phone falls over.

So I feel like there’s a reason they include so many protectors in a box. Every time u decide to change up your watch with maybe a different bumper ect. You will find yourself needing to put a new one on because the edges will pull up. If you plan on putting this on and never messing with your screen in any way then this will probably work for you. After the pulling off the 3rd one when the edges started to curl up when changing up my bumper I was done. I went to Walmart and bought the liquid screen protector instead and couldn’t be happier now!!

The review is negative only because the arm broke. While I had it, it worked exactly as advertised. The arm was stiff like it was supposed to be. The phone clamp worked great. The base clamp was surprisingly much more sturdy than I expected from an all plastic clamp. The way the product broke was from the metal core work hardening and breaking from too much adjustment in the same place. This was placed on the headboard above my bed and was adjusted probably twice a day, sometimes more. I have two of these, so I believe I received a faulty unit with poor quality core material as the other unit, which ive had just as long, has not broken. For potential purchasers: Treat this thing like a paper clip. You can bend it, but don't make the adjustments hard and fast or make the bends with small radii. Also, eventually it WILL fail simply because the metal core will work harden as it's adjusted and break. How you adjust it will make a huge difference in its longevity. If the other one fails the same way ill make sure to amend this review to reflect a one off quality issue vs a bad product.

Cute little case. I have the black S7, so the white flowers stand out really well against the back of the phone. Appears to be pretty good quality. I haven't dropped my phone, yet, so no idea how well this case will protect it. So far, so good. My only complaint is that the case arrived with a large scratch down the back. It's a pretty big and obvious mark down the very back of the phone where there is no white detailing, so it really stands out. So far no other scratches have formed, so the material seems to be pretty durable. That one huge scratch is a real shame. I don't think I would buy this case again, just because of the huge eyesore on the back. It's not worth my time to send it back, so I'll just live with the scratch. Otherwise, really cute design and adds that extra layer of protection I was looking for.

This charger is sturdy and can charge your phone multiple times. However it is not fast charging capable which is a big blow to the reason for buying this. If I'm using a portable charger it's because I can't charge my phone and need battery asap. Also this thing is so heavy. There is no way it can fit in a pocket or a normal size purse. Even in my tote bag it weighs it down. I'm returning it because of those cons. For the price it is I can get a lighter charger that can fast charge from a different company. Sucks because the color was so pretty but thats honestly the only positive to it.

The case arrived on time, and it seems very protective. Is heavy and thick, so if that is a no go for you, this is not your case. The material seems resistant and the case pass the dimensions of the phone a little so the screen and camera don't touch the floor wheb the phone falls, what is prety good. I wished the material had a better appearance though. Its.. plastic, it looks like plastic and it feels like plastic. If you are into design too much, you might not like it. I got the pink one and the color is like old bubblegum. I don't have doubts it protects the phone though, and no problems with the keys sensibility. However, if your skin is more sensitive, you might feel the lateral texture (to avoid slips) quite itching in your hands.

UPDATE: So so sad! I went to adjust the angle and it snapped and broke! I loved using this in my car. I've only had it maybe 2 months. It was fitting fine so I'm not sure what happened? Update again!! Bought one for my mother's car and it has now also snapped. Not in the same way as the other one but in the same place. So mad!!!! So great I ordered a second one for my husband's car! In our state that just passed a law that made it mandatory to be 100% hands free so this was a must have for us. It opens at the push of a button and then you just squeeze it shut to whatever size your phone is!

Its nice but here are the draw backs, the installation instructions have a bit to be desired. The package gives you everything you need but doesn't fully explain the functions of each step. For me I didn't understand fully the function of the blue sticky piece until it was to late. I was confused as to its purpose and application. Lining up the protector glass is a challenge but one should expect that. Everybody wants it to be just perfect and the fact of the matter is that unless you have done it few times you just might not get it right the first time. Its works great, just take patience and time to install it.

Stock ROM is a bit slow, but the phone runs Cyanogenmod 12.1 very well with little trouble. About 4 months after the purchase, the phone began to get overly warm, about 130 - 150 degrees Fahrenheit when charging while running. When the phone is off and charging, or on while disconnected in standb mode, it still is much warmer than other smart phones I have checked. it also runs down batteries much quicker now than when I purchased the phone. I carry an extra battery during the day and usually swap them out within 3-4 hours, even in "battery saver" mode. The seller, Shopebest did not respond to my email when requesting assistance in solving these problems.

Not very impressed with this item. my iPhone charges as it should. A little slow but that's alright. My biggest problem is charging my Apple Watch. Again a little slow charging but sometimes it doesn't charge at all. If you tap lightly next to an Apple Watch you can see if it's charging or not as the watch face will tell you. With the Mag Safe Charging Station the watch appears to be charging, but even after 2 hours no charge at all on some occasions. One wound think the problem is the watch not being placed in the charging position but after several try's and each face suggesting it is charging I gave up and could not trust. I have not attempted to charge my AirPods. It is difficult to see if the AirPods case is positioned correctly and the instructions show nothing more than a picture. I'm not impressed. Great idea but not reliable.

It works OK. BUT, there are some basic operational flaws neither Sprint nor LG will address or fix. It will NOT make a 3-way call. A feature advertised but NOT delivered. It simply WILL NOT merge the second call you place and tie it in. It just drops the second number. The LG locks-up when you accidently push the back button instead of the red end call screen button. So, she got him an HTC EVO and hasn't heard one complaint yet. My advice: spend a little more money now. Get the HTC EVO or some other better phone. So the beveled edge of the glass is backwards. Instead of having it be a smooth transition to the phone glass it has a lip. Sadly you can't reverse it to solve that problem as the other side has a coating of some kind on it. (Maybe anti glare) This is not a problem if you have a case on your phone as the edge will line up extremely close to the edge. Both sets of wipes were bone dry so have some alcohol ready before install. Size wize it is great. Make sure your buying the correct one for your phone. Samsung has a A20 and an A20s. There is a size difference between them. You can tell by looking at the camera. Three lenses is the A20s, 2 is the A20.

Ok so I received my case today and just to find out if another person's review I read was accurate, I decided to put this to the test. I inserted my USB cable into the charging port and it really does not fit. You'll actually have to remove the case from the phone when charging. One thing I did observe however is that the side keys (volume control etc) are very functional unlike another silicone case I purchased. It also fits to a "T." I did receive the mini dust protector/stylus and its works for both purposes. For the price, I won't stress it. If the opening for the charger was a tad bit wider, this case would have been perfect (in my opinion) and ideally would've receive a 5 star rating.

While the overall quality of the material is good and seems to provide good (not great) protection, it makes the fun very slippery to hold, especially once you get any oil from your fingers on it. The curved edge makes it to where there is no good width to grasp and hold on tight to (especially considering the relative weightiness of the phone). Also, the mute switch is so buried in the case that unless you're an 8 year old girl or have a French manicure, you can almost forget about getting your finger in there without really digging deep. This may be a good choice for some users, but definitely not for me. Going with a Spigel Tough Armor case this time.

I chose this charger under the impression that everything I needed to use it was included in the box. Unfortunately the charger adapter is not included, and I did not learn this until I received and opened the box the unit came in. Having no adapter is an important exclusion that one would expect to find prominently displayed in the heading of the listing, and not deep within the description halfway down the page. Had I known that the adapter was not included, I would not have chosen this item. I won't be able to say how well it works until I purchase an adapter, IF I decide to purchase an adapter.

Get at you own risk. I have ordered this product twice now and both times it has arrived broken. The cat is heavy and it is put into a super thin plastic box that is not ever secured with a piece of tape. The box has no padding and the cat is not secured to the box at all. Amazon then puts the item inside a flimsy semi padded envelope. It doesn't take a genius to see how the cat arrives broken every time, when it falls out of the unsecured box and is thrown around inside the envelope. Easy to use depress the valve stem in the center of a 1 lb empty tank to relieve any excess pressure turn your 5 gallon supply tank upside down, Fill tank for a few minutes until you could hear it stop flowing unscrew the 1 pound tank (after of course turning off the 5 gallon supply tank) again take a Phillips screwdriver and relieve some of the pressure from the 1 pound tank Put it back on and Fill again keep doing this procedure until the tank is full.weigh the tank before and after you fill it up you’re looking to put 1 pound in it.

I really liked the detailing on this case. But there are some major design flaws. The side of the wallet that holds your credit cards snaps to the part with the change purse. If you have change in it the snaps won't meet one another. If you have more than one thing in the credit card slots, it won't snap shut. The magnetic closure holds 2 parts of this 3 part phone case/wallet closed but doesn't cover the third part which flops open if there is anything in those credit card slots or change purse. So that third of the wallet is non functional and a security risk. The wristlet has no place to attach to this wallet and honestly it's cheap and tacky. I liked the style but sent it back as it doesn't function properly.

My old S7 battery had become very hot and had swelled, so as for getting the old one out it was effortless so I cant really speak about the removal process but the Kit came with everything I needed to make short work of the install. I had enough sticky on the old adhesion tabs that I didn't bother to replace them either, Dropped the battery right in and replaced my 12 tiny screws. I turned my phone back on and the new battery sat as 70%. I have had no issues since the battery replacement. Its nice having a battery that will keep up with the demands of everyday life again with out worrying about a dead phone.

So this bumper case looks really good in the pictures and videos on the Case-Mate site. When I got it I was happy with just about everything accept that the laser cutting on the aluminum was really sloppy. First off the case is not symmetrical. The front is cut at a different depth than the back so when you look at it form the profile it looks all oblong and weird. This asymmetry also makes holding it more difficult. The buttons and button holes are not cut flush. They fit into the holes awkwardly and giggle around when you touch them. There is also a small issue with the two halves staying together. Mine has a slight bow when put together and that is just unprofessional. its a decent case and looks pretty cool but these little amateur mistakes really disappoint.

Its a decent case. The Note 8 is only available in black or grey though here in the US as of this date. If you decide to put a skin on your phone than this will display it well, but with the straight black color of my Note 8 the clear build of this case is kind of wasted. It seems durable enough and isn't too bulky but if you let any water get on your phone (the Note 8 is water resistant so I'm not afraid to take it out in the rain, etc) it will get between the case and the phone and make a bubble that doesn't look great. All in all its a good case, especially if you have a wrapped phone to show off.

I have been using this phone case for a year now. I drop my phone about everyday and my phone is not damaged at all. The case however has ripped where the charging port is and the part where the aux port is has ripped. The pink on the sides were a very nice pink color but that has changed over time (now like a dirty fuschia color). The case is thin enough to put in your back pocket. I got a water proof case because well I'm clumsy and might drop it in water. The screen does a good job at preventing water from getting inside. I haven't dropped it into a toilet, bathtub, or any large form of water so I do not know how the case will handle it.

The first day using my new phone,it restarted 3 times. The second day started much the same. Every time I took the phone out it was rebooting. Then notice the case pushs in on the power button and the button seems to stick out a bit to far. Turn the phone upside down and it doesn't reset. Ribs on the case feel sharp to the touch. . Case is thinner than others like it I've had but like them the clip is a weak spot. For the price it's a good buy but I may look for another because of the sharp edges and the phone resets

This case had a major tear in the corner after only using it for one month. I contacted the seller that I purchased it from Amazon and they told me to contact Lifeproof directly. Lifeproof than told me that this case was counterfeit and would not do a warranty replacement. Lifeproof only supports two sellers on Amazon. Amazon LLC and Lifeproof on Amazon. You get really good prices from the other sellers but if you have any problems with your case Lifeproof will not replace it. I am waiting for a credit from the unauthorized seller that I bought it from on Amazon. I just ordered another case from Amazon LLC. Lifeproof has great cases as long as you don't get one that is defective and counterfeit. UPDATE- I just received credit from the seller I used within 24 hours on my request and I am very happy that the return was very easy.

Overall, this case serves its purpose by being waterproof. Also, it is not too bulky and the color makes it look great. However, it's not an everyday case. It decreases functionality. Firstly, there is no way to use the stylus, which I use quite often. Secondly, the case is such a tight fit that my home key and power button could not be used unless one side of the case was left open. Leaving one side open also helped when I needed to remove the case quickly. Because it is waterproof, the seal is very tight, so much so that I use a knife to open it, but even after many times of prying it open with a knife it still maintains its waterproof function. I still ended up just taking it off completely. The seller is very reasonable and responds quickly with solutions.

Overall okay case. This case looks just like the photo, so satisfaction on that end. However, within minutes of first use the magnetic plate fell off the case and my phone hit my knee while driving. I also wasn't very pleased with the glass covering. It was simply a piece of thin plastic and had stickers on it so you could tell the front from the back. The back sticker came off clean, but the front sticker was difficult to remove and left a sticky residue and warped and dirty screen protector. I guess I'll buy a new screen protector and use super glue on the magnetic plate.

Warning!! This unit will not work with any of the common wall chargers on the market, and the one that it comes with has a high fail rate, and impossible to replace. Mines has failed after three years use. Just stopped working. The wall charger that comes with it is unique because it outputs 12.0v at 2.1A, which is the required operating voltage. I cannot find a replacement anywhere online, and I think the original may have been discontinued. The model number is EP-TA300. Tried other Samsung wall chargers and I get blinking red lights because the voltage is too low. Shame on Samsung for making the wall charger unique and no way to replace it. Never again, and just so you know. Buyer beware!!!!

It's okay. I've had it for a couple of days now, but I'm buying a different one and just throwing this away. (I had to destroy the packaging to get it opened, so not sure I can return it.) The phone fits in the case, but the sides bag outward and the screen cover is hard to type through. And I didn't watch the video to use this, as instructed in the packaging. If a phone case needs an instructional video - it's too complicated. I just wanted a case I could snap on and that fit, not an engineering challenge. I can see how others might like that though, so a more complicated case would probably work for some - just not for me, and that's fine.

I like the complete well almost complete phone coverage this one isnt water proof as the details stated when I purchased it so your stylus slot is open not sealed as a water proof case would be im not around alot of water so no biggie there i wanted the wp case because in some cases as with my galaxy note 8 i dropped my phone about the first week of owning it and the stylus shot out of it never to be seen again. ive not lost this one yet 3mnths in but it has ejected almost all the way out. the wp case has a plug to prevent this from happening

Great product, kudos to them for creating this. I've had it for about 2 years now. Initially I mounted this to my dashboard as others here have stated and that was huge mistake. After a few months the summer heat caused it to drop off on its own which was good cause I wanted to move it to the windshield anyway. It's a suction cup but there's also some strange adhesive substance on the cup as well which works great for permanent placement, so keep that in mind. (seriously this stuff is mind-bogglingly sticky!) But I relocated it to my windshield and it hasn't fallen since, but now age is starting to set in and it's no longer staying pointed forward like it should. Because I have it mounted to the left side of my windshield it pivots on the suction cup axis and leans over onto my A-pillar causing a vibration from my phone to the pillar causing me to have to smack it over every few minutes. Otherwise when new it's very stiff and protrudes a long way for wherever you want to place it, adjustments are terrific. Just know that there is still a ring on my dashboard from when I initially placed it there.

Easy to apply, no bubbles at all. Looks and feels like the real screen. Happy so far! Good price too! .....We'll only a few weeks after we bought these phones and screen protector, my hubby dropped his phone while getting out of the car (3 feet drop), and the phone screen cracked and went black! No damage done to the screen protector, but phone was useless! The cost of a new screen w I us be the same as busing a new phone, so we had to buy a brand new phone. I've read a lot of reviews that the's phones' screens go black after dropping. I guess I assumed the military grade case and this protector would protect it. I'm giving them 3 stars because I've had no trouble with mine. But I'm extremely disappointed that this didn't do its job with a short fall - we're out $300.

I needed a new screen protector for my phone, so I decided to try out this Glass one. I thought it really wasn't going to be glass and it was just a marketing plot, but no, it was really glass. I was impressed. It was very easy to put on because I have put on so many screen protectors in the past. I was able to put it on fine with no bubbles at all. The guide stickers and the cleaning cloths it came with were a big help in keeping things clean and dust free. However, it did not fit the phone perfectly. The Home button hole is a bit bigger than the home button. And the top of the protector does not come up all the way on the phone unless you move it up. If you do that, due to the size of the home button, you're left with a big gap by the home button, which you can feel when you're unlocking your phone. There were gaps on the side as well, but my phone case covered those. Without the case, my finger kept finding the seam of the protector when swiping my finger across the screen. It is really annoying for me, so I don't think I will be keeping this protector on for long. The protector itself is nice and clear and such, but the sizing issues are a deal breaker for me. PLEASE NOTE: I received this item for free, or at a discounted price in exchange for my fair and honest review.

I do Uber and got a daughter. Overall my impression is this product will break within a few weeks/months if it even last that long. Cord don't stretch far enough, if it's pulled out all the way it won't retract and it took me nearly 2 days of messing with it to retract, I thought I was going to have to unscrew this thing and take it apart to try and fix it. Cords are thin and not long enough and I foresee it just breaking or snapping cord wise. The box unit it's housed in is plastic and it feels sturdy and the attachment arm holding it in place seems okay. Honestly will take time to see how the plastic holds up over time and if it is durable enough to survive summer time heat and normal abuse of being used. I'm very concerned that it's going to scratch the glass.
