Returned for replacement and we'll see if the next set is better, in the mean time I went to the Motorola site and ordered the real thing.

The product works and that is the most important thing. it is not nearly as smooth to insert as the original cable that lasted 3 years nor does it feel the same. Update May 2021: I have owned it now for several months. Up to this point, I have only needed it to charge my phone and it has performed flawlessly, However: I just went on a trip and used it in the car which has Android Auto. It did not function and locked up the stock Honda navigation app. Not happy with this product anymore and next cable will be direct from Samsung. (Note: I used my wife's original cable in the car and it worked just fine)

I have enjoyed everything about this phone, except for one major flaw, which some other reviewers have also mentioned. The earpiece volume is extremely low. If I am anywhere with any noise at all (in the car, outdoor event with noise, etc.), I cannot hear what the other person is saying to me. It is so bad, that I am going to have to return this phone. I was hoping that I just had a faulty unit, but some of the reviewerss mentioned that they have gotten their's replaced, and they are all the same. I don't use an earpiece, so if you primarily do us one, this may not be a big issue for you. It is a wonderful phone, otherwise. But, this is too major of a fault, to keep the phone.

I just received the case today so I really can’t rate the durability or sturdiness of it but I can say that it’s very easy to hold and it looks fantastic. The leather look is spot on and the case fits my iPhone 8 Plus like a glove. If you’re into minimalist design, this is your case. I love it. *UPDATE* I had to return the case and I’m very upset about it because I love this case. The problem I had was with the barely there lip on the front of the case that is suppose to protect the screen. The screen protector I had already placed on my phone was higher than the lip so I ended up shattering 3 screen protectors within the first week. If you don’t use a screen protector this case will be fine.

I like the sleek design and display that shows how much power is left however, it's advertised that it will charg an iPhone 12 at least 6 times. I figured with my little Galaxy S10+ it should charge at least 6 times before the power bank will need to be recharged. Wrong. Phone was at 32%, I plugged it into the 100% fully charged power bank and after charging my phone to 100% (It did charge pretty quickly) my power bank is at 54%. Nothing else was plugged in or being charged during that time. This power bank does charge pretty quickly and charges my phone quickly, just doesn't hold a charge long itself.

I just recieved this band. Upon opening it appeared to be a quality product. The pins dont feel cheap and the clasp feels pretty sturdy. The band does appear to be genuine leather. This is where the downside begins... the leather is cheaply dyed, well I should say colored. I noticed the dye was transferring to my wrist so I figured that I would was off the excess dye, which is what I had assumed was transferring to my wrist. Oh how wrong was I. After washing the band in warm water with a wash cloth and hand soap all and I mean ALL of the coloring was washed away from the leather, leaving a lite tan almost beach sand color instead of the dark coffee color that I originally ordered. This is not a huge issue for me but it is very disappointing. Hopefully the durability of the band itself is much better than the dye.

not sure if I got a defective item, but the charger gets pretty hot even with no phone on it, and transfers a good amount of heat to any phone that is attached to it. the stick-on ring it comes with isnt metal but a flexible plastic impregnated with magnetic particles like a flexible fridge magnet. not a very strong hold, but not too terrible either. the problem is that 1) it's pretty thick compared to metal rings and 2) the adhesive easily melts under the heat of the charger. to make matters worse, the charger doesn't seem to like 3rd party stick on metal rings... the phone will initially recognize the charger, but quits charging within 15 seconds. i do really like the mount portion, so my solution was to buy the very basic $20 version with a standard magnet, and then buy a separate 15w vent clip charger with the same size ball mount. the one i got was a ZOOAUX brand 15w, and it works beautifully

This phone case is great by itself; it’s sturdy, the card door stays closed well, and it’s overall good at its job. However, it has one flaw that is a huge downside for me. I had put a brand new glass screen protector on my phone when I got this case, and the red plastic shell that goes on the phone before being seated in the case fits so tightly that it caused my screen protector to lift at the corners, and no matter what I’ve tried, I can’t fix it. I push the corners back down, used a credit card to try to push them underneath the plastic shell, even filed down the inner rim of the shell. Nothing works. Now there’s dust and moisture under the screen protector. I love the case, but I’m afraid I’ll be getting a different one that works with screen protectors. And replacing mine again.

I will preface this by stating that I have ordered these before and at that time was very satisfied with my results. They do adhere very nicely and line up perfect for my model of Samsung phone. However, I was very unsatisfied this go around. Firstly, my package of three included a damaged screen protector (as shown). So right off of the bat I am down to 2. So I apply one of the 2 remaining onto my phone and within less than a week it broke, seemingly for no reason. It did not experience a fall or any trauma. I am pretty perplexed as to why it shattered. I have yet to use the last one in the pack but I am very hesitant. This was such a disappointment.

I've always loved Cruzerlite cases and was excited to get one for my Z3 Compact, but the fit is too tight with tempered glass screen protectors. I have front and back glass protectors on my phone, so unfortunately the case does not fit well and lifts the front protector off my phone. If you already have your z3 compact protected with tempered glass, this case may not work for you. I have the fevilcase tempered glass which is very full and extends to the end of the phone. I'm sure this is a great case as all of Cruzlite's other work, but you may have to remove a full glass protector if you plan to use it.

I've purchased this product before and the first one stuck well, had very few bubbles and really protected the screen. I dropped my phone one too many times so decided to buy a replacement protector - I was tired of cutting my finger on the one crack right where you swipe. This second protector does the job of protecting the screen from breaking but it is impossible to get it on my phone without excessive bubbles. I have reinstalled this thing so many times with the same results - long bubbles along both sides of the screen the full length of the phone. This product is better than the protectors that just have adhesive along the edges, but it could be much better than it is.

Looks great straight out of the box, and OtterBox's evolution to clear plastics is very well executed. Downsides include seeing an accumulation of fuzz, dust, etc. trapped between the back of the case and the phone (requires periodic cleaning), and color transfer from garment dye (i.e. blue jeans) onto the beige rubber on the outer edge of the phone case; it picks up the color from everything its in prolonged contact with. The clear plastic design is a great concept, but not a great execution; its high polish sleek finish makes it difficult to keep a grip on, and constantly slips out of your hand. I will eventually have to replace it with the same OtterBox model in a non-clear finish, to avoid breaking the phone via continuous dropping.

I was excited to find a beveled screen protector with glass! It's hard to find one that's good quality. But unfortunately this one is not! It immediately cracked and buckled and when I put my phone case on. While I could get a more low profile phone case, I won't do that because I like to have heavy duty cases. IOne of the biggest problems for me is my phone does not read the touch!! If it's close to the edge within it inch or so, I have to tap really hard on things for my phone to work. It's been really annoying! The glare is pretty bad too. Don't recommend

Got this for my birthday almost exactly 6 months ago. Today, as I was recording a video, I did not touch the tripod at all when it so suddenly snapped and my phone dropped to the ground. The spring didn't break but had somehow shot out of the phone holder. I'm pretty upset, as this was a great tripod for my basic needs, but due to how the spring was placed into the holder, it's impossible to fix on my own. (One end is completely closed off and I can't insert the spring back into the holder from the other end, only the top end.) I did not use this tripod excessively. I used it, on average, once a week for about half an hour at a time. This means I got an approximate total of 13 hours of usage of this tripod. Not even a day's worth. Very disappointed.

I have a Chevrolet Cruze which has skinny vertical vents which might be the problem this product didn't work for me. However, I tried it for over two weeks and with just bumpy roads or taking my phone in and out a few times, the mount would start to wiggle and then get super loose and then eventually just fall off. It was hard to adjust and tighten once it was on, and it just didn't work like I expected. Again, I think it might've been my vents..if they'd been horizontal I'd imagine it would stay on better. The mount itself felt high quality and sturdy (not cheap plastic) but it just would not stay tightened and in place so I ended up returning it.

It's advertised as a solar charger, but says if it gets too much sun, the battery will swell and you should throw it away. You're supposed to plug it into a wall to charge. . The solar part is a back-up with so many warnings against using it, it appears that it'll only be a matter of time before the product will be ruined if you try to charge it with the sun. It also says use the solar part under 'self protected mode only'. But no instructions on to what that is or how to turn it on. Yet it's advertised as a SOLAR charger, with no reference about plugging it into a wall at all in the description.

For the price I paid ($190), this is a decent phone. It does come pretty bloated, not having much storage capacity. You will run out quick. Also, the camera isn't good. It has a hard time focusing, everything is far too bright, and it's very slow. It just doesn't do enough and what it does do, it does bad. It does run Android Pie which is a huge plus for a 2 year old phone. The phone is pretty slick and doesn't completely touch the surface it sits on so at any incline it will slide indefinitely. The finger print scanner is amazing though. Remembers many scans for easier access and is compatible with all apps I've come across. Using Google voice usually results in incorrect input or doesn't work at all. This device needs more mics or at least better placement of mics. Although I thought I would like the speaker on this phone more than my Google pixel, that isn't the case. The sound coming from 1 speaker vs 2(even though right next to each other), is just lower quality and volume.

Pros: Great battery life, large bright screen with sharp resolution, great price Cons: Response can lag with some apps. Unless you're in perfect light conditions, plan on being disappointed with the camera. Memory management is atrocious. I have plenty of internal memory (500MB) and SD (10GB), yet it can't update apps because the phone thinks there isn't enough space, even though I have selected "install apps to SD card" in the settings. I suspect the internal memory may be damaged or corrupted, thus reducing the effective memory seen by the system. After just 1 year of use, the screen is yellowing around the edge and on the home button (presumably where I touch the screen the most.) And don't waste your time emailing customer service about anything. I tried emailing on three separate occasions, and got no response... not even an automated email saying, "We'll respond as soon as possible"--likely because they know they won't respond at all.

Product went on really nice. Install was a breeze. Someone with zero experience could do it. Product covers most of screen enough to protect but not 100% to allow for a case. Also for anyone installing this my glass in the plastic had some dust stuff all over it. Almost messed up my install if recommended cleaning the front of this before applying also. Only complaint is my phone has almost become unresponsive due to the lack of touch screen sensitivity. I literally have to mash down hard on every letter of this review. I dont see it getting any better. So I dont think this is a win for me. If screen was still nice and responsive this would be a hit instead of paying 40 dollars for the screen protector with the light. Hopefully this works until I decide to spend the 40 bucks. Great product terrible sensitivity!

I love the color. I really did not have a lot in the way of options. My samsung was stolen at work so I got a replacement one with my plan. (This was not worth it as I now realize, the monthly payment for the plan and the copay, is too high..but that is another issue.) So, my phone was stolen along with the case that I loved...now, I got replaced phone but no case. Good luck trying to find a case for a samsung galaxy. I phone cases are all over the place in every variety. My samsung replacement is not for the newest model and finding a case in a store is impossible. The options online are not great either. I had to get this one since it was one of the few options. I like the color. It is very very very bulky, the rubber is floppy and needs to be constantly adjusted. The screen cover is TERRIBLE. It does not fit quite right, and it is not clear at all. It is difficult to use the touch screen now and is not really cleanable. Without this cheap screen cover the case would be acceptable, but unfortunately I cannot use the case without it. I don't recommend this one if you can find something else. Also, opening the plastic hard shell part of the case is just impossible. I was able to open it twice, but cannot open it now. That is frustrating, since this is way to big to carry around in most of the pockets on my slacks and on my dresses.

A bit slippery on the edge, but the case is pretty snug fit for your phone. DO NOT add a vinyl skin or full coverage tempered glass screen protector to the front panel of your phone as this case will cause bubble to the vinyl skin or pop the TGSP off. UPDATE: PROS: - Sleek and minimalist design case - Open back to view the asthetics of the phone - All phone ports are well cut, except the speaker ports that was off by a couple centimeters - Snug fit with extra cushion on corners for any potential impact CONS: - Slippery that causes high potential of dropping phone

The wireless charger does not charge the iPhone 12 Pro Max - even though the description states compatible with iPhone 12. It clearly is not. It does work fine with the iPhone 11 Pro Max. Tried it with both the MagSafe case and without - does not charge in either case. The charger itself is great - single cable to a QC 3.0 charger that is included. Charges all three items - AirPods, watch and phone. Just don't get it if you have a iPhone 12 Pro Max - not sure if it works with the other iPhone 12 models.

This is a perfect fit phone case that is reasonably cost. There is a small logo, Caudabe, on the back of the case, but not enough to bother me. Matte finish and it is like having no case at all. Completely love it! In comparison to Peel case without logo that costs a lot more, definitely will go with this again. The case is definitely very minimal protection for the phone, I dropped my iphone few times and the case ended up cracking before my phone got scratch. It is definitely not a durable phone case if that is what you are going for, but it is very thin and looks very minimal and classy on the phone.

I was very excited when I saw this product and immediately bought it, because I was completely fed up with the bad design of iPod charging cable. I have bought over a dozen of those cables and everything broke in few weeks of usage. It's not just those dollar deal cables, even the original apple brand cable broke quickly for me. This micro usb adapter seemed like 'this is it' because I never had trouble with micro usb cables and devices. Just one cable and works for ever. It worked like a charm for few weeks and now it broke. Some kind of loose connection. Now I have to shake the usb cable in circles to hit the sweet spot. And once I hit the sweet spot I have to hold it tight otherwise it stops charging. So, I hold it in the sweet spot for about 5 mins to get some juice for immediate use. Out of excitement I ordered 2 of them. I didn't open the other one yet, not sure if I can return it. Like I said, it could be the crappy ipod touch. I see some green stains in the data socket of the ipod. Whatever it is, I am fed up with the ipod and it's charging/sync cables.

The case is great to look at and durable as well. What I do not like about it is there is no way to tell, without looking, which button I am pressing. Those little, different from each other, bumps would be a nice addition. Plus, it does require a bit more force to press them than should be necessary, even after disassembling and cleaning. I definitely like the texture on the sides as it improves holding the phone without it slipping free and falling. I only wish there were a kick stand of some kind. Overall, I am very pleased with this case and will likely purchase another in the future.

It's a good thing these cases are cheap because the tabs that hold the two sides together don't last long. Drop it once or twice and you've got a broken tab and a corner or two that will no longer snap together. It fits very tight to start with so I'm thinking the tabs are just over-stressed right from the beginning. The designs are great, colorful, creative. They do wear off over time. I've just purchased number 3 found here: [[ASIN:B00AJIIUSM Protector Cover Snap On Hard Crystal Case For ZTE Score X500 - Colorful Turtle]] I don't expect it to last any longer than the first two ([[ASIN:B006Y1VW3I ZTE Score X500 (Cricket) Rubberized Design Case Cover Protector - Hawaiian Flowers]] and[[ASIN:B006Y1VSVY ZTE Score X500 (Cricket) Rubberized Design Case Cover Protector - Blue Vines]] but, better the cheap case break than the not so cheap phone.

I bought these a while ago. Things were going smoothly for a while, maybe about a month or two. Then the bottom black part on the batter came off. No big deal just a slight annoyance. Then the top part started coming off to, but was still attached with the wires and all. Then eventually one of the batteries completely stopped working. Wouldn't power my phone or anything. Then a couple weeks after that the other battery did the same. Its a great deal, but make sure to keep the batteries very well protected. I carried mine in my wallet for convenience so that may have attributed to it, nevertheless my stock battery was in my wallet just as much if not more than these and still works perfectly fine. The charger is really nice to have providing you have more than one battery to use though. Just let it die all the way then pop a new battery in, then charge the old one up all the way. It's better for the battery that way I suppose.

If you are going to install a screen protector on any device, then you need to take a few precautions - first, take your phone's battery off and then clean your screen a few times with a clean lint-free cloth. Also wash your hands and apply the included solution onto your fingers as well to avoid leaving marks or anything else. With that said and with a little patience, you will do a great job and have a bubble-free screen protector applied onto your phone. The film fits nice on a BB Curve 9320. The anti-glare part is not as good as others but it does the job well. The only reason that I'm giving 4 stars is because at the top it has a bigger cut than expected - it is exactly as shown in the picture, just that I didn't notice that and a small part of the phone ends up not being protected and accumulates dust, grease, etc. I would believe that it is by design to have the same screen fit multiple phone models and I know it is not a big deal and for the price you definitely can't ask for more, but it could have been nice to have a small cut surrounding the earpice like other manufacturers do.

Purchased the phone when it came out, it ran great and smooth, but got very hot when using VR or AR. The battery was disappointing but thats to be expected from the specs. The leather finish on the back felt great and the phone looked good, but the bezels for a 2017 phone flagship leave a lot to be desired. The phone ended up getting purple burn in the top after a week or two so i sent it back. As a Asus fanboy I will look to their flagship next year hopefully we will see a winner but i would pass on this one, it just doesn't hit the mark. 8GB in a smartphone felt awesome though.

Update: The company contacted me and offered free refund or replacement and were very kind. I selected a replacement and will give this product another chance. Hopefully I just got a defective one the first time. Updated from one star to three stars due to excellent service. I have owned this item for two months. It quickly lost its support and my phone would shake when the car was moving but ok I could live with that. However now the arm has separated from the part which attaches to the window. My husband put it back on and it fell off again within 30 mins on the road. Very disappointed.

I truly don’t like to be negative about things but the glass that is provided is extremely sensitive and the slightest bump will crack it. I went thru the first 2 in about. A week, then the seller was super nice and switched it out for me, which I thought was extremely courteous. Then when I got the new one, let’s just say I am on the 2nd glass protector screen and it is all cracked. This message is more for the seller to know and possibly get new glass provider. All in all the product has kept my phone from damage and I am hard on everything. I think the seller is a very nice, organized and punctual. The protector came extremely fast was shipped perfectly. So, the only issue is the glass sturdiness and the red paint. I would see if there was a way to make it out of red plastic to avoid discoloration. If I could do it all again I would of ordered the white case.

This is one of the best brands for phones but I have an issue with the case I just bought. On the picture online they make the case look rounded and like the color is a vibrant turquoise color. Which was why I picked it, when it came in the mail its nothing like the case online, the color is more of a mint green than a turquoise, its not shiny and its not rounded like it makes it look. Im really disappointed because I thought I was getting a totally different color and shape of the case. other than that I like the feel of it, for a flex case it seems pretty durable.

This was my first time buying a tempered glass screen protector. I've always just used the plastic which were ok.. could never get then on without bubbles or a spec of dust getting trapped. This product went on super easy and not 1 bubble or dirt spec trapped underneither. I can't really comment on it's durability or scratch resistance because I've only had it on a few days. One thing I don't care for is the gloss finish. It shows finger prints and the reflection/glare can be annoying. It's to bad they couldn't make it in a matte finish. Other than that, so far so good. If it doesn't hold up I'll post a follow up. *** Update *** Only lasted 2 months before the first crack appeared. Third crack just appeared (3 months). Ditching it and trying a different brand.

I have several Qi chargers at home with various brand (Anker was one of them) that charge My note 10 plus with no problem. But for some reason I can never get a full charge on my Iphone 13 pro max. Some will not charge at all and the Anker charger light stay lit but not charging. All my USB charging adapter is between 18W to 20W so I know the adapter is not the issue here. I get a fully charged phone every moring with this charger. For those who has trouble with this. Try higher Wattage charging block.

I work a physically demanding job and wanted protection for my new Charge 3; I ordered these because they were the highest rated at the time. Installation is dicey. I went through three of the six just getting it right, all because the protector migrated after installation. After it was placed correctly and left to "set" for 24 hours, it slid around on its own during that time period, even with my Charge sitting face up. The big reason I docked my rating is that the film half-separated from my screen while I was charging the device. The Fitbit Charge 3 has a clamp charger than actually hugs the back of the watch. I had charged it three times after installing the screen protector with no issues, but on the fourth charge the film bubbled up from under one of the charging clamps. I think these would be alright if you don't wear your Fitbit very often, but I'm not happy with the longevity of this product so far.

I recently purchased the XICHENK TPU protector for my Apple Watch Series 4 44mm model with modest expectations and these expectations were met.First when you received the case you get 2 different protectors one is a full coverage protector and the seconded is a bumper styled protector with a raised ridge. In the time I have owned the protector I mainly used the full coverage protector. The case does a good job at protecting the watch face and body from scratches and ding. My one and only complaint that can be easily overcome is that when exposed to hand washing or any activity involving water the full coverage protector seems to fill with fluid and cause the screen to be non response. This would be fine if it only filled in situations such as swimming but for me it has happened with basic hand washing. The instructions do state that this is an expected issue but I didn't think it would be that prevalent due to the tightness of the case against the body of the display. The way i fixed the problem was I just ended up getting a Zagg screen protector and using the provided second screen protector less case to resolve the issue. Overall the two cases are both good at their jobs and are thick enough to take some damage without any problems. I would have like to see some more material around the digital crown for some extra protections but for the cost i really can't complain.

Blu Products is not a well-know maker of smartphones, but it offers a bewildering number of phones with slightly different feature set and prices. You can check out its entire lineup at blueproducts.com. Beware that the cellphone market being fiercely competitive, you can often find a phone made by the same maker with a few better features for slightly more money or even at the same price. Blu has TWENTY phones in its Studio series. Studio G is a 5-inch Android smartphone with the most basic features: 480X854, 196 ppi display, 4 Gb internal memory, 0.3 MP (VGA) front camera, 5 MP rear camera, 2,000 mAh battery. The Studio G is currently selling for about $100 on Amazon. At the same time, you can also buy the Blu Studio C smartphone for about the same price. The Studio C has these upgraded features: 720X1280, 294 ppi HD display, 8 Gb internal memory, 2 MP front camera, 8 MP rear camera, 3,000 mAh battery. Comparing just these two phones, both selling for around $100, obviously Studio C is a better deal than Studio G. There are 18 other Studio smartphones that you can make similar comparisons to find the best phone that suits your needs and budget. Blu also has other product lines: Dash, Vivo, Life, and Specialty.

The case is well made, but I guess I was a little rough on the belt clip. This case comes with a really nice belt clip that has a flap that actually clips over the belt clip, making sure this case does not come off your belt. It is a rather ingenious little design, However, After about 2 months, the flap detached at the seam, and then the piece of leather sewn to the pouch to hold the belt clip in place, came off. Basically leaving the case useless for wearing on a belt. I bought this becasue the $25 case I bought with the phone began to wear out and the metal rivet holding the belt clip on to the case began to chaffe the touch screen on my phone. It was way too late for my phone (cosmetically) before i realized what was happening. So I bought this case through Amazon. It was very inexpensive, but did not last me very long.

This is a nice little phone holder. I have started to use it to hold the phone on the microwave to bring up a recipe. (Stainless Steel). I am using an a very cheap friends android phone to demo it and taking the picture with my iPhone 5, However it does fit my iPhone 5. I do have doubts that this will fit an iPhone 6 Plus, or a large Samsung type phone securely. The magnet seems strong and should hold the phone without issue though. I am giving this a 4 star only due to not having a swivel base to rotate the phone. *Note I did receive this in exchange for an honest review.

While it works fine, the clear plastic cover required more pressure to access the iPhone screen. Not so well done. Strap is designed to two configurations to accommodate 2 arm diameters; but there's no info on how to do this. Took a few minutes to figure out. I use it to control songs while dancing so don't get too active (as I might while running); thus I can't say how it holds up to sweat and impacts. Seems like it would be fine. Just not the best way to access and control touch screen if that's important to a user.

I bought these when I bought my wife a Vivoactive 3 for her birthday. I had mine for a couple months prior. I forgot I bought these and never installed them. But I'm very hard on my watch. I've bumped it in to concrete walls. I've fallen on it while skating biking and I've biked a couple thousand miles with it mounted to my handlebars. The watch bezel is scratched up a lot but the screen doesn't have a single scratch on it. I wouldn't waste your money on these protectors. I'm sure they're fine but they don't seem necessary.

I loved the case for the way it was meant to protect my phone! I picked it out due to the fact I have Epilepsy and I have been through many phones! This case offered everything I was looking for The Screen Protector & How It Scerued To The Phone Case! (I knew that I would not have a cracked screen for a change) I have yet to drop my new phone but I unfortunately have to buy a new phone case. I am just trying to figure out how this happened! Overall I love the color, the material of the case & how the screen protector was made for the case!

I had this case for my iPhone 6plus, but in a different color. So when I ordered the one for the iPhone 8 plus, I didn’t give it much thought that it would be the exact same case. That is fine because it is a 5-star worthy case. I dropped my phone many times and it was very protected. However, Apple moved the little Apple icon on the back of the phone. They moved it down probably about 1/4” which shouldn’t be a big deal to most but if you look at the picture of the case, the little Apple emblem on the back of the phone shows but it is no longer centered. Does it affect the phone? No. Will most people even care? Probably not, but it drives me nuts. So I will give it a few weeks and search for a new case that covers the Apple emblem or if a cutout is there, it is centered for the iPhone 8plus and not the iPhone 6 or 7 plus.

Update: There is something about this case that aggravates my latex allergy whenever I have to open it up to change my SIM card or SD card. My face gets itchy and my throat feels tight. Beware if you have a Latex allergy. Otherwise, very effective protection for the phone itself. Original review: This case turned out better than I thought it would. It fits my SafeLink phone perfectly (Alcatel Raven) and has a nicely raised ledge to protect the screen from ever touching the ground. The included glass screen protector came in good condition and applied to my phone with zero bubbles. I had to be careful, though, to not break it as it was stored tightly inside of the case when I first got it. I almost thought they hadn't included the screen protector at all and may have accidentally broken it when disassembling the phone case. Thankfully, I recognized the foam pouch protecting it. Others may not, however, and so the company should include a brightly colored instruction for the average consumer. I'm confident that my phone will survived several drops in this case.

The main things I was looking for was great sound with heavy bass def and a long lasting battery. I work in a warehouse without any climate control, temps are 50 or lower. The sound, even at 70-80% volume is fantastic. I charged it last night, brought it to work, and got nearly 5 hours of playtime, quite shorter than the touted 20 hours. Was it just the cold temps at my work? Is the battery defective? I'm going to test the playback at room temp, 68 or above after it receives a full charge tonight. Oh, there was a huge fall off in the battery life from 80% to 10% in an hour. Again, I'll test it tonight and edit this review. So far, impressed with the sound, battery is meh at best. Edit: It has been nearly two weeks since I posted this and have since returned the product to Amazon. There seems to be problems not only with the battery life, but also the battery indicator. At room temperature the battery performed the same, full charge to empty battery in less than 5 hours at 75% volume. Maybe it's a refurb, or just a cut rate model marketed to T-Mobile for a limited time. Either way, dodge this one. I'm going Bose now, and direct purchase too.

I purchased this stand because its design seemed to accommodate charging my phone regardless of the width that my cases added. However, the rectangular, plastic surround for the micro USB connector prevents the phone with cases that add even a few millimeters around the charging socket from connecting to the charger. The stand won't charge my phone even with my thinnest case that covers all of the sides, even when I gently press the phone down on the connector. Without a case, the phone docks quite easily. The plastic surround on the micro USB plug helps it to stand vertically, and the three rubber feet in the back prevent it from reclining too far Bottom line: If you have phone cases with socket openings smaller than the plastic docking piece, you'll have to remove it to charge your phone on this stand. With more protective cases that are difficult to remove, using this stand might not be worth the hassle. It's a beautiful stand, but if you use cases, you'll have to be very selective about the cases you buy to use it.

The description on Amazon says "(2 Pack)' which would make me think there were two complete mounts. That is not the case. There is one dashboard and one vent mount with two magnetic pieces. There is not 2 sets of dashboard and vent mounts which is misleading. The description needs to be more clear. I also mounted the metal plate on the case as shown in the video and the phone will not stay attached to the mount. The magnet is not close to strong enough. Hit a bump and it falls off. also, the dash mount will not stay attached. it pops right off. The adhesive is not good. Very disappointed.

It’s a great screen protector. Very clear & seems durable. I just wish it was a tad wider. I have the iPhone Xs & it covers the screen, but just barely. If you’re looking at your phone from a side angle you can’t see under the protector & it messes with my ocd mind a bit. I actually had to remove it after one day. I replaced it with the second one & moved it over to the left side a bit so I see under it, because that’s the side I usually tilt my phone to. So, were as it is durable & clear, I probably won’t keep it one very long because I don’t reall like how it doesn’t go closer to the sides.

I have had this case for 10 months and its working well except for one issue the plastic piece on the top cover that overlays the bottom part of the case has broken off not once but twice. I purchased this case on 8/2013 and the plastic piece broke off after Christmas. The piece actually weakens to the point to where it tears off. I sent in a request for warranty coverage but they only have a 90 day warranty. They did still honor the warranty and sent me another top cover only in January, 2014. Unfortunately this piece broke again last week 6/4/2014 and will have to live with out that piece to hold the top cover to the bottom part of the case. The lower part of the case is well made and have no complaints about that part. Good Luck.

Just got this 2 hours ago and put it on right away. It's not bad for the price, I guess. One that I've put on has a white mark around the camera hole, starting from the camera hole to left edge of the protector. Not really noticeable but it does catch my eye at times. 2 things that bother me are * Large halo/oil slick effect in the middle of the screen and 2 small one at the top of the screen. It's not as bad when the screen is on but still noticeable. The large one was about 2cm wide in the beginning but it has gotten larger after an hour. * There is a slight drag when I glide the tip of my finger where the smaller halo effects are at the top of the screen. I think the halo effect is happening because that part of the support is touching the screen. When I press down around the area, the halo becomes larger then returns when I lift up my finger. Really annoying. Not sure if I should try putting on the second protector and hope I have a better luck with it.

I received this one time, but the box was ripped and not in great condition. I used the tempered glass screen, but it really isn't the correct size; a tad shorter than my iPhone SE and I have trouble when using certain keys, etc. The case is pretty much bent out of shape and feel it could be salvageable, but have yet to put it on. I would have returned it, but I didn't think there was a problem at first, so I had already put the new glass screen on my phone. I am not sure I'll use the case or not at this point.

Bought two chargers but only tried one. First attempted to plug into a surge protector and the usb to my phone (Nexus 5X). The charger only supplied current intermittently - my phone was not charging and the indicator light on the charger itself was blinking on and off. Just to check whether the surge protector was the problem, I tried it on a wall outlet in my kitchen (on a different circuit) next, and this time it produced a serious electrical arc - larger and brighter than what I normally get if the circuit is just close to load capacity. I didn't bother trying the other one. I was initially encouraged by reviews here, but now I suspect that Anker just has serious quality control problems. Edit: While I remain skeptical about Anker's quality control, their customer service has been excellent. After I left my initial review here and had already returned the chargers to Amazon, Anker reached out and sent another charger gratis. I'm not sure if it is exactly the same model - the packaging is different (smaller box, no cable) and the LED is blue instead of the defective item's green - but I haven't had any trouble and have been generally satisfied with the replacement so far.

The negatives first. The adhesive is pretty weak. I may have to attach this with super glue. Since I'm putting it on a case and not on the phone's actual back, I don't consider this a major issue. The ring is very tight which sounds good, except it means sometimes the piece twists off when you're adjusting it, largely due to the previously mentioned weak adhesive. Finally if you look at the picture you'll notice a curve on the ring itself where it comes to a point in the middle. This looks good, but it makes the balance unstable. You can get around this by adjusting the angle, but that does mean you have fewer angles. It works better horizonal than vertical because of this, which is fine if you're just trying to watch videos. I also use these stands so that if someone pings me I don't need to pick up my phone to see the message, so that's not ideal. If the ring was flat instead of peaked, this wouldn't be a problem. So the positive? The material is great, it doesn't look or feel remotely cheap. And it looks completely awesome. Feels good in the hand, much more comfortable to use than a pop socket. I'm recommend it, but I'd also recommend a tube of superglue. The peaked ring is less useful, but it looks cool, so you need to ask yourself whether you're more interested in the phone standing vertical, or the accessory looking good. If you want horizontal for videos, this will meet your needs.

I bought the new 2020 iPad, and sure enough, they changed the size of the plug-in port! So, off to find new plugs, cords, etc. I found these, and they weren't too expensive (should have known there, but it's not a complicated piece), so I ordered them. BOTH of them blinked on & off & on & off, etc. Neither would stay steady, so back they went. It's hard to just find the plugs without the cords, too. I had already purchased the cords, and didn't want to get more than I needed. that's the way they merchandise things. ...get you to buy more than you need! Anyway, I finally found another one/pair and ordered them. they work just fine, thank you.

I have about 6 different Qi chargers that I use regularly between home and work for my iPhone. They ranged from generic $15 ones up to the $60 name brand ones. In general, I see no perceivable difference in the charging speed of any of them. This Belkin model is pretty large and significantly more expensive than other models and I don't see any reason to pay more for it unless you like the design. Unlike every other charger I own, this one requires a dedicate wall wart instead of just a USB charger which is a significant pain in my opinion. This cord is special and has a large brick that make it more difficult to use in my already crowded power strip. The Belkin works well... always charges my phone reliably, and can be used horizontal or vertical, however many stands available for 1/2 the price offer similar features. Unless you love the look of it, I'd recommend something cheaper with solid reviews because this does nothing better and the dedicated power cord is a big negative.

My old band broke so i purchased these. I liked the idea of having options and put the white one on immediately after they arrived... and haven't been able to change it since. It's been getting super dirty while at work and it does clean up with a little effort but I got tired of having to do so everyday so I attempted to remove once again today. I finally was able to remove one side with maximum effort but the other side wouldn't budge and started to tear and I decided to just finish the job as this was the only way it was coming off. I'm pretty upset since the white was the one I was most excited about, I wanted to just swap it out on weekends or something. I inspected why this was happening upon removal and it's obvious that the button does not move the latch release almost at all. Meaning the latch never exits the insertion hole. It's a flawed design but at least it's secure? I recommend choosing the band you either love the most or the least as you probably won't be able to remove it which can either be great since you love it or terrible since you'll have to break it to take it off like I just had to. :(

The case makes the already large phone much bigger and heavier. It protects well enough but the USB charging port hole is misaligned and makes it difficult to plug in the charger or headphones. The case itself is not all that easy to snap on or take off. The protective glass is a pain to install and despite being careful it went out slightly crooked and so it looks ugly around the edges. In addition it has made the touch screen very difficult to use. It interferes with the fingerprint scanner and sometimes refuses to allow touches at the bottom of the home screen to register. It is really annoying to the point where I am researching new cases and protective screens.

I bought this case because my husband and my kids have one for their phones and it had held up really well. First of all the case is not light pink, it's neon pink. I was hoping for the light pink but I figured it would be okay because the case was well made. Unfortunately my case does not seem as well made as the other two we have. This one is already coming apart at the bottom near the home button and the plastic cover where the charger goes is pretty stiff, it presses on the cord when charging. Other than that it does seem sturdy and I feel like my phone would be okay if I dropped it. Still a bit disappointed though.

I have purchased Otterbox Commuter iphone cases for years. I've always liked the slim profile of the Commuter and was hoping this one would be the same way. To my surprise and slight disappointment, I found that this case was much bulkier than what I have been used to with the iphone 6s Commuter cases. It's a nice case, but it makes my iphone XR feel like an iphone 6Plus (its HUGE)! It's something to get used to. So, if you're not up for having a larger phone because of the case, I would pass on this one. But, if you're willing to get used to it, it really is a nice case. I purchased the Aqua Blue and its beautiful.

Simple enough to install (even though I still have a few air bubbles (I'll just reinstall the second one)) and seems like it'll just fine in regards to keeping the screen safe from general light scratches and wear. The way it FEELS though is quite awful. It's very grippy on your fingers, almost like you're swiping your fingers across rubber. Just sticky and unnatural feeling. Also, my hands aren't the least bit greasy (in fact they're dry from bleach most days) and within an hour of installing, the screen has very visible smudge and grease marks as if I had been handling oily food or something. Overall, it works I guess, but doesn't feel or look very smooth...

I received the wrong model which has since bee replaced at no cost. The new one is exactly what I wanted. I would recommend this item! I bought four of these last christmas. Two for my mom, and then two for me. They were heavy duty and I still use them. I often need a charger at work in a grocery store and my old ones were too big and heavy to keep with me. I was so excited to find the slim version! That is, until it arrived. It’s EXACTLY the same size. I used my kitchen scale to weigh them and it’s about a 5 gram difference. Don’t be fooled like I was, the “Slim” title means nothing.

I've had this case for a couple months but am looking at getting a new one. The pros: it looks good and seems sturdy and durable. The cons: It's very difficult to open the kickstand. Forget about trying to do it with your fingernail. You need a butter knife or some other thing sturdy tool to get it open. Even worse though are the volume buttons. I press them and 90% of the time nothing happens. You really have to fiddle around with the area near the volume buttons to get them to work. I'm guessing it's an issue with the case not fitting as well as it should with the phone.

Works very well so far at keeping water out. I'm having a few problems, though. One is that the black plastic closure pieces at the top tend to separate and fall off the bag. They can be reattached, but it's a bit of a pain, and they need to be attached in order to make the waterproof seal. Two, the sleeve on the back of the bag that the armband slides through is separating from the bag on one side. I don't think I've put it through any great strain. Three and most importantly of the issues I'm having, it's tremendously uncomfortable to wear as an armband. I wear it on my wrist instead. On the arm, it pokes you and scratches you and doesn't hold the phone in place very well.

This mount does not fit into the CD slot on my Subaru Outback as well as I'd like it too. When driving over the crappy roads prevalent in northern Ohio, it wobbles up and down more than enough to make me nervous that it will pop out and fall onto the shifter. The small handle to lock the unit into and release it from the cd slot is extremely tight in the locked position and came completely off the mount one time when I was trying to reposition the mount. Luckily it wasn't broken and I was able to snap it back on.

If you want a phone case without a kickstand then this phone case would work. For the first week it was fine and would hold the phone but it is quickly getting harder to get it to a position that holds the phone up. The metal piece on the back is just getting loose so it does not hold the phone up well. You have to turne the metal kickstand sideways to get it to hold and even then it just slides down unless you have it perfectly positioned. I Have only had it for a few weeks and it is already getting worse so I would definitely look for a different phone case unless you don't care about the kickstand.

I purchased because I wanted a case I could use with wireless charging but also a ring to secure my hold on the phone/kickstand. It’s working out but the inner little frame you install first lifts my tempered glass screen protector which is quite annoying. I opted out of using it which still works but it makes the case looser which lets more dust and stuff in which has kind of scratched up the sides of my phone. It would have been much better just to make the case snug and gotten rid of the frame. The back slide ring takes a few days of use to loosen up a bit so be patient. If you don’t use screen protectors then you’ll be very satisfied.

I honestly do appreciate the products however the top piece is too weak and easily breakable. The first time I got the case, top piece kept fell off because its edge could not fit the case. I contacted the manufacturer if they have the top piece of the case, They told me that they do not have spare pieces but I can contect the manufacturer in China to help me- of course they sent me a iPhone 7 Plus size top piece which I was very disappointed, yet I was able to get a new case from the first manufacturer after emailing the company. Although they sent a new one, it did not last for a month, with one drop the top piece fell off again. Sigh, what can I say, the service is decent, however the product need to be a lot stronger than a plastic piece- especially the top and buttom parts;thus,I hope they can change the top and bottom material in to something else.

We've had several of the moto phones over the years. We have liked the pricing and the features. We've always purchased unlocked phones and have had no problems on using them with various BYOD service providers. This has saved us hundreds of dollars. However, recently we purchased two G6 phones and both had issues after about one year. One phone has developed several dead spots on the screen which makes using it very difficult. On the other phone, the charging port failed. For both phones we contacted Moto customer service and in both cases a minimum cost of $100 was required to repair the phones. It just seems like the build quality isn't what it used to be. We have decided to try Samsung phones for our next round of purchases.

This would have protected my phone really well in the long term, but it felt so blocky/hefty and didn't seem to have much actual grip to it. After ten days I went with a thinner case that had a grippier back. Power and volume buttons weren't raised. I thought they weren't great and blended in too much with the side of the case. The kickstand was there, that's about the best I can say about it. It feels cheap. Pros: Your phone will be very well protected from drops. Cons: Your phone will be encased in a slippery brick with suspect feeling buttons on the side.... so you're going to give the sturdiness of the case a test as you drop it more than you might a tpu type case.

The privacy factor worked great. It just kept having air bubbles and the first one I will admit, I cracked it bc I didn’t have my protective case on my phone and the screen protector actually hit an angle where my case usually would have been. The second one though I have no clue how it chipped and got a crack on the bottom. It was in my back pocket, screen to tush bc I was at work and I’m clumsy and walk into everything, didn’t touch it all night and then when I finally pull it out there was a big crack from the bottom to the top. Screen was 100%, but I was disappointed bc I also had my protective case on that time.

As a guy there really aren’t many ways to accessorize, especially if you aren’t into jewelry; my one exception is my Galaxy Watch 4 Classic. The style of the watch is sharp, so I’m very picky about the watch bands I use. These bands from Areziir are… interesting.. They fit the watch perfectly and don’t leave a gap where the pin secures the strap into the watch like other generic bands do, this is a plus as having a gap just makes the watch look ‘cheap’. Unlike other brands I’ve tried, the watch bands are perfectly sized and install easily. The only issue I have is the bizarre pallet of colors they’ve chosen to use for these watch bands; they remind me of my wife’s makeup compact. They appear different in person than they do in the picture, probably because of the way they reflect light and appear more shiny. As they say, "Beauty is in the eye of the beholder". For me these colors would match someone’s makeup pallet more than they would my shirts. The quality, fit, and feel is great. The colors are just not for me.

Got loose after 6 month heavy use. Every time I try charging I have to force/push the cable in an angle to get it to charge. This product works great. I bought an iPhone 6S in October 2016 and because it got good ratings, I ordered this screen protector. It's June 2017 and I'm just now changing it. Because it came with 2, I went to put it on and it was for an iPhone 6 PLUS! I have NEVER owned any iPhone Plus. I always got the regular one because I thought they were too big. I liked the macro lens the best. The charge for the manufacturer to replace is 5.99usd. But it's obviously just cheap plastic that's going to break again they sell two packs for $10 they're the exact same specs as the OtterBox they just don't say OtterBox on it disappointed in the company because if you spend $50 on a phone case it shouldn't break within 30 days of normal use no drops. I very seldom write reviews - bad habit, as I never buy anything without reading at least 10 reviews BUT this screen protector is absolutely amazing. It actually IMPROVED my screen responsiveness! My phone is new and there was a 'dead' area on the screen that wouldn't respond to the S Pen, finger touch only. After installing this protector my screen response is better than new. It went on fairly easily - I had to reposition it a few times - it came off easily without damaging. Once it was on (now 6 months later) it is completely invisible and so far scratch-proof. It goes around the curve completely - took a bit of holding it down to stay in position around the curve but once it stuck it was perfect. Unfortunately only one protector came in this (advertised) 2-pack. After contacting the seller twice I still got no response. If it wasn't for this poor response this would be the only product I would use for the life of my phone, but now I'll try a few others.

It is a little bit bulky which I figured it would be since it is shock proof. It takes between 7-8 hours to charge. We charged our smart phones with it and it took 3-4 hours to get the phone to 80%. It started at close to 10%. The second time we used it, it seemed to go a little bit quicker. My husband was using his phone while it charged and it got to 75% from the red line in around 2-3 hours. The flashlight is VERY bright. Much brighter than I thought it would be. Very reasonably priced. Arrived quickly.

I like the design and it seems durable. The only complaints I had about the product was that the power button cover on the case wasn't flexible what so ever and kept holding the power button down causing it to turn off only to turn off. I actually had to cut the button off my case so I could use it. Secondly, like anything you buy on the internet, you can't really check the quality before the purchase. There was some blemishes in the design like spots on the middle of the skull, the edges of the case are a bit rough. I used the stylus maybe once but other then that it's kind of just there... The screen cover is exceptionally well. But Like I said, you get what you pay for. Overall, nothing major wrong, just that darn button cover but it was an easy fix. It stays on and fits my Samsung galaxy prevail 2.

Upon opening the package I was impressed by the quality of the genuine leather; very soft and with a consistent grain. The stitching along the bottom and lateral sides make for an appealing touch of detail. I was immediately excited about swapping out my old silicone Apple case for this leather case. Unfortunately when I attempted to put the case on my phone I noticed that the top right corner (camera side) lip was deformed and therefore would not properly attach to the phone, making the case unusable. I will be returning this case and exploring other options unless Mcmadley will stand behind their products and make this situation right. I decided upon a 2 star review due to the quality of the leather, I would have left a 1 star otherwise. I will follow up on my review after I hear back from Mcmadley.

Works for its intended purpose. Can set my phone at a variety of different angles, usually I use it either over my face when laying on my back or next to my face when I am lying on my side. I have a heavier phone, and sometimes the neck isn't strong enough to hold it up and starts sagging and I have to move it around until it gets into a position that holds. Also note that depending on your headboard, you probably need to make sure you have at least an inch or two of clearance from the wall to accommodate the clip.

I still lost my wallet with this thing. Do you know why? It works really well when you misplace it around the house, but if lost in public, there's no chance this will help you. First of all, I REALLY wish it notified you when the wallet was out of range. If it started beeping or whatever when I left the gas station, I could have retrieved the wallet right away. Unfortunately, I noticed it was gone about an hour later. The Tile did help me determine where I lost it, and it was the gas station. When I returned, the wallet wasn't there and the employee had no idea where it was. So that's that. Maybe if the range was a bit better than 30 feet, or my phone notified me when the tile was out of range, it would have helped me retrieve my wallet.

Wow! I have been thru so many cases because I have not been impressed, but I have to say I am super impressed with this case!!!! Such great quality and design. I like that my phone sits in a rubber case so the body doesn't get scratched. Super tight fit, and the material seems to be great quality. I definitely recommend this case!!!!! Just bought a 2nd just to have as a back up. Only case I will have. Update: the case itself is fine, but the belt clip holder is poorly designed. The 2nd holder has broken and you can't buy just the belt clip.

Don't bother. The screen is nice if you get it just right the first time. When I laid the screen the first time, the screen went off the center even though I was trying to be careful. If I had 2 in the pack, I could have done better with the 2nd one now I know the screen would slide a tiny bit when first being released. I could have left it crooked - which would bother me all the time, or try to take it off and re-install - which invariably left a bubble space around the edge, which also bothers me. I vote for no screen. I should have listened to the other reviewers to save myself 10 bucks.

Almost fits perfectly... And that almost is everything. Used their car for the Pixel 3 XL and it was flawless for what it was: a 2 piece case without a kickstand. It had great grip, good texture, and good color, all while pulling off a great fit. The new case for the Pixel 4 XL however is all those things except the fit is almost there. When I push on the chrome pass through power button, it works exactly as intended. When I click on the down volume button, the tactile feel of the clock passes through, but when I click the up button, I have to press hard, and it never delivers the click. It's so close, but it might as well miss by a mile.

I purchased this headset after reading several reviews that mentioned it was 'great'; that may be true if you only use it to make regular phone calls but it definitely lacks the quality needed for a Zoom conference call. The mic makes your voice sound hollow and it seems as though you are in an empty bottle or on one of those old speaker phones. The incoming sound is too low -regardless of how high the volume of your speaker is set. The noise cancelling feature is okay. The one-sided feature would be great and comfortable except for the fact that the small cushion that rests on your head on the non-hearing side got horribly tangled in my hair, making it very uncomfortable. Connecting the Bluetooth was a breeze (I use a MacBook Pro and iPhone) it immediately connected to both without any problems. Switching from one device to the other was seamless and I am guessing that the battery life must be awesome. Unfortunately, because of the poor sound quality, I had to return it.

EDIT: After having it for a year, it started to yellow. I've had it for two years now, and it still does its job; but it's now very yellow haha. I'll dock two stars for that; but I think that's really just the nature of the TPU material. Very cool. This case is awesome. It uses a very good quality flexible mold, that has a great balance between being grippy, yet won't stick to your clothes inside your pockets. It's quite thin, yet, the sides protrude out just enough (perfect width) to protect the screen when you have the phone upside down on a desk. Also, the protrusion is nearly the exact length of the protruding camera of the new iphone6, so it sits flush on the desk. The case fits like a glove. The case is not cloudy at all, and there's absolute no discoloration through it (unlike other clear rubbery cases I've tried). Also, a cool unattended feature is that when you have the flashing enabled when you receive texts and phone calls, the light travels across the thin case and it looks like the entire phone is lighting up. It's great. Thanks LUVVITT for making a very decent case.

I love that the case isn't too bulky. I love that access to the fingerprint scanner is just as easy to get to as it is without the case. I also like that the edges don't interfere with my swiping or having access to the sides. What I can't stand is that the case is a bit too slippery to hold. The material, while it looks like it has more grip/grit to it, it doesn't. I have very small hands and I've almost dropped this phone about 6 times after I got the case but not once without a case at all. It's also harder to hold due to a) the "squareness" of the edges, and b) the ridges of the cutouts cut into my pinky (which I use as a "base" to keep my phones from slipping through my hand). I'm probably going to have to ruin the case by putting duct or gaffe tape on the back of it to make it more grippy, but this is the third case I've tried and I'm getting sick of returning them (I'm sure Amazon is too lol). I'll keep it as it is a decent case with some minor flaws but it will be tossed into a drawer once I find a case that I'm more satisfied with. EDIT TO ADD: I've gotten much more used to the case now (about a week or two later). I didn't apply duct tape, but I DID take a nail file to scuff up the sides of the case where your fingers and thumb hold on to the phone -- and since then it hasn't slipped once. :)

I like lightweight cell phone cases. I also like transparent cases - you spend all that money on a phone, why hide it behind a brightly colored or patterned case? While this case meets both those concerns, I'm just not convinced that its going to provide the best protection for my iPhone Max. There's just not enough of a raised lip around the edges of the case and its completely flat around the camera lens. The material of the case is also paper thin around all the openings. I don't understand this. Obviously that part of the case is handled quite often, so why make that part of the case so much thinner than the rest of the case? The back of the case is also a fingerprint magnet. More so than transparent cases made of silicone.

I've had this case for about 2 weeks now. I like it buy it's bulky and the plastic corners are fragile. I've manage to break 3 out of 4 corners in the matter of 3 days just from taking it off it's clip. I'm expecting the 4th corner to bust tomorrow at this rate. I bought it because it looked durable and the case I originally purchased wasn't the correct one built to military grade. So I got this one instead. Looks like I better shop around again soon before the case kills my phone! You'll see the top left corner is the only one holding up!

I have the iPhone 4s and I'm notorious for breaking phone because I drop it all the time - falls off the bed/couch/table/, it often falls out of the truck onto cement ground when I get out of the car because I forgot it was in my lap, it sometimes falls in puddles - and this case and protected it through all that. You could through it against a wall and it would be fine. The only down side is that after 10 months of use my screen is scratched and sometimes it's difficult to click on things in the corners of the screen due to the plastic. It could just use a new plastic sheet. The other biggest issue is that the headphone jack is on the wrong side so I have to lift up the rubber thing every time I want to use headphones. Also, the bottom flap doesn't always stay put in place.

After reading the reviews I'm highly disappointed. I got the shield for the Galaxy Note 10 and it was too big. I had to cut it down to the best of my ability because it was over an eighth of an inch too big. The sides were extremely difficult to get down even using a drier as suggested. The edges still do not stay down completely on their own and need to have the phone case on just to hold all the edges down completely. I used the squeegee as instructed, and their were just a few bubbles left that were supposed to go away, but still remain. The fingerprint reader reads well, and much better than the glass one I had tried that didnt even work at all. So far I have not had any trouble with scratches. Had the edges stayed down and bubbles went away, I'd have given this a much higher rating, although it is still not easy to put on. In all hi honesty, if this had not been so difficult and not needed to be cut and let dry for over 12 hours, I have probably returned it or exchanged it for one the right size that fit better and had the edges stay down and bubbles go away, but I guess I'll use it as long as the edges dont come up too far. Hopefully yours fish and works better than mine did.

This product indicated it is compatible with iphone 8, which is the type of phone I have; the original one had cables that did not fit my iphone; I chatted online with a gentleman who assisted me with process of returning the one I have and getting a replacement, which I received the other day; the cables that came with this battery charger are the same as the first one and do not fit my iphone 8; I choose to keep this product as I do have cables that are compatible, however I am not satisfied with the misinformation about the product.

The outer cover on this is really flimsy. It easily pulls away from the phone. Also, I've had this for a couple of month and the areas that pull back to allow connections (power cord, headset) are already tearing. If you cannot find a better cover, this will be ok. Just don't expect it to last long. My husband got the black case (mine is the pink case) and his is MUCH better than mine (I wonder why?). UPDATE: the port covers have pulled off completely. I've had this cover for 4 1/2 months. It's not handled roughly, but I do use the earphone port and the power supply port regularly. For the amount if money it cost for this case, I'm very disappointed how quickly it fell apart.

Edit: I reordered and my newest pack was different. The dry pads did not get rid of lint, rather it caused it. I used a new eyeglass cloth for the lint. I wasted 2 out of the 3 trying to get it on. Oh well. i got two of three on my first order. Its just frustrating. Each time Ive changed it its because the older one got cracked within a few months. Wish it lasted longer. I just put it on and it was the easier screen protector process ever. The frame is genius. I usually hate protectors but this was pretty low stress. Seriously. The frame.

I love the way this watch looks, and it is easy to operate. I am really disappointed in two things— the heart rate isn’t even close to being accurate. I know that wrist heart rate is not as accurate, and I can accept that, but my HR literally goes from 170 to 65 while running at the same effort. It is so far off, it’s worthless. The second issue that I have is with battery- I did a long running race last weekend, was worried about the battery and shut off everything possible. It only lasted 7.5 hours, not the 11 that I saw advertised. It’s unfortunate, because I do like everything else about the watch but for me as an avid runner and cyclist, these two features are important.

So upon first look, I think that this looks super aesthetically pleasing and I really like the feel of the sturdiness of this case. However, after a short period of usage, one portion in the top right corner of the case has already cracked and it makes me think that it's not so durable which is why I've deducted a star. On top of that, the design of the case has started to chip off after a mere month of usage which is quite disappointing because I didn't expect this to happen so soon. I will be looking for a new replacement case but this was good while it lasted the time that it did.

My first impression was "Wow this feels cheap and wobbly" upon opening the box. After reading it in small letters it reminds you to tighten the screws. I can't help but wonder why this wasn't done during assembly (1 star minus) but its a simple task... Provided you don't strip the screws while tightening them and they are weak and if you over do it you will strip them so just take your time. When equipped it is comfortable and looks fine. The loop that keeps the excess band from flopping around was not assembled well and looks like it will break easily. Later I may show pictures but I do not expect this product to have a long life (1 star minus). When everything is said and done though I'll be keeping this and using it as an expendable backup band.

Bought this for my moto g 4g lte. it holds it, but only just. I have had it fall out once while on my dash, but i have a pretty thick case... the little disc work pretty good, as long as it isn't cold outside. I had a heck of a time getting the mount to stick to the disc at first but it was 18 F outside at the time. As soon as it was warmer, i got it to stay better and the adhesive has not come off or anything. other than that, this thing is sweet. Edit 7-20-2015: All 4 little fingers that hold the phone on the mount have broken. It's been a little over 6 months, so I guess that's not horrible, but I had hoped to get a bit more time out of it. Disc hasn't come off the dash and the suction cup is still holding fine, but the part that holds my phone is completely useless. 3 stars for 6 months, but there are cheaper holders out there that will last at least that long. I wouldn't buy this one again...

This case fits the Moto G7 power just fine and seems adequate to protect against your average phone drop from 3-4' or so onto a hard surface. I've dropped my phone a few times over the 8 weeks or so I've had the case and have had no issues with protection. I generally keep my phone in a pocket and black coating wore off on the edges of the case within just a couple of weeks. This doesn't affect the durability of the case but it does look bad. The kickstand seems sturdier than what I had had in other cases and since it is designed as a loop you can put it on your finger like a ring to help hold the phone securely if needed. Pros: Good protection for the price, good price, has a rotating kick stand Cons: Black coating wore off on edges within a couple of weeks, would prefer that the edges of case were slightly taller to help protect screen when face down on a surface more

Got the Casemate cover immediately after picking up the phone. Initial impression is good but for that small sagging lip above the charging point. In fact I would hazard to say that it provides a good protection while retaining a very slim design in comparision to otterbox or griffin. But obliviously There is no dust protection or water resistance. For an additional $ 4 to 5 their offer is more is of more value but at the cost of becoming bulky. So Casemate is good for regular office but for a outdoor trip griffin or otterbox maybe a better choice.

Super easy to correctly apply with the help of provided screen alignment frame. Cannot beat the value of these protectors. Three screen protectors and screen cleaning kits are provided. I have used these protectors before and they are proven tough by me accidentally dropping items on my phone with no damage. The only reason I rated 4 stars is the fact that with the protector perfectly aligned, the top and bottom of the protector match the contour of the screen well, but there is a problem with the left and right sides. When the protector adheres to the phones screen it appears black and disappears. I have about an eighth of an inch on each of the left and right sides that looks gray. When I press on the protector side it turns black but when I release pressure it pulls away turning gray within 5 seconds. Apparently the protector is not curved as much as my iphone 8 plus screen. I tried a second protector and the outcome was the same. Used my third protector on my other iphone 8 plus with the exact same outcome.

*2021* update I no longer recommend this phone mount. I've gone through 2 phone mounts since i purchased. In high heat this stickiness and grip to the dash board starts to melt off and get everywhere. I've tried resticking it and also purchasing this again hoping it was a one time faulty phone holder but it happened to both phone holder over the course of time. So, I say for 1 to 2 years if you're lucky you can get daily use out of it but after that it's pretty much trash. Very sturdy and easy to set up right out the box. It's very strong and hold my IPhone 8 without a problem. I also tested it with a larger phone Note 8 and fits as well. You might find it easier with a slim case and it has an adjustable knob to tighten or loosen it to your liking. It's a great hands free option for ride share drivers like Uber, Lyft , grub hub or simply to use for GPS. I've recommended this same exact phone holder to friends and family and even considering buying this again especially at this price.

Pros: - Soft and nice to touch - Secured so you will never lose the watch - Interchangeable straps, you can buy any standard 20mm strap with quick release mechanism and use this strap with the band pointers which are attached to the watch Cons: - Heavy and not suitable for 24 hours wearing - Green color is not so vivid and bright as on the pictures of this product and as the original Nike band. This is a deal breaker for me. I'm really disappointed with the color mismatch. Will take some comparison pictures later and update my review so you can see the difference yourself.

This is the second one I bought. The case that hold the phone was great, it comes with a built stand, so if your watching a movie you can open the stand and place the phone down so you longer have to hold the phone. But the belt clip is made of some cheap material. When I bought the first one and the belt clip broke I thought It was me. But when the second belt clip broke in the same spot, now it the belt clip. If you like or combine the case for the phone with a different belt clip it great but overall not worth the money because of the clip.

The colors were nice, quality and comfort of the strap was perfect. However, after only a week of wearing one color (only taken off to shower and charge but otherwise wore 24/7) the metal clasp of the band showed signs of the paint color peeling/chipping off. The photo I attached is about a month of use. I do not work in construction or anything that would excessively bang it up. Just working from home computer during pandemic shut down so very little impact use. So, poor quality on the painted clasp/buckle but if you just change colors for a day or night out to match your outfit and remove afterwards or if you don't mind this issue then the bands are otherwise good. On the contrary, my Samsung factory band that came with my watch has been used for many months without any similar defects or chips.

The New Trent Alixo 6S case comes in an attractive looking package and is a very slim yet attractive thin case. It comes with a white cover as well as a black cover to enable one to match the face of their iPhone. I found it challenging to peel the soft outer case from the hard inner case as outlined in step one of the instructions printed on the back of the box. I ended up punching through the front surface of the screen, this removing the clear surface the would protect the front of the iPhone. Pros: The case is slim and light. The case in general is protective and covers the phone and all of its ports fully. The moldable material surrounding the outer part of the case is made of a non slip type material making it easier to firmly grip the case. The case is transparent and see-through on the sides and back clearly displaying the color of one's iPhone as well as the Apple logo on the back. For those with the Gold iPhone, this highlights the phone's colors. Cons: The membrane used to protect the Touch ID makes it difficult to use Touch ID unless ones pushes really hard. Many 3rd party Lightning cables will not fit into the port due to the small opening provided by the case.

Great case. Have dropped it a few times with no damage done to the phone. S-Pen is near impossible to pull out due to the rubber and no indent. I have use the rubber edges to pull it out slightly. It's a pain! I have no nails so if you do it should be easier to remove. The screen protector is complete garbage.
