Like many, I got this charger for traveling and figured it could replace multiple chargers. When it worked, it worked well and we did charge 3 things at once a few times. However, this charger is very long / sticks out from the wall relative to other chargers, and then once you add cables, it gets extremely heavy. It pulled itself out of the wall everywhere we went, and really only worked in hotels that had horizontal outlets from a lamp, etc. We ended up being disappointed because we hadn't anticipated this issue, and couldn't charge everything at once. It also gets warm.

I received the package and everything inside of the box was very well protected. I’ve had the protector on the phone for about a week now and I feel like it isn’t as dark as it originally was/it’s defective. The tempered glass protector messes with the quality of the camera when the flash is on. If the flash is off it isn’t a problem but when it is it’s as if there is a milky/blurry filter on the picture. If you don’t mind the things stated above then I guess you should purchase this product but I think you would be better off purchasing something with higher reviews.

Pros: 2 cases and 2 screen protectors. Good deal I think. Tried the black case and tempered glass screen protectors. CONs: First screen protector had a small nick/cut/smudge on the sticky side and it caused it to look unsightly. And on screen fp sensor unusable. So, took it off and placed the second one. It stuck clean and easy. But fp sensor became wonky. Had to remove and re-add fp. After that, it works about 70-80% of the time. Face recognition is fast, so, not a very big problem with day to day use. But with apps that use fp authentication, it is a pain in the ... Bottom line: Cases are decent. Screen protector is not so much.

I was excited to get these screen protectors, but when I reviewed them, they looked almost like they had been used before.. I made sure my screen was super clean to avoid getting dust or other particles underneath the screen protector, washed my hands and the surface in which I was applying the cover.. But there was still a whole bunch of crap underneath the screen protector when I put it on my phone.. I wasted 2 before I got one mostly free of debris. It seemed to me as if they were just dirty to begin with, before I even peeled either of the outer coverings off. So needless to say, I was a little disappointed.

I bought this product a couple of months ago and the adhesive has stood extreme heat, low and high humidity. I gave the second pair to my dad and neither has had any problems with it. Depending on your case (basically how far away the metal piece is separated from the magnet) you might notice your phone start to rotate, but it will not fall. UPDATE: almost exactly one year after my purchase, the piece of plastic that tightens the grip on the mount broke. This piece joins the fixed mount part with the spinning part, so essentially the whole thing is useless now. I definitely expected more than 1 year's use.

After less than a year, this fell from my dash and I've not been able to get it to stay for more than a week or two at a time. I dont have a garage. I live where we get both freezing temps about 10 days a year and hot temps above 85F for a couple of months on and off. Other than that, I loved it. My friend has one and he also doesn't park in a garage, but he lives 5 miles away where temps don't get so extreme (gotta love mocro climates). His seems to have stayed on his dash fine and he's had it longer than I have had mine.

I bought this case because I have a Jet Black iPhone 7 and every transparent case I've found bubbles along the back and makes the phone look terrible. I was hoping that a simple bumper case that leaves the back exposed would give me the best of both worlds, protection and a clean look. While the RhinoShield CrashGuard looked like it would do everything I wanted, I ended up returning it. The description claims that the case is slim and non-intrusive, but it actually adds significantly to the height and width of the device. In my case it added just enough bulk to prevent me from using the iPhone 7 with one hand. There's also a fairly sharp ridge running all around the case that I found uncomfortable when holding the phone. I don't doubt that this case provides excellent drop protection, but the inconvenience of losing one-handed use of my phone combined with the uncomfortable feeling of the ridge digging into my hand every time I held the device was was too much. If I had an iPhone 7 Plus, which is already an inherently two-handed device, I would buy this case for it without hesitation.

I had to separate the rubber bit like the jaws of an alligator to get it on my air vent, but it finally fit. The magnet is so strong I kept accidentally pulling the whole unit out of my air vent, but this can be easily remedied by changing the way you pull your phone off. (Try a peeling motion rather than straight off.) Only problem I'm having is after only a couple hours of use, the glue that holds a thin material over the magnet has become unstuck and is starting to peel. Looks really tacky in my truck, especially for a literally brand new product. Overall though, I give it a 3 out of 5. Love the magnet strength. Hate the build quality.

I tried all the tricks - putting it on in a steamy room, cleaning my phone thoroughly before applying, and following the instructions to a T yet I still got air bubbles around the sides and top. After using it for about a month, the tempered glass started to pop off at the top. It looks ridiculous and now I'm a little worried I might cut myself when I use the phone. Not sure if it's the product or I did something wrong when applying it to my phone so I'm giving it 3 stars. I decided to skip the tempered glass all together and bought the Halo Screen Protector Film and that is working much better for me.

So far I'm the lucky one since I haven't dropped my phone since it's been in the case, but I'm sure it's a matter of time sigh... Quickly - the good: * Yes the case is very sturdy. It does add a bit of weight overall because of the glass backing. * The locking mechanism is a great feature. The phone feels very secure in the case * The dust seal around the camera lens is a nice touch (good luck applying it to the case though) * The back absolutely does not touch the back of the phone so I can see my shiny Jet Black phone sans smudges and fingerprints The not so good: * It's GLASS - it will break eventually duh! (See the other reviews) * No refund policy if you're not happy with the product. You bought it, you're stuck with it, better hope you like it. * The front of the case sits flush with the phone. Absolutely best to have a glass screen protector on it (not the flimsy plastic that ships with the case either). Frankly, I'm more concerned about my screen breaking if I drop the phone * The dust seal around the camera lens is good but no matter what, you WILL get dust in the case so be prepared for that. It's a good looking case but it's pretty much a $45 accident waiting to happen...

I like the picture on the back. It is a bit chopped up by the holes, but I knew that when I ordered it. I didn't want a bulky phone case, but this one went too far in the opposite direction, in my opinion. It's thin, which would be great, except it doesn't cover the ends of the phone -- which is where my phone will hit when I drop it. It's hard to tell by the picture, but the top and bottom of the cover are U-shaped. The sides cover completely, with voids where the buttons are. I wish I hadn't bought it because I feel like it won't protect my phone if it fell.

The product did not fit my Samsung Galaxy and appeared to be about half an inch too long on both ends. I ended up having the cut a large section on the top to be able to fit, while still using the notch prefabricated for the finger print detector. After that, it was (just like most) a pain to get on without bubbles, lint, or finger prints. But once it was on, it stayed there for a year. When I finally upgraded my phone and peeled off the protector, I found a scratch free and in perfect condition screen. Win.

This case could have been 5 stars easily. Some major flaws in my opinion. 1, no need for that cutout for the Apple logo on the back. Seriously why would they do that? I covered that area of the phone with 3M carbon fiber film. 2, The lip around the front should be a little thicker to protect the front better and it should be gloss black to blend with the shiny front of the phone. 3, there should be a raised lip on the back around the camera to protect the camera lens a little better. The case almost sits flush with the camera. Kinda disappointed with this purchase.

This case was for my son's new phone. It arrived promptly & as promised. The case is sturdy & has a "kickstand" that allows the phone to stand both portrait & landscape. Only thing he doesn't like about it is there's a little port cover for the charging plug - he felt the area should've been left open like the spot for the power button. Overall, a very good product that I would recommend. UPDATE: Sturdy enough - haven't dropped the phone, so can't say whether or not it's protective. My review regards the "kickstand." After using it about 30 times, a tiny plastic "pin" that holds the kickstand in place broke off & now it doesn't lock in place when not in use.

Update as of 08/21/2015 My phone dropped in my New Trent case and is cracked on all sides and in the middle, I am devastated and disappointed. Original Review: Protects fully at a great price. Why buy more expensive products when this is just as great. The inner shell put on the phone itself is made with TPU and thick, it protects from falls/drops. I have already dropped my galaxy a handful of times with this case on and no one would ever know. It does have a plastic type covering to protect the screen, and I found (unlike a few other reviews) it does not prohibit functioning the screen at all. I actually prefer and like the plastic screen cover that comes with this case, I was still able to use all the functions 100% with it on. All around this case is a little more expensive than others (and well worth it), but at the same time is not as expensive as an Otter Box, while providing the same function. I recommend to anyone looking for a highly protective Samsung Galaxy S5 case.

Meh. I wouldn't buy another one. It's fun to look at but if you drop your smart phone then say your prayers before the device hits the ground because this cover will do absolutely NOTHING to protect the phone. It is not made of rubber. It does nothing at all to protect the screen. It's a very thin synthetic material that is not protective at all. I keep my phone inside a tiny little zipping case (like a little laptop case). I am currently shopping for another, more protective rubbery case for the phone itself. I won't buy another one of these, though.

I was disappointed but not that surprised when this item arrived. The other reviews I had read told me that this was for the T959 (Vibrant) model and not the T959V (4G version). I contacted the company & they said I could return it for a full refund - they didn't offer me a partial refund as another reviewer reported. But it hardly seemed worth it as it originally cost under $6 & shipping would have cost me a couple of dollars plus my time etc. The two phones screens are essentially the same size but the 4G version has a front facing camera for video chat etc. You will need to trim the ZAGG screen protector just a little bit so that it doesn't cover the camera lens - I did it with some sharp scissors. Once you've done that just follow the instructions to install - I practiced with the back case one first (as the instructions suggest) to get used to the method. I nearly ran out of the spray though, so use it sparingly! Once I got it on it made my phone look BRAND NEW! Very smart product & I would definitely get one for my next phone.

The red one fell apart fast, had weak magnet, difficult to access on/off button (see comment below). Pink one, great material, easy access to on/off button, strong magnet. Go figure, it's like they were made by opposite companies that stamped one brand's name... . . . Update: This thing scuffed very quickly. The material is very weak and now it looks unsightly. Loved the design and light weight, but the material ended up being of very poor quality. When I bought the hot pink case for S4, the material held up exellently well, but it seems the red material is not the same as the pink and that is why it fell apart. Magnet is a bit weak, but can fit 5 plastics, 2 paper i.d.'s, few bills and still closes with a bit help. I do think if I drop phone, the magnet won't hold up - not like my previous one.

A nice case that fits well. Please note that I'm reviewing because I purchased one Aug 2017. I purchased my second case June of 2018. I really like the case. I am a klutz. I've dropped many phones and wanted a secure case. The previous case was dropped in water, mud, on concrete and my phone has no scratches and although not waterproof. When I took off the case to see if the phone was damaged or wet, the phone never had been damaged or wet. The CON= the screen cover on the case gets worn and scratched so much I had to purchase another case in order to see or show pictures taken. The case was less than a year old. But after comparison with pricing and knowing how protective the case is I chose to purchase the same brand again.

I ordered this after previously trying another competitor's screen protector. In comparison to that, this one is great. I noticed right away that the touch screen sensitivity wasn't impaired (like with my previous screen protector) and it was pretty good with not picking up every fingerprint - though yes, it still will get fingerprints. I haven't dropped my phone (and hopefully never will) so I don't know how it holds up to that, unfortunately. My biggest problem with this screen protector is that I purposely bought this so that would reduce the glare from the sun when I use it outside. Almost all the reviews I read raved about how great it was for that reason AND IT'S NOT. It hasn't done squat for me in that area and that's grating considering that's why I bought the product to begin with. So yes, if you're looking for a screen protector that doesn't reduce your sensitivity and doesn't retain every fingerprint and smudge, this product is great. If you're looking for a screen protector that will make it easier to see your screen in the sun, this is not the one for you.

I bought this item because I wanted a device I could use in rental cars, not for a more permanent dashboard installation. It's easy to take along and attaching it to air vents is simple, just open the jaws and clamp down. The problem is the swivel is too loose; it kept tipping sideways. I thought it was because I had the cord attached to keep the phone charged, therefore creating a weight on one side. But even when not attached, the holder had difficulty staying firmly in place when the phone is in the horizontal position. This is distracting to have to keep adjusting it while driving.

I like the look & material of this case, fitting on my 12 pro max perfectly. What caused low rating is the "360° Adjustable Ring Holder". It sounds like a good idea, but 2 major inconvenience for me: 1. the ring can only be used as a stand when the screen is horizontal, I would like it to stand on vertical direction when I read on my phone 2. I would like the stand to be stable. With the ring 360 adjustable, it also means it can easily rotate, so when it is used as the stand, it falls easily.

Hi After hearing all the reviews whether on third party sites , YouTube and etc. I decided to give it a shot purchasing it with my own money. First I purchased the ionglass( I was very disappointed and my review was denied. The screen protector did not adhere on one corner. Seems to be a chronic defect) back to the case. It’s very chic same size of the speck presidio pro. The problem was it didn’t cover the whole ionglass where there gaps eventhough I aligned the screen protector enclosed with a photos and defect. That was the only con where it didn’t cover the phone with its own product. Very disappointed. The case arrived crushed due to packaging. Return for a refund. Not impressed

The case looks nice. I get lots of compliments on it. However, I have a few issues with it. First, if I use the credit card slots on both sides, it becomes too bulky to close properly. The magnetic closure strap should be longer. Second, the magnet that holds the phone to the case is not as strong as it should be. If the case is jostled, the phone slips off of the case. Third, it has not held up well. I've been using it less than 2 months and the seems are already separating. I will soon need a replacement and will not buy this case again.

I really had I hopes for this case but within 30 days The charging port broke off so I couldn’t exchange it. Wasn’t the worst thing I could live with that. Within the next month the rubber that went around the case started to peel off, wasn’t horrible at first so I kept using the case. From there it would just keep peeling. Then the side buttons! Oh the side buttons! When you use them they will literally disappear on you . For the price of the case you would think it wouldn’t peel or look so gross! I clean my phone I have a 7 year old that uses it from time to time and little kids are nasty, I make sure to always clean my phone case. However, yes it’s a great case if you drop your phone a trillion times. My son even dropped my phone from a ride at a amusement park & it survived. LOVE THAT ABOUT THIS CASE but I am all set with a phone case that peels & leaves you with colored rubber pieces in your pocket or bag that looks so gross. I never used this case in the water even though it says it was water proof.. I really wish this phone case was made better. Please be aware if you do buy this case that your case can peel & ports & buttons can disappear. ***My case is less then 6 months old***

This Bluetooth does NOT play media. If you plan to use your Bluetooth to listen to music/videos/radio, this is not the one for you. I ordered this Bluetooth without knowing that, but then thought I could still work with it by downloading an app that would allow it to play media. It worked, sort of. Going through the app, the Bluetooth media would cut off a few seconds before a phone call came in and my phone would start blaring whatever media was playing for the whole office to hear. I opted to return it for a Bluetooth that plays media. Also, the earpiece is not very flexible. My previous Motorola had a nice earpiece that could maneuver in just about any direction, this one can not.

I like the Ceeya unit very much, but I'm holding out on a 5 star rating because... I charged a Kindle Paperwhite overnight. In the morning, the paperwhite was charged, but the Ceeya had dropped from 89% charge down to 27%. Paperwhites use very little energy, and if it had absorbed all that, I'm quite sure it would have exploded. No idea why the Ceeya unit continued to discharge. I'm going to try plugging in other devices and see if the Ceeya exhibits the same behavior with them. Update. Downgraded my rating to 3 stars. The unit continuously discharges with iPhones too. If you can’t leave something plugged in over night without running it most of the way down, it makes it quit a bit less useful.

Pros 1) It's a really pretty case. 2) Did protect my phone when I dropped it 3) affordable 4) fits well Cons: 1) Cracked when I tried to clean it. The first day I put it on my phone. The screen was hanging on to small dark particles on the inside of the case that I didn't see before I put it on. It was driving me crazy once I noticed, so I attempted to pry it apart and clean it again. It cracked at the bottom. I was able to put it back on and it has held together just fine. 2) It is HARD to take off (possibly a positive, but I'm putting it in cons because of it cracking when I did take it off) 3) not water resistant. I have spilled twice on it and twice it's seeped into the case, and because it's so hard to take off I just left it. (My phone itself is water resistant) so I have a small bit of dried up wine on my screen. 4) It's very slippery, no grip whatsoever.

Bought these to replace my initial screen protector that I put on last year and which cracked within days and finally got to to the point where I could hardly see through it. Unfortunately could not find any that really looked good, so settled on these. So I put one on (there are 3 in the package), and 4 days later it had a crack forming, starting from the near the bottom where the cutout for the button is. Within a couple of days the crack had expanded all the way to the cutout where the speaker is near the top of the screen. Also, while the fit seems to be decent, there are gaps at each corner where it does not quite provide complete coverage. And, there is a gap along one side where it doesn't quite fit with my existing case, though that isn't anyone's fault, really.

This case was one of three different ones I purchased so I could compare and pick the winner. It didn't win. It's attractive but a bit flimsy. There's no hard shell, it's just a one piece plastic case that's kind of stiff and not really a great fit. The sides of the case don't exactly hug the phone all that well so there's a bit of a gap. It just doesn't give me a secure sense of protection. But to return it, I would have had to pay shipping costs which was almost the same as the refund amount. So basically I'm stuck with it. But it was cheap enough so I'm not going to lose much sleep.

[[VIDEOID:8eae564112d4b0989954bfe6dc7efaf3]] - Feel like- soft silicone - Protection- overall protection screen plus metal sides -Very thin clear film outside the original Body - Touch is just the same. I had gotten a scratch on my watch, it was a defected piece. I had to return and order a new one. I had decided to not wear it without protection. I am glad I got this. Its classy protection and I do not have to compromise on how my apple watch looks. Update- I now have a little paint as my hand got slightly dragged with the wall but my watch is still safe. So removed 2 stars.

Have used this protector for the last four or five phone models. Always five-star rating, easy install. Used to come with a plastic snap-on cradle to align the protector perfectly. This time for the 6A, no cradle, just tape to try to make a hinge system out of it. Not a good installation setup. Went through all three protectors before getting it aligned correctly with camera opening and no air bubbles. It's a great protector if you can make it through the mickey mouse hinge installation process. It would be nice to know the reason for doing away with the snap-on cradle installation system!

I like the case very much, but once it is installed you may not be able to open it to install a micro SD card or clean up your phone. Or to replace your phone if your cellular company sends you a phone with outdated non-functional software installed and then has to send you a replacement (Thanks Virgin Mobile). Do I ever have a love hate relationship with Virgin Mobile...Sorry, for the digression. Anyway, the two tiny (I really mean tiny) pins at the top and bottom of the front cover are very likely to break if you ever attempt to open it. Which will make it worthless. I am returning the case for that reason. I may still buy another one once I get my new phone, but I will do so knowing that there is probably an 80 percent chance that I will break it if I ever have to open it...Also, the only instructions for installing the case consist of a few pictures. Why can't a company that spends so much time, effort, and money building a product put together a simple YouTube video showing how to install, re-install the product without breaking it?

The sparkling band is so cute; however, the metal pieces are starting to fade, turning orange n rusty. I just took out the silver band. As you can see, the silver metal is shiny, like new. Therefore, it will change color after about two weeks. Also, the band is strengthening, but it gets loose over time. It doesn’t stay tight as it should. After wearing it days after days, I noticed the band started to loosen up. I wouldn’t recommend getting this band, but if you want a unique style And cheaper made, then go for it. Otherwise, go with the apple stores to get you a good band. (You get what you pay for).

One of the 3' cords had a splotch of solder on one side of the device connector, shorting 3 of the leads across each other and rendering it non-operational. It would not charge my phone. The other cords were usable. The two 6' cords seem to actually be about 79" and 80" long (maybe made as 2-meter long cords). The 10 foot cord is actually about 10 feet long. The cords all seem to be well made. Surprising that they had a splotch of solder on one. I tried to scrape it off but was unable to do so. I actually needed the 3' cord for my car so disappointed it did not work.

I like the design of the case and the colors. What I don’t like is that the image is off center. The case is also slick to the touch. It feels quite slippery. There is no grip whatsoever. It does feel rather durable, for a decorative case. It has two pieces, and the plastic piece with the design on it has the ability to snap off from a more rubbery type of plastic. I don’t really understand why. All in all, it’s pretty. But I’m not sure it’s worth $18. EDIT: The case broke in less than a year. I liked the design so I ordered another one. The image was off center (again) and this case is blue on the sides for whatever reason. I also took a picture to show how it snaps apart. Really poor quality and will be returning this time around. Could not recommend for the price. Maybe if it were $5-$10.

I bought this case in early August for a few reasons: 1. My daughter has one a lot like it and it has held up well. 2. I liked the color 3. I wanted a kick stand for my phone. Unfortunately it didn't live up to its expectations with my first and third requirements. The iPhone 6s is too heavy to really be held properly by the included card kickstand. The slot tends to be a bit too loose. The other thing that happened is that the case broke on the bottom of the card slot right by where the Spigen logo is. The phone and case were never dropped from a height exceeding 1-2 inches for setting it down. The case was never removed except for the photo I wanted to take of it. It just broke from the repeated stress of of going into and out of my front pocket. Because of its failure in less than a month and a half of use I would not recommend this product which is unfortunate because it really is a striking blue color that I like.

The glass is beautiful and easy to install. Unfortunately, I had to remove it because my fingerprint reader was all but useless with the screen protector on it. I was careful to follow the install instructions, making sure the fingerprint ring was properly centered over the fingerprint sensor. I made sure all air bubbles were gone, just as the instructions said. But only one out if every 10 or so attempts were successful at recognizing my fingerprint, even with sensitivity set as instructed. The print ring on the screen protector is also way too distracting. Trying to view a website, or social media app, I was constantly noticing this round ring in the middle of my view. I wasn't a fan. If you have a phone with the fingerprint reader on the buttons instead of the screen, this product would be great. Giving it two stars for the gorgeous glass and easy install. But taking off three stars for the useless print reader.

It should be mentioned that the cold shoe on top of this handle is just a big gaping slot, with no pressure pads to retain anything inserted in it. I inserted an accessory viewfinder and when I tipped the handle back, the viewfinder just fell out. Better made devices use pressure pads like hot shoes on cameras. The drawings for this product show accessory devices (like the microphone) with a thumb screw at its base, but the ad should go further to mention that a thumb screw is ESSENTIAL to prevent it falling out of the top of their handle.

I like this phone, I like my other blu phone too which I'm going to have to go back to using even though the screen is cracked, because the G91 pro battery is shot. I'm lucky to get eight hours out of it. Only had it a year. I don't have a lot of apps, games or junk on my phone. I've deleted unwanted apps, I use battery saver and got rid of everything that I just don't use and still the battery doesn't last. I have gotten to the point of keeping it on the charger all the time but this doesn't work well when you're out and about.

This case is sleek and smooth. It doesn't take away the shape of the phone, and doesn't add any bulk. I love that the bottom cutout is large because it makes it easier to use with non-apple chargers. For $10, its a good case to keep your phone from getting scratched. However, I don't think this guy will protect you very much from falls and such, only the occasional bump here and there. What really made me take the review down a star was the fact that it makes my screen protector bubble on one corner. While a lot of people would say this is to be expected, I would assume that by now with so many iPhones and iPods there would be a slider that doesn't bubble screen protectors? It's very annoying to have a bubble on that corner and i suspect I will need to buy a new protector soon. UPDATE: I'm beginning to dislike this case for two reasons: 1. It came apart when i tried to take my phone out of my back pocket. It didn't fall, it wasn't man-handled. I simply slide it out of my pocket and the two pieces separated. 2. I'm pretty sure it left a small scratch on the back of my gold 5S. I've had this case on since Christmas Day, so it hasn't bee this long. Both of these reasons caused me to take it down a star. I actually expect a case to stay ON a phone and to keep it from getting damaged.

I was hoping to be able to use this as a quick option for shooting 360 degree panos for publishing on Google Street view. However I was not able to edit the photos sufficiently to product a clean pano without my hand, head or body in the nadir. I suspect it's good as a novelty camera attachment for those wanting to post to some social media platform, but in my opinion it lacks in quality and versatility for professional use. It's also a bit pricey for a novelty camera attachment. There are other small stand alone 360 cameras that do a better job in my opinion.

This was pretty, but it came damaged (just cosmetically) from the way it was packaged. I included pictures to show how the little braided wristlet cord had pressed up against the back of the phone cover and left indentation and faded marks along the whole back. Then there is also a scratch/worn away area in the front. I need a phone cover today, so I’m not bothering with the return process, but they need to package this so the cover isn’t messed up before the buyer even receives it! I like the floral design a lot and the inside holds my cards as designed.

I hope people read this and don't just base this review on the stars. I love this screen protector. From what I understand the pixel phone has a bit of a contoured surface which makes it impossible to get a tempered glass screen. This solves that problem. It looks beautiful on the phone and feels great. The 2 issues that I have had are the "halo" that occasionally occurs because it doesn't actually touch the phone screen itself (hoover over the screen due to the shape of the phone itself). This is not that bad and goes away on its own (much better than a constant halo around the entire screen with other protective screens). The second issue just happened today. I simply placed the phone on my desk at work with the screen down and the protective screen cracked and the bottom. This is not a big crack but I have had this screen for only a month. I love the look and feel but I now question the durability.

The price is great for the quality of the case but I'm not sure how I feel about this yet. The back part that is textured feels kind of slick... That's the only word I can think of to describe it. Like it could easily slip from my hand. The power/lock button is a bit difficult to press and it made my phone a little heavier but it's not something that bothers me. This is a good case but my favorite case from Caseology is their wavelength series. Edit: I ended up returning this case and purchased their Wavelength series in navy and gold. The Vault Series case was a bit "rough around the edges" as in the sides were kind of sharp?? Not sure if that's the best description. The difficulty of pressing the lock and volume buttons also drove me nuts. Maybe this case will be good for some but I just didn't like this case.

I have very little confidence in this case, the silicon is just so loose and flabby in the places the polycarbonate shell isn't holding it on. The entire bottom and top edges separate away from the phone if you even brush past them with your hand, because they're only held on by the corner pieces, leaving the entire edge unsupported. I can't imagine why this has so many good reviews, this seems like a bad design. It certainly is a nice-looking case, and the buttons work great. I love the kickstand, too. If I wasn't such a clutz I'd probably be perfectly happy with it, but I need serious protection for my poor defenseless devices, and this is far from it.

Original review: The charging port on the phone I received is finicky, and it often goes back and forth (i.e. actively charging for a few seconds, then not charging for a few seconds, then back to charging). Although it's finicky, it does charge to 100% and it holds the charge well. The camera is pretty dang good on this too! 2 week update: The charging port barely works at all now. I noticed it was a bit weird the first day I got it, and I incorrectly assumed that it wouldn't be much of a problem. But it worsened pretty quickly and it's now at the point where it barely charges at all. It's disappointing because this phone was advertised as being in "excellent condition". I've submitted a return request and I'll be ordering a replacement once I receive my refund.

[[ASIN:B006NZ7Y0K HTC Wildfire S Prepaid Android Phone (MetroPCS)]] As with most prepaid android phones, don't expect it to be any where near as good as phones such as an iPhone, Galaxy, or most other contract phones. The battery life on standby has lasted about 8 hours, with continuous text around 3-4 hours. Talk time would kill the battery at abou 1 1/2 to 2 hours if you're likely. Depending on the prepaid carrier expect a variety of bloat ware, constantly slowly the device even after forcing close such apps. Voice quality is decent when the device decides to function somewhat properly. Not that great experience, but was expecting more considering the short experience with other HTC products and recommendations from friends and coworkers. As a prepaid android set I would recommend this to teens and folks who aren't familiar with the operating system. If you have experience with android devices and want to cut your bill with a prepaid service I would look else where.

I was excited to have a new red case to go with my new red iPhone11. I used this for a while, and found it handy to have a spot for my transit pass and credit card -- but eventually, I went back to a simple case because I did not like the extra bulk of this case and could not use it with wireless charging stands. It is a nice enough case -- it certainly doesn't feel like high quality leather, but it seems sturdy enough to hold up to every day. The case does not protect or cover the phone screen -- rather it just provides a place to store cards on the back of the phone. Overall, this was a nice case -- but it does not protect the screen and is not compatible with charging stands.

I lost quite a bit of enthusiasm for this device before I even attached it to my iPhone. The inexplicably dumb design choices made to accommodate iPhones are evident the moment you attempt to connect your iPhone. I have an iPhone 13 Pro Max, which required an additional piece of ugly, black rubber to accommodate my larger Pro Max. Considering every damn iPhone ever made has a FLAT top and bottom, WHY did Backbone choose to make a controller with these goofy adapters, instead of providing flat surfaces to hold the entire phone instead of focusing on the camera bump, which every iPhone also has? This controller was NOT designed for iPhone. It was jankily modified to support iPhone with additional parts, but still has the premium price associated with anything Apple. This $100 controller didn’t even include a case?! Don’t use the trial software unless your willing to dedicate the trial period’s end date to avoid the $40/yr subscription that allows Backbone to pester you with meaningless marketing emails for features you will likely never use. I’ve owned the Backbone for months and I’ve never used the app for anything, despite paying for that $40 sub, which makes this controller ridiculously priced for what it actually provides. I’d encourage anyone considering this controller to exhaust every single option they have before pulling the trigger on buying the Backbone. It’s a god controller, but really no better than a Joy Con or Xbox Controller. There are cheaper options available to use on iPhone and I wish I’d tried a few more options before spending well over $150 on an iPhone controller that’s only a bit above average. I’d have purchased a dedicated gaming handheld and avoided all the limited choices on iPhone.

I have many Anker products. Some of them I've even purchased in bulk for employees, coworkers, family, and as Christmas presents. It's almost funny to mention that as I type this, my phone is plugged into my Anker 5 ports charger. So I was excited to get a great deal on a phone case. I realize this is a okay review but its a honest one, I have installed every type of screen protector there is on more than 25 phones and this brand is not good at all, it does go on very easy with very little to no bubbles after installation and the manufacturer supplies a plastic guide for you to line the protector on the first time ( this should be a standard tool supplied by every maker ), this is where it goes bad, the smudges and fingerprints you will be dealing with is not something that happens once a day, it you want a clean screen you will have to clean the screen after every time you use the phone, terrible. I've had this for over a year now. Nearly the whole time the face of the watch has had a cloudy appearance that has slowly gotten worse over time (initially it was only going from inside to outside, but now it's like that all the time); it's like there's cloudiness in the glass of the watch face itself. I contacted Withings and then Nokia several times about it, but they never really bothered to do anything about it. Sometimes the notifications stop working and I have to turn bluetooth (on the phone) off and back on, then close and restart the Nokia Health app, in order to get the notifications working again. This MagicMobile case for the iPhone 6 / 6s is definitely pleasing to the eye and comes in a variety of vibrant colors. It's made of thin plastic that is colored around the edges, while the middle is a frosty translucent plastic (it may not look like it in the picture, but the back IS completely covered). Now, as for protection and durability... That's where my problem lies with this case. If you're a person that takes care of their phone and is careful with it, you're golden; this case is an affordable and attractive solution for you! It will protect the phone from scuffs and scratches, and minor short falls. If you tend to drop your phone and you're a bit careless or clumsy, I wouldn't rely on this case alone. The thin layer of plastic isn't going to protect your device from falls more than a few feet high and doesn't really "overlap" the sides of the screen, leaving it vulnerable to cracking and even shattering if it were to land wrong. That being said, you get what you pay for! This is a beautiful, affordable, and low-profile case that is sure to turn heads. I really like it, I just don't trust it as my go-to case for when I'm out and about and using the phone a lot. I received this product at a discount in exchange for my honest review.

One star off because in just a few days the finish is showing a tiny bit of wear where it drags on the desk, table, etc. A tiny bit will become a large bit in short order. But, again, consider the price.

I like the style of the band and it has been very comfortable once I got it sized correctly (which can be done easily with the equipment included in the box). However, I've only had it for about a week and the black paint is already starting to wear off near the clasp on the bottom of the band. I was looking for a good quality screen protector that would keep my iPhone from getting scratched. My friend had a matte-finished screen protector that he got from Apple, but it was expensive, and I wanted to go a little lower. When I found this product, I was a little wary about the price being so low. I didn't want a low quality screen protector. However, after reading positive reviews I decided I was going to just get it. It was only a dollar...why not? But when I tried to put the screen protector on my phone, I wasn't impressed. There were a lot of bubbles, and the quality seemed lower than what I wanted--which is what I thought in the beginning. I immediately went out and bought a more expensive, higher quality one, which works great. This one is not terrible, but it wasn't the type of quality I wanted. It didn't have the matte finish that I wanted and there were a lot of bubbles. Next time, I will just go with the more expensive option.

The case is beautiful and it fits my iPhone 11 perfectly. I’m not sure about how well it will protect the phone from damage as seems a little flimsy on the sides. The back of the case is harder. The finger ring holder is nice and seems pretty sturdy and very easy to use. It lifts up and rotates well. Slightly disappointed with the magnet as this was the reason for me getting the case. Bought this to convert a newer USB-C 2Fac dongle for use in my older system that doesn’t have a USB-C port on the front (Work upgraded our 2Fac VPN methodology). The bottom is wide open, so if you're worried about drops, then I wouldn't recommend this case. Positives: It leaves the speaker and charging port uncovered and doesn't inhibit any swiping from the bottom of the display, which is important on the iPhone X models. Leaves plenty of room for a screen protector and is slim all around the phone Negatives: silicone back is slicker than you would expect, not quite as slick as plastic, but close. It doesn't have the tack to your skin that you expect from silicone covers. I wanted the case for drop protection and tackiness to my hand as I hold it. I don't want to add one of those gripper buttons and want it in and out of my pocket easily. I returned mine because I need more protection and grip than it offered.

The waterproof case is in two parts that snap over the phone. They are stiff and difficult to install over the phone, especially the clear top portion which must also fit over the bottom piece. The added bulk of the case meant that it would not fit in the belt clip that I use at work. So I was constantly working the phone into the case and back out which is not a trivial task. Therefore, this case is not good for individuals that want to use the phone on the bike but also carry it in a belt clip when not on the bike. The flap that cover the earphone did not stay closed; however, that is not a major issue if earphones are used. The biggest problem is that the mounting clamp is bulky and the place where the phone fastens is offset to one side. My bike has aerobars so there was no room to mount the clamp to the handlebars. Nor was there sufficient room to place it on the gooseneck. I ended up mounting it to the top horizontal bar. Unfortunately, because of the offset (which is now to one side of the bar), the phone was in the way when I needed to raise out of the saddle.

First off I would like to say that I am an ANKER man. i have their Car chargers, Batteries, Speakers (Soundcore), wall chargers, charge cables, Qi charge pads, and even Flashlights... This is the first product I have been truly disappointed in. Now don't get me wrong, the MagSafe Qi Charge pad itself is great.. strong , sturdy , magnetic hold with Qi quick charging capable with the iPhone 12+ ONLY. ---BUT--- both the vent clip and the dinky little 3m tape base they include are woefully under-designed. I have been promoting Anker's superiority to my friends, family, etc.. for YEARS and this is the only one that I would go so far as to say that it needs help. I hope they can come to the table and re-design the base because it is bad. If you are going to purchase this device, use it only for the charge pad. My original car charge mount had a GREAT base and I ended up re-installing it, luckily, the pad base ball joints SEEM to be universal, so I was able to keep the MagSafe Qi charging pad part of this product and use it on my old car charge base. I threw away both the vent-clip and the crappy-non-suction-cup-base in order to salvage the use of this product. sorry for the lengthy review: TL:DR; if you have an iPhone 12 ( not 'MagSafe compatible' ) this will work for you, just keep your old car charge base and throw away the included clips !

After finding a case I liked, I tried and returned 2 screen protectors that didn't size up well. After laying out a grand for the phone, I didn't want to mess up the screen and settled for buying another case with a built in screen protector. I like the kick stand and case protection but the cover is a disaster. First off, it has the dreaded rainbow effect or what some call the oil slick between the phone and the protector. Although it's not too noticeable when the phone is on, you can see how bad it really is with the phone off. Next complaint, the cover retains body oil like a magnet to iron fillings. It gets dirty easily and fast. Lastly and most importantly, I treat my phone with great care and the screen protector scratches easily and there are no options to purchase just the protector by itself. I'll keep this one for a year or so and then see reviews of other available products. Maybe by then, there will be something better out there.

This is a nearly perfect design. It's sturdy, works perfectly in the CD holder, and does everything you'd want it to do. However, its design also blocks the touchscreen too much, especially when a phone is on it. This really needs to have a way to extend upwards, or downwards by a couple of inches. I even checked with the company to see if there were any attachments that I could connect to it to move the part out of the way, but nope. This becomes most noticeable when I'm trying to back up my car and I have to remove my phone to see the screen. With no phone its somewhat annoying, with a phone it's horrible. After using this for the last couple of months I've decided the screen blocking is unacceptable and I'm going to find something else.

nearly impossible to get off. The graphic on the back is clear and as shown. I put this case on my brand new Nexus 6 immediately as I'm prone to dropping things. It looks great and seems to offer great protection. When I tried to take the case off to install my SIM card, both me and a CSR at T-Mobile couldn't get this thing off, with our fingers, fingernails, or tools. This case does come with a little three-sided tool that you're supposed to put in a space in the case and turn to pop the case open, but that's much easier said than done. It probably took me a solid 10-15 minutes of using the tool and my fingernails to gently pry this thing open without breaking it. So that being said, it's definitely solid protection that won't come off if you drop it. Or smash it with a hammer, or use a flamethrower on it.

Received and installed their screen protector. Good fit. Easy to install. Smooth responsive surface. The Galaxy Z Flip absolutely needs a screen protector. I have already noticed a glaze on the surface where I pull out the edge screen. Make sure you move the location of the edge screen frequently. This surface glaze is only visible when you hold the phone flat and view the surface from an edge. I jumped on this brand screen protector since they have a decent reputation and they indicated an early delivery date. I was concerned about adhesion at the hinge area. To date, this has not been an issue. It is impossible to give a final rating till I have used this product for a reasonable amount of time. Will update at that point.

I haven't tested fate seeing how tough this thing is. But from the information on their website it seems tough, and I'm okay leaving it at that. I followed the instructions on the video and got it on nicely, which is saying something because I have the uncanny ability to mess up every screen protector application I have ever attempted. I docked a star because it isn't as crisp feeling as just the screen or a regular screen protector are. It has a tiny bit of squish to it, and a little more texture than just a screen would. If you press on it with your fingernail it'll leave a little dent. Also there are a couple of very small ripples on the surface that haven't smoothed out yet, even though it is well sealed in those areas. All in all I'd recommend it, it seems quite protective for a screen saver, and the annoyances are minor, not usually noticeable unless you're looking for it. Update 5/25/2014: One of the corners started not sticking good and was trying to curl up, and a few weeks later it must have caught in my pocket, but the whole side rolled down and got covered in pocket lint. Never had a problem like that before, Maybe the edge didn't want to stay on because the skinomi screen protector is a bit thicker than the usual ones. Bottom line though for $10 I would have expected the thing to stay on longer than 4 months or so. So I removed it the rest of the way and decided to test how strong it was. Neither myself or my brother could break this thing. I tried to puncture it with a key while he held it and was unable to. So that's fun.

If you're careful with your phone and you just want a certain measure of protection, this case is fine. If you're drop-prone, get something better. Four stars.
