Odered 2 new batteries to replace in 2 iPhone 6S's. One has been working great, takes a full charge, and I am totally happy with. The other took a charge for about a month and then completely stopped. I thought it might be the charging port in the phone that was faulty, so I ordered a new one of those and replaced it in the phone. It still would not charge the new battery. I double checked by re-installing an old battery, and it took a charge just fine.(At least, as well as it could being 3 years old.) So, I am happy and unhappy. If you get a good battery, they work great, If yo get a bad battery, you are out of luck, since you have to tear the phone apart again, which ruins the gasket seal and adhesive strips. Guess it's time to just buy at least one new phone. Good luck.

This screen protector was easy to install and I was able to get it on without any bubbles. The camera protector was easy too. You just have to watch the video a few times to understand what to do. My only complaint is that both the protectors get very smudgy. I was only using the screen protector that came on the phone when I bought it and nothing on the camera and I never had any smudgy fingerprints. Now that's all I see. Of course the screens are better protected now, but just be aware that you'll be cleaning the screen off a lot.

This glass was very easy to install as it came with a template to place on the phone. The fingerprint reader is slower to react then workout the protector, even after I increased the sensitivity, but it still works. I like that there is no cut out for the fingerprint reader. My photos seem to be just as good as before. My biggest gripe is that the glass isn't very tough. I've been very careful with what I put my phone with and haven't dropped it, but got a small crack and many scratches day one. The scratches have continued with daily use -placing it in and out of my purse and backpack phone pocket. The anti scratch quality is my biggest concern. It seems like this glass should be tougher. I'm going to put on my remanning protector and give it a try, but will likely not order this brand again.

I liked the idea of having a glass protector originally, before I realized that the ever so slight curve on the screen meant that there would be a pocket of air around the perimeter of the display. This didn't bother me at first, but dust would collect in the cracks on the side, and the only good way to clean it at that point is to remove it and wipe it down. It eventually cracked after being dropped pretty hard, and I've been going through a pack of regular plastic protectors and replacing them whenever the key scratches get too annoying.

This pop socket is beautiful and sturdy and sticks so well! It’s made very well. But it’s also very painful. The jewel is thick and heavy and the ridge that holds the jewel is too and it’s hard and it’s leaving painful swollen indents in my finger and defeats some of the purpose of using a pop socket. Even when I position my fingers behind it, it’s just heavy and thick and is hurting me. I’ve never had a pop socket do this before. So I’m going to buy a different style. It looks lovely tho and goes so well with my case aesthetics.

Something's different. This case isn't like the one I had for my iPhone 4s. The case doesn't seem as secure around the phone, and the rubber around the face started peeling after only a month. Still seems "waterproof", but I haven't dunked it with confidence like the former case I owned. I don't know that I'll get another. Call volume is ok on the earpiece. Listeners haven't complained that they can't hear me, so mic is good. When you use speakerphone or play a video or music, the sound is really muffled. Switch to control ringer doesn't line up well, so sometimes it toggles to silent, and other times I'm surprised to find it didn't move the switch. Upon closer inspection, it doesn't seem to line up well with the switch itself, and the plastic has worn from me trying to toggle on and off after only a little while. (Never had that issue with my 4s LifeProof case after 2 years!)

I bought this case for my Samsung Galaxy S9. It is very pretty and the sliding finger loop is a nice convenience. The kick stand tends to slide on most hard surfaces but is functional. My chief complaint is that the case is so thick that it makes using your fingerprint to unlock your phone is unreliable. I have to try to jam my finger in as flat as possible into the opening to get my phone to recognize my fingerprint. But the case is very protective, so much so that it’s difficult to get it off when needed. I’m probably going to replace it solely because of the difficulty scanning my fingerprint.

Bought it for my new S22+. The kickstand was great. Worked for portrait and landscape views and allowed for precise positioning in landscape. Translucent back is nice if you want to show some color. I did like the slimmer profile. Side buttons were east to find/press. A minor annoyance is that it does not lay flat on its back. There is some wobble due to the height difference of the camera and kickstand areas. I returned it for two reasons. 1) Back was fairly stiff but didn't think it provided enough protection for the glass back of the S22+. 2) Felt that the camera/flash cut out would soften in warmer temps (or over time) and snag on pockets or other clothing. Other cases have a separator/support between the cameras and flash.

Well made and all aluminum. Easy to install which was a good thing as mine came with no directions. It secures well to the handle bar and holds the phone securely. My only complaint is the feature which allows the angle of the screen to the rider to be changed also allows my iphone 8S to jiggle enough that i keep getting prompts to delete text or cancel on the screen. This must be cleared so that I can see the trail map that I am trying to follow. I attempted to tighten up the screw enough to stop this with no luck. I will try to remove the top and put a rubber washer in between.

This seems to be a decent case. It doesn't seem to offer as much protection as you might get from an otter Box but it has a slimmer profile than my iPhone 5S Otter Box. It can still slide in and out of my pocket with ease. I have not had any issue with the screen protector which one of the main reasons I ordered this one. My major issue is the tab that covers the charging port. It covers the opening but something about it makes it a pain to use. It always feels like a hassle to deal with.

This is really pretty. Unfortunately I did not receive the Dark option I was sent the grey. It did not come with the metal part on the bottom (which is fine honestly), nor did it contain the five card spacer (this one just had two). I took it out and slapped it on before I even realized it was the wrong color. It would not stick. For the life of me I ended up using gorilla glue on this dang thing. Usually 3M is great stuff, and it's not the sellers fault as the backing was covered and neatly applied, it was just downright bad luck and ineffective. I really wanted this to work, I love how cute it is. Unfortunately, three strikes your out and I therefor cannot recommend purchasing this item. Sad day.

I had an incipio with my 5 and 5s. This came today, and I have played with it a bit. Seems to be a great case, well made! The only thing I have yet to figure out is the mechanism that holds the cards tight is a little finicky on getting the cards in, don't know if it will loosen up a little bit or not. Cards seem to catch on it when putting them in. I hold 3 cards in it, but tried 4 to see how it would be. It held 4 fine, just bowed out a little bit in the middle, so it may not be completely flat if you lay it on the table. I stick to 3 anyway, so no problem for me.

First time trying a vent mount and was impressed by how tiny and easy to use it seemed, but the design has flaws. The front plastic plate is loose and rattles which is very irritating. Can probably fix that with a drop of hot glue or something. The other and bigger issue is that the vent grip itself is not sturdy enough and has bent open a little in the 2-3 weeks it’s been installed and keeps slipping loose. You can push and click it back on easily enough, but that action messes up the angle of the phone and requires constant tweaking to get it just right again. I was using a iPhone X with a thin case. I’m going back to a cup-type holder even though they are more expensive, at least they are not fidgety or block a vent.

We didn't get a chance to use the remote because I just used the button on my Apple watch to take the photos but the extender part of the selfie stick was perfect. I have an iPhone 14 pro max in an Otterbox case and it was a bit difficult to get the phone into the holder while still in its' case but I was able to Macgyver it in and it was nice and snug. We were able to take some pretty great photos while walking around California with this selfie stick so I was pleased. It was a little hard to figure out how to use it all because it didn't come with directions and I was afraid if I pulled too hard I would break it (note: you are supposed to pull which I eventually figured out).

So far, the mount has been great! Very easy install. Suctioned to my dashboard without even needing the adhesive pad. Had a bit of trouble getting the ball mount on the back of the magnet tight, but got there eventually. Holds my Galaxy S8 Active just fine, and I haven't even needed to attach one of the included metal plates for it to hold. So far, it's great! That said, I've barely had it in my car for 2 days so far, but we've already received at least 2 emails from the seller asking for a review. So, here's your review. Now stop contacting us.

I like this charger, BUT, the blue LED stays illuminated even when there is nothing connected to it. Since I purchased this for my boat, I really don't like the fact that this (a.) drains the battery while the boat is on the trailer, and (b.) makes it difficult to troubleshoot when the connected device doesn't charge. I installed a power cut - off switch to solve the first issue. I DO like the dual current rates, as it allows me to keep my phone active with the GPS and radar app running, important in Florida since storms can and do pop up every afternoon.

I like this. Its comfortable made relatively nice and fits phones with cases well some cases as long as they are not super bulky. The really cool thing is it charges your phone. The shutter button however when connected bluetooth does not work. It activates zoom for some reason but doesn't really zoom. but it's not a big deal for me since the camera buttons aren't to far away. So because it doesn't quite work exactly the way its suppose to it gets 4 stars also bc of the slightly high price of $60 for how this is. UPDATE: The shutter button does not connect via bluetooth at all. Never did. When searching an item appears but says cannot connect without app. The charging does not work with a case on or you need to have a super slim case. Charges my Note 8 fine without a case but with a case it doesn't. It does not charge my Zflip no matter what. I have also found this same product under a different name at half the price so I am dropping it another star.

First, the good. The pouch is waterproof and suits the intended purpose in that regard. The closure is secure and watertight. However, despite the description indicating this would fit an iPhone Plus, my 8+ barely fits WITHOUT a case on the phone. Presumably, the pouch is the case you’re using and no impact protection is required, and I’ll just remove my phone from the regular case when I’m using the pouch. For some users, though, this may be a dealbreaker, so it’s worth a mention. Additionally—and this is my biggest problem with the pouch—the lanyard is utterly useless because you can’t attach it to the pouch. (See pictures.) The loop for attaching is too small for the clip to fit through. Real stupid design flaw for which there is no excuse.

I loved this case for two months but then one day my phone tragically slipped from my fingers and the case did not survive. I must say, the case served it's purpose because the phone survived the fall unscathed. The case however suffered a much different fate. The bottom right corner broke off leaving the weak silicone under case exposed. I replaced this case with a different name brand case and I have a hunch as to why the Incipio design is flawed. I feel that the corner design on the Incipio case is not sturdy enough to withstand a 4 ft fall. Another issue I had was with the silicone inside layer becoming worn quickly. I don't put my phone in and out of a pocket and the silicone still became loose over time. I would not try this exact case again. I would try other products from this company. A nice feature of this case is the frosty feel that didn't slide out of my hands very easily.

So far, so good. However, they came without instructions and I initially thought that they weren't going to work because they come installed in an alignment tool and I assumed that the alignment tool was part of an assembly. If that had been true, the whole thing wouldn't have fit inside my case. So, take the phone out of any case you may have added already, leave the lens protectors in the alignment too, press the alignment tool over the lenses, and then lift the alignment tool off and discard it. I didn't rate their adhesion or durability because I just finished the installation. But, they haven't fallen off yet!

This is an okay grip, but it was much thicker than I anticipated which made my car phone mount unusable unless I took my whole phone case off. The elastic starts very tight and strong, and at first it was uncomfortable to use with even just one finger. Now it is so loose that it stays awkwardly raised from the back, and I have to use two or 3 fingers just to keep it from sliding around. I tried to take it off to see if i could cut the elastic and reattach it, and the plastic base just snapped and the adhesive stuck in place, though it wasn't hard to scrape off. People have said this is moveable, but I really don't think it is.

TL:DR This case is hard to hold and doesn't provide adequate protection. Rated 3 stars because the case does what it says; it's very slim. After getting an annoying large case I wanted to try a small one. This is too small. You dont realize how much comfort the wider case gives your fingers. With no edges your fingers cradle the space between the nonslip case and sleek smoothness of the phone. There are no button covers so it's actually easy to accidentally press them. A big fault I discovered within a day it that the case does not extend over the screen. I drop my phone at least once a day (this case probably more, since it's so strange to hold), and without the case absorbing the impact my brand new screen protector cracked. It's a novel idea, I love how sleek my phone is without a case, but I'd rather have a bulkier case than a broken 700$ phone.

Okay this is definitely not a water resistant case cause I got it all tightened up and splashed some water on it using my hand and immediately water got in between the protector and screen. The sensitivity also go very low but there is a really good app in play store, just search sensitivity and it would come up, this app helped a lot so far. The phone is def built like tank and could easily take a fall but i'm not sure if the downsides are worth it as i'm around water a lot hence the S7, but I don't think I can handle the water between the screen protector and phone screen. Would report back when I have a chance to use the case for a couple of hours. Edited - if the case is tightened properly on the power button side the bottun tends to be squishy so you'll need to have it a little looser on that side for the button to work properly.

I bought this cover based on the overall stars/ of reviews. Wanted something cute that would also protect my phone. The design isn't as bright as it looks in the pictures, it is much duller. However, the biggest issue is that the 3 piece phone case system doesn't lock together well and fit around the phone well. I had dropped my phone after first using the case from a height of about 3 feet and the entire phone case came apart. Not very effective at all. And again, the pieces don't lock together and fit the phone well. I would NOT recommend purchasing this case.

This is a great case for protecting the back of your phone, but won't do anything to protect the screen. I've never had a case on my phone ever, and I've never dropped my phone or cracked the screen, but at the constant urging of my son, I decided it would be a small investment "just in case". I don't use a case mainly because I like the elegant design and feel of the iPhone. So this seemed like a good compromise; the slim fit is quite nice, but after two weeks with this case, I did drop my phone, and the screen cracked. I can see that the case doesn't come up around the edges of the front quite enough to prevent disaster from striking, so I'm not quite sure what it's good for as the screen seems to be the most vulnerable.

UPDATED INFO!!! I have upgraded my stars as i have been contacted by customer service, which is outstanding by the way, and they are fully aware of the issue below and are offering a fix. Will update again after receipt, but had to give more stars due to the service i have been receiving!! Major props!!! The full protection is great. But it rubs against the crown so yeah. Not going to he using this as thats what i use to turn the screen on instead of tapping. Was perfect till i noticed that and then its not much use to me as it will eventually rub a ring

I already removed this from my phone. While it went on easy, bubble free and fit well, it reduced touch sensitivity to much for my tastes. I have used screen protectors on ALL my phones for years but not the Pixel XL for now. The screen did have a slight imperfection that looked like a spot of dust but upon magnification was actually a flaw in the glass. It was almost in the middle and while noticeable when the phone was off it wasn't when you used the phone. I guess the curved screen makes the screen less sensitive on the edges with the glass on. Oh well. I used it so I eat it.

I loved the phone case when it first arrived. I still like it. The case is really snug and the pocket is big enough to keep several cards inside (right now I have 2 ID cards and 2 credit cards with room to spare). The magnet is great for keeping the case shut and unlike velcro, it doesn't snag on clothing. The camera worked perfectly (no vignetting)... at first. After a couple months of use, the corner near the camera started to bend back and makes a black outline around my photos. Perhaps if I glued it down, it would be nice again. Just be careful not to touch that corner so it doesn't bend. Other than that it looks pretty good for 6 months of use.

I originally purchased this case for my daughter's enjoyment even thought it was for my phone and loved the look of it. Upon arrival, once I removed it from the packaging there was a very strong odor and I also noticed that there were many areas where the case had rough edges. I used a pair of scissors to remove the obvious blemishes but I wish more attention had been given to delivering a "polished" product. After using the case for some time now and have to admit I love the youthful look and it does a good job protecting my phone (although I don't trust throwing it into my book bag). Despite my initial criticisms, I do enjoy using this case especially for the price, though I will likely be purchasing a "boring adult" case in the future

I would first like to start off by saying that I think that I may have gotten a lemon. The stand feels very solid and sturdy in your hand. It folds up and is very compact. However, the product that I received has a slight issue that dramatically hinders it’s use. One of the arms that supports the phone is lose. The thread is stripped, so the screw cannot fully connect, which results in a crooked phone placement. It might not bother some people, but it makes me not even want to use it, because all I notice is the crooked picture.

These are crap. They give you a microfiber cloth to wipe with. I am pretty sure it deposits little fibers as after apply the first protector thats exactly what I saw. They also had micro bubbles. So I removed one protector down on to number 2 . Went out of my way to make sure nothing got on the screen so I wiped With a terry cloth one would use to work on high end car paint. Then again used the alcohol swab. Once dried applied the second protector it did not align well even with their cheap alignment tool. Had to care remove and reapply aligned this time carefully by hand. Still it came out with micro bubbles center roughly. One I can see even at off angle. Update.... Tozo does seem to want to keep their customees satisfied by shipping out free of charge another set of screen protectors. I will be using it and hopefully there will be no bubbles.

I have an iPhone XR, and use it for gig work. The apps I use do drain the battery quickly, and I do what I can to mitigate that, but the charger just can't keep up. I've actually seen the phone charge go down while driving. I'm finding myself using the lightning cord that came with the phone more often. When I buy a new mount, I will look for a quick charger or something with more power. Other than that, the mount is great. If you're not going to take the phone out often, let's say if you're a Lyft driver, then this will be great to use.

I ordered this about 3 months ago and the sides and edges are yellowing. I have a hard time using the volume and on/off buttons because of the case, and the shape of it doesn't seem to protect the screen. I don't think the edges come out far enough. My phone has slipped out of my hands twice, both kind of lightly on a wood floor. It seems to protect the phone from impact, but the screen cracked in the tiny gap where the screen protector and case do not meet. If only the case came down the width of a fingernail or two lower on the top!

Update on 2nd case: I purchased & installed the replacement in March and here we are in August and it has broken again in the same place as before, top-right corner of the front screen. I like this case, but I wish it was a bit more durable on the front screen part. Updating after 5 months of use: This week the border protection for the front screen broke. This part of the case is adhesively attached the phone and generally works well, but the molded plastic is designed with slits at the corners to allow the case to expand to be wrapped around the phone. This plastic is under tension once install and the slits in the corners are spots which can catch and result in breakage. This is what happened to me. Naturally the phone goes in and out of my pocket many times each day, and finally the top-right corner caught on something and it broke. The resulting break left a a flap of plastic on the long edge of the phone and made it annoying to keep on so I have removed it. I'm going to give the case one more try, because I really like the slim design and the protection it provides, but it's unfortunate that it's this fragile. Original review below: ------ This shouldn't be expected to provide much protection in the event of a drop, but for setting the phone down on various surfaces it works well to protect the edges and face and I'm happy with it. Using the double-sided adhesive that is included has kept the case on my phone for a few weeks now with no issues. It doesn't really add any bulk to the device either, just the protection that I wanted.

The reason I chose this product over all others was because of the included screen protector and the kickstand. Well, the case is awesome. It is durable and the kickstand is very strong. I was impressed at how nice the case wS for the price I paid for it. NOW...let's talk about this crappy screen protector. I honestly wonder if it was used. It was suppose to have a protective film over the fingerprint part before installation...well, it did not. I put the screen protector on very easily and it fit great. However, the fingerprint detector didn't work. I was so disappointed. I had to buy a separate set of screen protectors. I think that the manufacturer should just ditch the screen protector and just lower the price of the case. IJS.

Given all the raves about the sound quality of the BlueAnt Q2, I'm disappointed with it. The connection quality is poor - choppy, crackly, with millisecond dropouts. The voice quality, aside from the choppy connection, is mushy. I have it connected to two phones - a PCD Razzle and an HTC Ozone - and it behaves the same with both phones; so, no, it's not the phone. I've had two Plantronics Voyager Pro headsets over the last few years and they had MUCH better sound. The only reason I give the BlueAnt 3 stars is because it is much more comfortable than the Voyager Pro and the voice quality for the person on the other end of the line is very good, from what I've been told. All in all, though, I would not recommend this headset to anyone.

It was delivered insanely fast and it was a breeze to install. I haven't exactly tested it's protection but I'm skeptical. Also, I had initially though the stripes on the back were textured but they're not at all. They're very smooth. The whole case is very smooth for that matter. I'm used to a more bulky case that gives me piece of mind but hopefully I can get use to this. The button function on both sides is flawless and the ringer switch is easy enough to operate. Bottom line, I would recommend because it at least looks good but I don't think I'm going to be throwing this $900 phone out the window to test how strong it is.

Like the product, but have a serious issue in Australia. I purchased from Amazon and had it shipped to me. Attempts to use it with my Galaxy S6 Edge+ aren't working as the 'voice prompt' never occurs when connecting the device. This means the gear VR software won't install. Why this isn't just an app in the store is beyond me. I've read a lot about the issue and from what I can determine, there some kind of firmware required that's not yet available on phones in our region. It also seems there's some kind of key exchange happening between the Gear VR and the phone, which makes me wonder about the ability to sell the device in the future, if not sold as a pair with the phone. Really hope Samsung get this sorted, as an enthusiast, I was really hoping for a great out of the box experience to tell everyone about and right now the Gear VR is an expensive Google Cardboard.

I like the hook on back, can hang it on dash front with just stick on hook. The screen cover was too big, speaker hole isn't aligned. Tried enlarging that hole and shattered screen. The back isn't lined up with anything. Covers camera lenses, covers finger recognition module so can't open phone. The square , I assume camera gap is in middle of cover, cameras are in upper let corner as stated before. As long as cover is clean I think it'll will still take reasonably clear pictures, haven't tried that yet. I'm assuming I have a 2021 Gem 6, just got it 4 days ago but paper work doesn't id year. If not that may be the problem with covering up everything.

I purchased these USB chargers because I was in need of USB chargers with at least two slots, I'm on a tight budget, I needed more than one, and these had a decent review. I've had these wall USB chargers for about 6 months now. Of the 4, 2 of them have "died". Not a power surge or anything, just completely stopped working. Confirmed it's not my cables or plugs as they work with other wall chargers plugged in. I do like they're small, that they have 2 USB slots, and don't cover the other outlet whether directly in the wall, on an extension cord, or a power strip. It was the perfect size to take when I went on a business trip.

I purchased an ABCOTECH Magnetic Air Vent Mount, Model No: ABC2021 for my wife for Christmas. It does not fit her 2012 BMW 528i xDrive. In fact, it broke the vent during installation. It appears the thickness of the rubber tines are too big for the vents in this vehicle. There are no options or compatibility disclaimers for the product pursuant to my wife’s BMW, either on the product packaging or in the product’s content, and nothing on the Company website. I have contacted the company through their website and have not received a reply (they claim a response within 24-hours) since contacting them on December 25, 2016. Regardless of holidays, it is now January 4, 2017. Parenthetically, I did purchase a total of three of this item and two work, as designed and without problems, in my BMW M3 and Toyota Tundra truck.

The case is durable. I've not had any issues with it. The screen protector however is one of the worst that I've had. First it doesn't line up correctly it cuts off the sides if you want the front camera lined up correctly so minus points there. And I've never had a screen protector break so fast. I drop my phone like once a week and I also have pets and kids so it's knocked around a bit. My previou phone's screen protector lasted almost a year through multiple drops before it had any crack ons it. This one cracked the first time. All around the edges are nicks and gouges that are literally broken glass that will get in your fingers. So I would look for a better screen protector but the case itself is great.

[[VIDEOID:2723efbbb41960ef7d00a5ad0ce70fc7]] Original review, (see below for update and problem report) I drive a Jeep with a full roll cage in it. It's not easy to find a mount that will work around the part that goes across the dash. This little guy adapted quite well and with the telescoping arm I was able to draw it in nice and tight in a small space. The gummy suction cup really grips! Won't be coming loose on the trails and I love the push button release. No more broken brackets from having to pry clips from the sides of my phone. Bought a second one, same brand with a long arm for my hubby's F250. Finally, one that reaches far enough for his deep dash. ========================= UPDATED REVIEW - reduced star rating - added video: Fast forward a couple of years. First off. It arrived with small puncture holes in it. Like being pushed on pointed rocks. The pictures were hard to get clearly but i am attaching some and it was dirty a small film of dirt covered the back and a few pieces of feelable dirt were inside. Second it is a loose fit. Itll work because there is apparently no other options for this type of phone which really sucks because its not a form of protection for the phone at all. Just makes it another color. If you have to have a cover on your phone because you are that type of person itll work just fine. if you are looking for protection for your phonr from small falls and such it will do no good. Decent for the price would have been happier without the minor holes in it and the dirt that was all over it when it arrived which i unfortunately cleaned before i took the pictures. Just to be clear i am pushing slightly with my finger in the pictures to try to show the holes CLEARLY, WITHOUT making them bigger. which thankfully i achieved as best i could. Be sure to put your phone case on first. I put the glass protector on without the phone case. Then, when I snapped my phone case on, the glass protector split right down the middle, one long break from top to bottom. This happened with minimal pressure, so be very gentle when putting your phone case on, or put the phone case on first and then apply the glass protector. Good thing there are three glass protectors in the box. PS: the white applicator guide that comes with the glass protectors is, quite frankly, useless. As long as you can visually align the glass protector, it's going to go on straight.

This case is useful for two reasons: 1. It has a stand for viewing. 2. It increases grip for the phone. The case is very cheaply made with two pieces that don't tightly fit each other and separate easily. This can be addressed with a liberal application of superglue. Unfortunately the case itself doesn't offer a tight grip on the phone. Removing the phone is very easy but a drop is also likely to separate the phone from the case. Sadly, a liberal application of superglue would leave you with two problems, either a damaged phone or you would have to keep using this case. Not sure which is worse.

Its an OK cover for the price. one of the first problems was its too smooth, so the grip of the phone wasn't really that good even though this has a matte finish. second this cover is quite fragile. It broke and cracked with normal usage (i do remove it once every 2-3 days to clean the phone as its perforated). all in all invest in a better product if can afford to spend some more on a good cover. Although I've bought better covers for in this price range so its not a very good buy for the money.

I really like the 90° right angle cables. That is why this product got two stars instead of none. Each of the three cables would not fast charge at all. I tried each of them twice, but my battery just dropped to zero when I was using my Fire. Charging the tablet while it was sleeping was a slow process. From reading the reviews of 90° right angle charging cables from three different companies, I have learned that there are always some people who receive one, two, or three cables that just will not fast charge at all or work for a short while then stop fast charging. I seem to be in a small group of people who are having atrocious luck at receiving cables that work. Out of eight 90° right angle cables (3 different companies), I have received only one that has worked from the beginning and continues to work after three months. . As it happens, the other two from that company each worked about a month then quit fast charging. In the set of two cables neither worked very long. The other three cables did not work at all and they were from this company. The point that I am trying to make is that the majority of people who write reviews for each company receive cables that work. Some of us are not so lucky. I am not sure if the cables from one company are any better or worse than the cables from the other companies. Please realize that I am writing about the 90° right angle charging cables, not the ones that plug straight in. I just ordered from my fourth company. Hope my luck changes.

I bought this phone with the purpose of it being a relatively quick cheap fix so I don't have to spend a grand on a new phone. The one issue I have is with wifi. It has trouble connecting, do your research, this phone does have wifi connection issues. I have no use for this phone if it cant connect to wifi, wasted purchase. I really love the design and how you can simply unscrew it to switch between the disc and the mesh, but I've ran into some issues. My SO was nice enough to order these for me after my last stylus of choice was discontinued, and he thought it would be great since I play PAD and Mario Kart Tour. The disc end scratched the screen on my previous phone while using Swype. I haven't used that end much sense getting a new phone. I prefer the mesh nubs anyway, but with this stylus it popped completely out of the pen while playing PAD. I grabbed the extra one, screwed it in, and that one didn't even make it ten minutes before popping out too! And when the mesh ends pop out from the screw you have you use very slim tweezers to get the screw itself out if you want to try and reattach the mesh end. I don't think I would recommend this product to anyone who plays mobile games that involve a lot of swiping.

Not happy that I spent $40 on something undependable.

This product has a strong out current, however charge in and charge out options are very outdated. The USB mini charging was still only at 1/4 from an overnight charge (at least 10 hours). The USB A charge out, while it delivers strong, it is still lacking in compatibility with USB C products. This product would suite those that need a solid power bank for older type devices and don't need to upgrade for a few years. Like another reviewer said, this product did not arrive exactly as advertised. The packaging looks like it's been opened before, and says it contains a dust-free cloth and an "installation card" when it actually contains two tiny disposable wipes, one wet and one dry. The protector itself feels cheaper than I was expecting "tempered glass" to be, and I have no idea what the listing means by "Easy-Install Wings", since the product I got had nothing of the sort. That aside, it's decent as a screen protector, and I didn't have any trouble to speak of with dust or bubbles. I was so excited about this. I have an iPhone, an apple watch, and AirPods. I wanted to be able to have fewer cords and charge everything and I was also excited about the dimming clock. First of all, that clock has 3 levels and then off. They are ALL too bright! I have to shut the clock off every night because it's so bright, which completely defeats the purpose of having a clock, being able to see the time. Second of all, if you use the fast charger that comes with your watch, you can kiss the speed goodbye. If you actually plug your watch charger in where you're supposed to, it takes forever to charge it. I had to run the cord out of the top and plug it in directly because I don't have forever to charge my watch. Lastly, the stand that you're supposed to be able to charge your AirPods and your watch on is incredibly too small to have both cords inside of it like they are claiming will work. Like I said, I wanted it to work. I was super excited about it but it's just not a great design.

I'd love to say that this case is great. The wood looks good. The colors are nice. But here's the problem: the sides don't go up past the face of the phone, offering no screen protection so you can't set it down on it's face. I read that in a previous review but it didn't click as to why that's a big deal until I got it for myself. That means this cool looking wood backed phone only looks like everyone else's phone with a slim black case when it's on its back... the ONLY way you can set it down. No one ever sees the wood. Heck, I don't ever see the wood. And because it looks like everyone else's phone when it's on it's back, I've almost left mine behind a few times since adding this case (my last one was lime green and hard to miss). Also, that pretty wood adds a considerable amount of thickness onto the floppy rubber TPU case it's glued onto. It pushes this a hair past the slim case margins in my opinion. So, like I said. I want to like it.. I really do. But I might as well have just ordered a plain black case like everyone else's since that's the only part you, or anyone else, will see.

I have been a faithful LifeProof customer since the iPhone 4. When I got my 12 XS Max, getting a LifeProof case was the obvious thing to do. I ordered one for both my husband and I. We finally got our cases and we put them on immediately. In the past, there has not been an issue with the cases and having a glass screen protector underneath but with this case, we had to remove our glass screen protectors. For some reason it made the front bubble up to the point we had to physically press down just to get any response from the screen. Once we removed them, we have not had any issues with the screen. I do feel like the sides of the case don't completely close, as there is gapping on both sides and no matter how much I press it together, it doesn't stay. Also, the door on the charging port is probably the poorest I have seen. We have only had our cases maybe two weeks and the hinge is already worn. It is only a matter of time before it snaps off. Besides that, I am very happy with this case. It is thin but protective and it is definitely grippy. I read one review that said the case was slick and I do not have that issue at all. I also read another review that mentioned dots on the screen protector. My case also has those but it in no way affects the screen or the view and I can only seen them then my screen is off and I hold my phone at an angle. Decent case, but the price point is crazy. It's about time LifeProof became budget friendly.

Not absolutely thrilled with this product. I made sure when I looked at all of a available screen covers, to pick one that went edge to edge on my brand new watch. The description even says "2.5d full coverage screen protection". As you see in my picture, the glass does not go from edge to edge and does not even cover the entire glass face of the watch. When looking at the watch face head on you don't notice the extra ring around the face but even at a slight slant you can see that There is an additional line that circles the entire watch face and is rather annoying. I'm not sure why this company could not have made the glass just a few millimeters larger and it would be perfect. I will write more when I see how durable the glass is.

The belt clip holds to the belt fine, no issue there. The case fits okay, though I wish it hugged the top and bottom more tightly. My biggest gripe is that the phone does not slide well in the belt clip. If the phone rings, I have to stop what I am doing and use one hand to hold the belt clip and the other hand to remove the phone to answer it. The case appears to have too much contact/friction with the belt clip. Perhaps when the case wears down a bit, then this will no longer be the issue. However, I'm likely to find another case before that happens. People who need the belt clip get it not because it is fashionable (it is not, definitely), but because it fits the function of the job/environment. This assembly does not quite meet those requirements. When another belt clip case is released, I'm liable to buy that one instead (bought this one upon release of the G3).

I'm generally impressed with the value for money for the Nokia 2. However, I recently discovered that the Nokia 2 is not fully compatible with all T-mobile 4G LTE networks. According to Nokia Customer Service the Nokia 2 TA-1035 model operates on the following bands and frequencies: WCDMA: Band 1, 2, 5, 8; LTE: Band 1 (2100), 3 (1800), 5 (850), 7 (2600), 8 (900), 20 (800), 28 (700), 38 (2600), 40 (2300) This means that the TA-1035 DOES NOT work on LTE Bands: 2 (1900) & 12 (700). You need those bands to use T-Mobile's 4G LTE service in many places. So, this phone is not fully compatible with T-Mobile. Unfortunately, I have not yet found a reliable way to check which 4G LTE bands T-mobile uses for specific areas. So, if you plan on using T-mobile, and don't want your service dropping as you travel across the US, you had better not get this phone.
